text: I'm a day 1 player and I'll say it's the best RPG I've played. It's F2P friendly with generous rewards for each patch, amazing pity system, fun events, and doesn't make it impossible to farm for echoes and ascension plus XP materials. levelling characters isn't slow, but at a balanced pace to keep you engaged instead of loosing motivation to build them further. Character designs also are amazing. the lag is now fixed but the req storage space is insane on pocket devices.

Game is really good if you play it on high end mobile or decent laptop/PC. Both graphics and combat animations are extremely good, probably best in entire gacha industry, and no game is close to Wuwa in that area. Each character has unique sequence of animations, moves aren't repetitive, variety of combos etc. As for gacha part, weapon banner has no 50/50 unlike GI/HSR, though they don't have Capturing Radiance system if your losing streak goes brrr... Wuwa gives good amount of pulls.

Where do i start, it's been 2 years playing this masterpiece and I'm so glad i stuck with it. It has evolved into one of the best experiences in mobile gaming history. The story is absolutely amazing, the music is the best I've heard from any game, the graphics are stunning and the combat is a cherry on top (Peak combat i love it) Wuwa is going down in history as one of the best games ever not just gacha.

After the 3.3 Version, The optimization is improved to another level. Now there is no stuttering, lag etc. Also the story improved a lot. Not to mention the storage optimization which went from 50+ Gb to 38 GB. However do note that the phone became little a heater, like really hot, however this isn't an issue for me since this is summer time, and I play in front of the Air Cooler. Now the game is good, graphics are great, OST are quite soothing to listen to plus the songs which are even more so.

I have just started playing this game and I'm stunned by everything from visuals to combat everything is just near perfect though you have to compromise from quality and performance if you do not have a powerful phone but the game is very well optimised that on low graphics it can give upto 40-60 FPS . So it's a Must Try ! Caution: It's size is more than 50 GBs

I've played a lot of gacha games, including Genshin (AR58), HSR, AKE, but Wuthering Waves is the only one that truly hooked me. I eventually quit Genshin and stopped playing the others because they just weren't as fun for me. The combat feels amazing, movement and exploration are smooth, and every character feels enjoyable to play. The game keeps getting better with each update, the devs listen to feedback, and even as a F2P player I feel rewarded. I genuinely enjoy it.

WUWA is definitely a 5 star deserving game but in mobile it's barely playable now. Especially after the 3.1 update my tablet with snapdragon 870 can't run this like it used to. It crashes every time. The lags are unbearable. Maybe I'll play this more often when I get myself a laptop with great performance. Until then it's just a bad experience anyways.

I really love Wuthering Waves and genuinely enjoyed playing it — the visuals and gameplay are amazing. Unfortunately, even though my device is in good condition, the game keeps crashing and lagging heavily. The performance issues have become so bad that I can’t continue playing anymore. I hope the developers focus on optimization and stability improvements because this is a game I truly want to keep playing.

the game itself is good. I'm in mobile and I'm stuck at Lahoi-roi chapter 3 Act 1. I can't seem to get behind the wall to defend against the voidworm, it shoots before I could even reach there! Not only that, I can't skip the quest and I can't get out without completing it, which is impossible for me to do. If the time is longer, I could make it. I already tried 33 times... I don't think I'll be able to play the game again if the Devs won't fix this.

I started in its building stage itself, that time, story wasn't that good, I mean the experience, story game play, but battles are awesome. The dodge thing was very awesome. Genshin was one of its kind. Used to be. Then this came, changed everything, many things. Easy to play by controller. Now with competition, understood what is so less in genshin impact. They made most of them right.

I really loved playing this game but, it has some major problems. Firstly, it is very poorly optimised to the point that even high end devices can't run this game smoothly. Secondly, the game size is so huge it becomes a matter of time before your device runs out of space like... for starters it occupies about 52GB of space and deleting resources is not an option and if you choose to not download some older areas it would still cause problems because some older boss materials are needed.

This is honestly a fun game to play, but to grind for a character is hard. It's more of a pay to win situation. I lost my 50/50 in an event a month ago. Then the next event I got nothing, it was really hard to earn astrites. I missed out on 1-2 events because I couldn't get anything. Even with this current event I still can't get anything. Honestly it's a good game if you wanna waste storage and have time to kill. But I wouldn't recommend it.

Works fine at 60 hertz with my Galaxy S21 with mid graphics settings. Well I prefer Genshin's element reaction system, the combat in Wuthering Waves is game is just as much, if not more focused on learning your enemy as it is on your character. The music is above average, the story is good enough so far, and most importantly there is a dialog skip button! Daily missions can't be autoed but take maybe 5 minutes. Devs seem to listen and care about the players.

Playing on a 2 year old samsung phone and I've had no issues so far. The world is very vast with lots of puzzles to explore, the story is *immaculate* and male rover is pretty. What more can you ask for? update: its been over a year since I've posted the review and im gonna have to change it to 3 stars because its taking up more than 70 gigs on my phone and there's no option to delete old files unlike other, similar games. If I run out of space this game will be the first to go unfortunately

Amazing combat system, visuals, and story. The world is vibrant and still growing. I play it manly on My PlayStation 5 however it runs perfectly fine on my phone. Plus they give you settings that allow you to optimize the game to yield the best results. The idea that this game is a "gooner" needs to end. Y'all act like "anime" type games haven't been doing fan service since forever. It's simply a wonderful game 🎮🎯. Can't say it's a bad game by definition. It gives you what you're seeking.

It's an amazing game with great character designs and also amazing characters in general. The story is something I find enjoyable, and it's constantly improving from the first version. Although it is a bit fanservice-y, I don't mind, as that detail has never been a problem for me whatsoever, and most of the time I enjoy it. The mechanics are satisfying, and the game itself causes me to enjoy fighting, with it being rewarding in my own mind. I hope this game stays for a long time.

Speaking from a Realme 10 device(G99), the game itself is beautiful, character designs are top tier as always by Kuro. Combat is nice and so far the story is okay-ish but it's been improving so far. For the optimization which is the only complain I have in the game, it's improved since at launch but open world combat is so far has the most stutters. Exploration often felt smooth with little to no stutters. The most smooth experience I could get from the game is when you are in enclosed space.

This game is phenomenal in its graphics, music and combat mechanics. Being able to interrupt enemy attacks is so satisfying though the timing varies between characters. My biggest complaint is that there is quite a bit of power creep making the characters from launch irrelevant. The status effect system was not backloaded to existing characters (only exception is the Protag) and you need 5 star weapons because their abilities are pointless without good stats. The writing is mid until Ragunna.

I am really enjoying this game. The world is beautiful and large with plenty of puzzles and hidden treasures to discover. My first pulled character Phoebe made traversing the map faster and is very fun to play on mobile and PC. The combat is simple for a beginner but has depth as you learn more mechanics. I hope more players discover this gem and support the company because I look forward to many more updates in the future.

There are lots of bugs, especially when we refresh the game during an event because we were planning to restart our options but it just skips all the way to the back of the story, leaving confusion and empty minds. And exiting the game mid task would do so. But generous rewards each task! It's quite annoying too, the game restarts after just leaving it for a few seconds. It takes sooo long to load as well because of the heavy resources.

This game is stunning. Great character designs, fleshed out world, the cutscenes and visuals are peak, and fun and engaging combat. Top 2 gacha games available right now hands down. However, the performance is dogwater on even a medium end device (S23 FE). Framedrops and lag all over the place, phone gets hot enough to BBQ on and is borderline unplayable at times. Even with lowest settings enabled, the latest update has made this a consistent problem, now with added crashes. Sadly uninstalled.

this game is great to play but my phone being lag and I'm a bit confused when changing the graphic cause the red bar didn't even turn green or anything. and even I made it lowest quality, it's still lagging. when I go into another game, it work perfectly fine. I just hope I can play this game without having any lag cause it really stressful 🥲🥲🥲 since my laptop couldn't handle the game.

The game is very good. Exploration is fun, map and characters designs are very amazing and fighting just feels so smooth. The only reason why I give it 3 stars is because optimization is still an issue and anti-aliasing is weird on mobile by making everything blurry but without one, the game is just so rough. This roughness is such an eyesore to look at during long session. If it wasn't for this, this game deserves more than 5 stars

Alright, time for a full review update again. Man, this game went from a rough start, to being alright, to being absolutely incredible so fast. The animations on all of the new characters are just absolutely incredible and shows a real love from the developers. Every aspect of the game feels so polished and clean and honestly, this game has finally surpassed Genshin Impact in my opinion. Great job Kuro! Keep it up!

I don't know what to describe 2.7, it's just too good, it was worth staying since the game's lunch and that one scene iykyk, it made me feel something while watching specially when a soundtrack made a comeback lol, anyways yeah this game isn't for low end devices because honestly, the quality of WuWa is next level for a mobile game and I also want to mention the English VAs it's so good, the threnodian's va did a good job at the last scene of 2.7, the chills! now can't wait for the next region!

Absolutely love the game. The game just keeps getting better. That being said. I absolutely, positively , and resolutely hate, hate, hate and hate......time limits. grrrrrrrrrrr. If I wanna take my level 1 character with their level 1 weapons and spend 5 days beating on a boss i should absolutely be able to. I'm sick of wasting my time due to your time limits. fire whoever it is that works there that thinks time limits are fun. lol. Time limits throw out the skill part of the game

It is great, but there are some that i dislike: the lagginess in the game is needing adjustment, like my device is avg for the game but i encounter alot of lagginess even until i clear the cache and other necessary things for making it smoothly. Then the bug that make me go down to the down part of the world after the end of story or teleport. That is by far that i dislike and very bothering but others seems good 👍. I like it

This game deserves 5 stars but I gave it 4 stars because I still see some issues regarding the graphics that needs improvement. The blobfly despite turning the resolution in highest and all graphics to highest i still can't see them. I think the problem is how the game renders, only the shadows of blobfly can be seen. Then in main quest story, I encountered the same in the latest story it's bug on the cut scene it's like I'm in roblox the characters are clear but the background isn't.

this game is best of all time. the mechanism and battle style is very impressive and wonderful. all places are very photo- realistic and stunning!!! but if the game developers put a cyberpunk type city in the map, it would be more fantastic. their are several cities i know but they didn't too big and didn't feel cyberpunk type. soo please add a cyberpunk type city 🙏🙏🙏🥺🥺

i need to change my review AGAIN since this is just ridiculous, the character models are fine now but the NPC models are still poorly rendered in, but now the main problem is the poor optimization, this only started when i updated the app to 2.4, before 2.4 the optimization is already fine, idk what the hell happened in 2.4, we are UPDATING not DOWNGRADING the game is fun, but what's the point of the fun if the app is not OPTIMIZED (can't even move in Ragunna because of this -_-)

Bought a new phone last month, the game runs fine and at a decent frame rate back then, now after the update it doesn't, i feel like I'm using my old phone again, tried lowering my settings but it's still worse than before.

The experience in this game is totally mind-blowing and heart touching. I used to quit it when I was a 1.0 player because of storage issues. But guess that's not really my problem now as I can play it freely on my phone. Although I've got some splendid journeys inside this game however I would like to state some issues. 1. The gameplay is kinda laggy even though I already in a strong wifi area. 2. My game keeps on crashing after a few minutes of gameplay.

I mostly skip stories when playing gacha games but this game made it absolutely impossible to do so, you'll just love it so much that you can't bring yourself to do it. From storyline, character design, battle mechanics, and the world itself is peak. Just hoping for some of the maps to be optimized cause I can play Huanglong up to Rinascita with no stutter or frame drops but moving forward I do get some issues. Great game nonetheless

I love that the developers keep improving the game and make the experience better everyday. Next, I think it's important to allow us to delete progress on certain server only without deleting the whole account. It will help a lot in reducing the number of dummy accounts creation. On top of that, thanks devs for always listening. Keep cooking!

i love hack and slash games and this one is no exception if you are looking for boss fight. i'm only pass the shorekeeper arc and the story is still long way to go and i think the best way to play is to just chill and relax. the game has alot to offer and it is satisfying to slowly build your characters. the graphics is just beautiful and the characters design and battle mechanics is amazing. the only problem is it can be a bit overwhelm with stuffs to do and the story kinda mindblowing.

disappointing so far. Updates aren't implemented, what happened to the experience from before? The lags are constant and the graphics are too high, forcing you to buy an high end phone. I just want to enjoy the game, the experience is no longer enjoyable due to this lagging and extreme requirements for smoother gameplay. Find a solution for players like me Kuro, some of us dont have enough money for device upgrade.

Best gacha RPG game ever played. The story and the Lore is on the Next level. This was the first game i ever cried in Aemeth and Denia quest. The combat is Best. Everthing is lore accurate. Character design are so much good. But the reason i am leaving with 3 Star is the poor optimization. I played more game then you ever think, ther are some game which have more realistic graphic and can be played with my device perfectly. Wuwa is also good but sptimont😵, Roya frostland😵 optimization 😵

Updated 6th July, as im progressing, the main story is getting enjoyable, and when the dialog is actually discussing the story its ok, I find the extra options of choice lead nowhere or pointless small talk. Why does rover talk sometimes but hardly ever? (original rating 2 stars The dialog is so boring and repetitive. Game design and mechanics are great and the world is beautiful, the story... I only play an hour or two but the dialog so boring.)

I'm enjoying the game so far as a new player, especially the world exploration. The fact that you can just fly around the map and sprint on walls makes exploration smoother and easier. I was able to get 20k astrites in my first two weeks mainly from exploration with the use of an interactive map. One thing I would suggest in the game is increasing the amount of markers you can put in the map and adding a button that lets you add a marker on your exact location without having to tap on the screen

The best game I've ever played so far! There's journey where you go and experience it, there's emotional story that really hits the spot! I've really enjoyed it so much! but alas, My phone can't hold it anymore, and I don't have any budget to buy new one. it's a great journey to experience, but this is where I have to say goodbye to the game. "May Your Journey, Be Shining like a Bright Star!"

Sadly, Denia is not enough to save this game. This game is probably THE most money grabbing gacha game out there, and I mean it. I completely everything basically in the maps, that you can do free to play, and after that, it becomes literally impossible to progress any further unless I have god tier luck which is just... Dude. I would not recommend WuWa, despite how good it looks visually and it having high quality, it just does it wrong. It doesn't respect the player.

It could be a very good game but in my case it was all ruined by some kind of bug that got me completely stuck on a story quest (can't complete it, can't leave it and can't play any other quest either, very annoying). I wrote to support, they told me they were checking it but afterward I did not receive any other reply. A few days later I noticed the issue was labeled as "resolved", but nothing has changed for me. Finally run out of patience, I'll just have to play some other game

"Wuthering Waves is absolutely amazing. The story is incredible and keeps you hooked from start to finish. The graphics are stunning, with beautiful environments and smooth character animations. If you're looking for a game with a great story, amazing combat, and top-tier visuals, this is definitely a must-play. Highly recommended!"

EDIT: This is getting soo annoying. This new update was the first time I had the most crashes. I was not even in startorch and yet, I crashed?! I was in whiwa, and it was so laggy in there too now. I never had as much lag nor crashes back then as much as now! I am so so close to deleting this game because what's even the point of having so much high quality details when it's so unplayable?! It just gets on my nerves that I can barely move in an area or do proper combat.

The game quality has been increasing exponential since version 2.5; there's no denying it. However, the game still lacks optimization. Startoch Academy is way way too heavy, even on PCs! the RAM usage for mobile is crazy too, where 8gb of ram is almost not enough for the game. When I'm on the 3.0 maps, my RAM is always on the limit with medium to low graphics, this is just insane. Please work on optimizations for future versions, this is the main complaint for the mobile version.

I hate the new racing event. I either keep loosing or just don't finish the race at all! Even with the new joystick, I still couldn't finish the race without the obstacles or the shaky movements made by the motorbike. Second, there's this bug that makes the player's screen freeze when using the motorbike in mobile. I hate it when it freezes mid race. I cannot rotate the screen to see where I'm going.

This game is really good, It's very F2P friendly and is very generous with the rewards, the combat is very fun and easy to learn while still requiring some skill, the map is beautiful and the scenery is gorgeous, and the exploration is very fun and rewarding, as for the story, at the very beginning within act 1–5 of Huanglong, it was mediocre at best, very boring and didn't catch my interest, however, after act 6, especially after Abby's introduction, the story got so much better

Good combat; amazing visuals, story, music and storytelling; and character design. Game can feel really tedious for the first week, but once the story and combat picks up it hooks you into an emotional roller coaster ride. For new players, the game can be enjoyed casually or hardcore. Another thing is that the game primarily caters towards the male player base in regards to fan service, but despite that you will find that most of the male characters are well written and designed. Give it a shot!

This is my top 1 gacha game, and I love the graphics, the combat styles for each character, the character designs, the story is also one of a kind. But my problem is that it's hard to farm astrites, especially when the banners are shorter duration, of course, kuro is very generous and give out alot of astrites, but when I try to farm on my own for an upcoming banner, it gets super tiring since I've completed most of the quests and explored alot of the map.

I've been playing Wuthering Waves since the beginning, and I still remember how stiff the storytelling felt at first, along with the many bugs that made the game almost unplayable for some players and me. But in just two years, the game has improved a lot in terms of combat, optimization, storytelling, rewards, and overall quality. Keep up the good work, Kuro Games. (Please add more male characters 😔)

i love the story of this game! i love the characters and how connected the main character is to them. it's so easy to farm pulls as well, there has not been a patch so far where I would not have been able to get a 5star with their weapon. I wish they would rerun characters that haven't been ran in a while compared to the same ones over and over, but that doesn't upset me too much. I've seen people complain about pull count, but ensure you're exploring everything, questing, and doing your events!

One of the most beautiful and breathe taking games I've ever played. I love the combat and the design of the characters. But I've always had a problem with Startorch Academy. It always lags a lot when I do quests or explore there. I have no problems with other places like Septimont and Rinascita. I'm already at the lowest graphics but it still lags like crazy. I hope next patch you guys fix the optimization for mobile/tablet users. Thank you!

I loved the game. The stories, the characters. It ran smoothly back then, even with my somewhat potato phone...but now, updates after updates have taken a toll on my phone. The crashes became more frequent. I couldn't even play for more than 15 minutes, without it crashing mid battle or mid exploration. I could play this game on my pc but the reason why I won't is simple, i loved the feeling of playing this excellent game on mobile. I can play it anywhere, anytime. But now, I've lost that.

The game feels like as if it took genshin and shaped it into something much, MUCH better. It REALLY exceeded my expectations. the atmosphere is mesmerizing, the characters are so expressive, and the gameplay is beyond fun. I do hope, however, that we could get more male characters than one per 6 months. Other than that, I enjoy the game a lot.

It's genuinely the most fun I've had in a gacha game. It hooked me from the start and ,it's so fun to play. The environment, combat, it's all top notch. (I come from a 3 year old genshin account and 2 year ZZZ acount, I've also tried NTE) While the game is occasionally laggy, keep in mind that the devs did all the things in wuwa on UE4, and UE4 isn't exactly optimal. The story gets way better at Jhinshi's quest.

6th review: I really love the innovations and overall improvements in the game. That said, as a mid-range mobile player, frame interpolation alone isn't enough for smooth optimization. It feels like mid-range devices are being neglected compared to PC. Frequent fps drops. I appreciate the game a lot, but I wish mobile received the same level of optimization love as the PC version. Not making the players really NEED high end devices to play the game. Dropping my rating from 5 to 2, sorry.

Hello, not sure if it's because of the recent patch update but when Lahai Roi came, my WuWa keeps on Freezing when I play the 1st tutorial quest "Vehicle Driving Tutorial." Tried to do the quest 3 times, same issue, when I passed the Gold Arc while driving the motorcycle, the game will freeze and I have no choice but to relaunch it. I'm using Poco X6 pro and still have a decent amount of storage. Btw, I'm also using the same device to play CF Legends, and I never encountered lag/freezing issues.

Best gacha game I've ever played! I love this game, especially the quality of life features, its easy to explore, very interesting events and minigames. The lore is amazing and the combat is super engaging, been playing for more than a year and still love it! Edit: Idk why but its crashing alot on my phone and no its not that I have potato phone, I have poco x7 pro with dimensity 8400 (decent gaming chip). Im not sure if the problem is on my end or the game itself, I hope it gets more optimized.

I love this game, and I have no complaints about the characters, story, or etc. I play on my tablet, and my laptop and the lag on my laptop has always been horrible to the point that I could barely play, but it always ran smoothly on my tablet up until version 3.0. Now, on mobile, the game's lag is horrible, even with low settings, and it crashes every 5 minutes. I reinstalled, and now the game isn't letting me download 34 GB of resources even though I have 94 GB available.

I've been playing this game for 6 months on a daily basis. this game is a masterpiece. it may start slow (1.0-2.0) with the story and the characters may feel underwhelming, but after that it will be the best game you can put your hands on. Gameplay/Combat is unique between character, the story is absolute cinema and the visuals and voice acting will make you cry. the only bad side is the optimization, we can hope they'll make a miracle and make it run smooth and not melt your hands. Poco F7

Ive played this game from my friends phone and i want it so bad. The combat, story, and the characters are super good. Overall, its peak ✋🤚. But my current phone storage is making it harder to download resources even if i have 32gb left from my 64gb total device. Its really heavy and im finding ways to nake a solution and to finally play it with my own phone since i dont have the money to buy a good device. :)

An amazing open-world RPG with beautiful visuals, incredible music, and some of the most enjoyable combat on mobile. The characters are well-designed, exploration feels rewarding, and the developers continue to improve the game. Definitely one of the best games I've played. Keep up the great work!

5/31/24: Great game. Just need to fix bugs (camera goes all over the place and i cant see enemy. Also the "echo" sometimes teleport somewhere random. And the movement is "slippery" that I can't get my character where i want it to be. 7/2/26: Game needs A LOT of optimization, it was barely playable to play on midrange phone(I use Vivo v30 that uses snapdragon 7 gen 3, it is now NOT playable AT ALL. Pls Kuro games... Fix your game.

Game is great, but the events are just badly made. that Luuk card game can go to hell, and any co-op mini games are just bad on mobile. The racing event for example pc player can just press W and left click before the race starts, while mobile have to wait for the buttons to appear. Mobile players get shafted. Edit: Kuro needs to learn how to make a good racing map the 2nd one is just trash. Edit2: can't believe I'm about to uninstall due to an event.

The game has so much potential and I like playing it. but the moment the Lahai-Roi was released, my device kept crashing especially in the Startorch Academy Area. There were no crashing issues when I'm in Huanglong or Rinascita. I hope the devs will fix this issue allowing the mobile players to keep playing and would enjoy it.

So far after playing WuWa for a year, this game is overall good but there's a setting that needs to be changed. Crowd density. The highest I could go for in mobile is only 'high', no more higher than that and 'ultra high' for PC respectively. Sometimes I couldn't see any NPCs or TDs from afar and it makes Jinzhou look like a ghost town. I won't be back until this is fixed. So, I'm hoping for KURO GAMES to add 'ultra high' into the crowd density setting for mobile. 😭

Ive been playing the game since release and it had a LOT of bugs(which is normal for a game release)but when bugs did impact my gameplay, there was always some kind of viable compensation for the bug and it got fixed up during patching. as most games should, this one got way better over time with way better story telling and characters, I was very impressed. my only issue is the lag, though that might just be me because I use a mobile device, and for that, I give wuthering waves 5 stars.

Performance keeps getting worse with every update, when I have never struggled to run the game before 2.8. They also STILL have not fixed Denia's second liberation bugging the screen and freezing the game, an issue since 3.4 released, making Denia unplayable. HP inflation in the endgame is getting so ridiculous that Galbrena, a character from 2.7, in her strongest team, mono-fusion, cannot even clear the first floor of the hazard tower in Tower of Adversity now. Automated response incoming.

This is a phenomenal game with some of the most stunning visuals I've ever seen. Kuro puts so much love and care into every detail, is receptive to player feedback, and is constantly improving. If you love combat and story-driven games, Wuthering Waves is absolutely worth a shot. I feel like they deserves a bigger chance than any other company out there.

After updating to Version 3.1, my Snapdragon 8 Gen 1 device starts heating up within 5 minutes, even on the loading screen before entering the game. Versions 1.0–2.8 ran normally with no overheating issues. The problem only started in Version 3.1. The excessive heat makes me concerned about my phone's battery and hardware. If this issue is not addressed, I may have to quit the game to avoid potential damage to my device.

I was hoping this update would fix the problems from the previous patch, but it seems to only make things worse... Horrid latency (always over 120ms, and sometimes it spikes to over 500ms), constant crashes, frame rate drops... sometimes the game crashes just from opening the menu! Stop optimizing the grass and actually improve performance! I love the game, but it seems like they want me to stop playing it with every update!

Wuwa will get dropped by most people because say you have an hour break at work, it will only run on mobile for about 5 minutes and will freeze when you interact with the environment or go into a menu screen, it will lag in each and every open world fight, you will walk and it'll stop working on you. PS5 is better but it still freezes, lags and closes too much to become the game you enjoy playing. Beautiful game and mechanics but Kuro is out of their mind and lazy for not fixing optimization.

Solid game including the characters, gameplay and the plot. though hopefully, please hopefully Kuro you add a transfer button where you can transfer your save acc into different servers cause many people tend to choose a server then grind in that server without realizing that there would always be lag within that server especially if you're not in one of the countries built for that region that includes me and other players. it'll be hard to just start a new if you're one of the early players.

Returning player. Optimisation issue is still here, even more prominent in the latest quest. Tends to Lag, and crash, despite my phone being a massive upgrade than when I started in 2024. Regardless, it is a good game, if you could run it. The combat is as fun (tho so confusing w many roles for beginners. take your time). The banner is, meh. old characters tend to not make banner appearance anymore, easily forgotten. Too many 5 stars character, so making a decent team early game is....eh.

First and foremost, the game itself is so good. It's my first time playing such a quality and performances game. The concern thing is that, it haven't fully optimized yet for a low/mid range budget. So I hope they fix that too in the near future because I do really want to keep playing the game. It's so fun to play and a little addicted to it haha. Anyways keep up the momentum of the game. Thank you

Wuthering Waves is an incredible open-world action RPG with stunning visuals, smooth and satisfying combat, and an immersive world full of exploration. The fast-paced gameplay, unique characters, and engaging story keep every moment exciting. The soundtrack and graphics create a beautiful atmosphere, making the experience even more enjoyable. I definitely think it would be easier to play with controllers or keyboard. It can be a bit annoying managing the screen control pad as well as continuously setting off some abilities without meaning to. The game isn't easy either but soooooo rewarding.

It's a really great game, to be honest. But recently after the 1.1 update, it got so laggy and would crash every 5 minute. It's frustrating that I keep logging back in only to be kicked out of the game again. It might be my device, but I have enough storage for it, even more than enough. Please fix this issue, I miss playing the game when it runs smooth and just fine.

The game is great! The storyline, and the movements when you fight with an enemy is AWESOME. Though, the game has some bugs on phone. Whenever there's a cutscene, it glitches. I lagged so hard that I can't even walk to the game. And the graphics is so blurry, ain't even good. The game is still new though. But I hoping that it will be fixed soon.

I love the designs in this game. They are all so beautiful and I love the combat style, but I literally can't even experience it properly because of the LAG. it's not the matter of my storage, device or my internet, a few of my friends have experienced the same thing too. It's super laggy and my device overheats so much.(Both mobile/PC). I can't even fight properly without the scenes of the ultimate glitching everytime, I really like this game so I hope this issue gets fixed soon.

I'll be honest; I've been playing the game since the day it came out. Yes, it is a fact that there were various graphics and optimization problems before 1.1. But Kuro Games is generous towards its audience, just like its other games. Frankly, the mechanics in the game are among the important elements that make the game enjoyable. And I can clearly say that it is very good in various aspects such as in-game mechanics, NPC designs (and so on). The only problem is that in-game character/weapon dev
Phenomenal impeccable story... worth playing even after years of not playing wuwa

honestly, I play on PC mainly, so take me with that grain I like this game. It has its flaws but I think it's something that can be polished to be something wonderful. The combat is fast and fun and the world is great to poke around. The game does not run well. This is the biggest problem. It freezes and there's glitches in dialouge. I'm playing in English because the dialouge won't all display! It makes me frustrated cause I like the game. I have hope.

The game was fantastic and has potential to be one of the most famous RPG games. Just a problem on my device is I can't run properly the game and some also experiences this issue that in the middle of a quest, the game crash and kicks us out of them game so we have to restart on that part of the game. Hopefully the devs will fix this, overall it is an amazing game!

Honestly, such an amazing game, for the size of how much storage it takes up, it's able to bring a lot out of it. For the mobile version I'd say is the best because the PC version requires a pretty decent computer to run, while most modern $200+ can run this. Aside from that thought, it's an amazing game, the music the story line, and although the some voices and music aren't the best, it still fits well with the game.

I love the character designs, the quests and the whole open world concept. The game does lag a bit though but after going to the settings and dropping the in-game resolution, it runs smoothly. I can play the game for hours and it works great. I'm in level 29 with no major issues. My only complaint is that the in-game camera does not work, it won't save my pictures eventhough I granted permission on my phone settings. I also can't screen record, it crashes my recording app.

Wuthering Waves has been pretty good this past 4 months. The story has improved, the voice acting has leveled up, and the quality of life features just keeps getting better and better. With 1.3, I can already see the improvement with the cutscenes, the delivery, the storytelling, the music, etc. It was absolute cinema. The optimization issues has been nonexistent as of this moment. I can play the game just fine on my laptop and on my pc.

I enjoyed the game but had to uninstall since it kept kicking me put whenever I would initiate battle with overworld enemies. But, even at the lowest quality, the game is still beautiful. I like the parkour mechanics when it comes to climbing. The gliding is pretty well done. I like that characters do certain things when in battle when you switch to them. Echos are amazing! I love that concept! Update: it won't even let me play the game I can log in for like a minute before it kicks me out.

No issue on my end, the worst i had was one crash after a few hours, otherwise, no visual/lags/heating issue so seems like it's dependent on your device as to wether or not you'll have a good experience or not. Otherwise the game is pretty nice, ppl complain about the story but i kinda enjoy it here, combat is very satisfying, the visuals are pretty and the sounds/music are nice to hear. Give it a go, it may be for you.

It's optimized but still need some reworks. First of all, this game is great, especially in combat. I enjoyed pretty much in combat, much like when I played PGR. The downsides are; first, the story. It's pretty bad plot right at the beginning, in addition the quality of translation and English VA, I have to say, they're terrible. Second, regarding the echo exp materials, tuners, and the tacet field rewards. It was too unbalanced. I want to say more, but I'll stop here due to the word limit.

I believe this game has a lot of potential, however it was not ready for release yet. It's full of bugs, a lot of people can't even open it, the graphics look bad on mobile on any settings, the game lags a lot, controls are awkward, voice lines cut off and there's translation errors. I think this will be a great game eventually, after many very necessary optimizations, but right now it's a mess, unfortunately.

Honestly, this game has a whole lot of potential, it only just got released. There are still lagging and bugs but I really don't have a bad experience compared to other players. Fortunately, my phone was compatible with it. On the day of the release, it was really laggy and the ping spikes were irritating especially when combating with mobs. However, after the hotfixing, it became much better.

Very good game! Excellent story, characters, and game play! I was able to get two free five star Character after 1-2 days, which helps a lot! Also, this game has excellent cut scenes and a "skip" button, which allows you to skip scenes and dialog, Good game! But one thing that happened to me is that some cut scene would be skipped even though I didn't press the "skip" button. This caused me to miss the first cut scene (upside-down sea) and the last story quest cut scene, too :(

It's a very good game, I really like the combat mechanics, wall running instead climbing, the animations are funny, can run without consuming energy except if there's enemy around, character's design is beautiful, I don't mind it if it's laggy or not. All I care is about enjoying the game, I really don't see it as a bad game. So please keep up the good work!

Crashes every 10 minutes with my phone. Loading back takes more than 2 minutes of waiting. Roaming around lags literally every 0.1 seconds. Game runs slower than normal. By the way, I'm using the LOWEST possible settings in terms of graphics. Though really it's just due to my phone. The game is incredible. One of my favorites. Keep at it Kuro!!! (Seriously I love the game)

The game is still crashing after just a few minutes of play, and it got worse overtime, at least from my experience. My phone can handle a similar game just fine even if it's not on the highest graphics available. I'm not sure if it can be fixed, but please do consider stopping the constant crashes and the strange, extremely fast camera motion that makes me feel rather dizzy. Thank you for your time, and I'll still try to support your game.

The combat is engaging, fluid, and very rewarding. There is a lot of room for skill expression, and every character feels unique. The open world is STUNNING; I could not stop taking screenshots while I ran around. The puzzles are really fun and do not feel repetitive. The developers are simply amazing. Every issue the game had was quickly addressed and compensated for. They put in so much attention to detail and clearly prioritize their players' feedback and what they want. Thank you Kuro! 😊

I really appreciate how the dev actually listen to player's complaints. The game has so many potentials. I kinda has an issue that makes me feel a bit uncomfortable when doing combat. The mechanic's great, but many times the auto target when I attack the nearest enemy, it won't focuse on that enemy. Instead It'll go to the enemy behind the one that actually right in front of character's face, or sometimes it just go to the one behind the character or left/right. I hope it can be optimized :)

The game is very fun and good. There's just a few things that need polishing. Firstly, the voice acting direction needs some improvements. Some scenes the characters' voices lacked emotion or sounded like they were reading of a script (yangyang). Secondly, for me, the story feels a little fast paced and it drops random dialogue that isn't related to the story. Lastly, there a few bugs and inconsistencies like dialogue not following the text and spelling errors in some of the overworld/mainquests

Nice game. But please fix the problem of lag! My device can't even update the game. Every single time when I try, whole screen just blacks out. Taking many tries in order to play. Once finally in, holy hell it is SO laggy! Had to set graphics at lowest only for it to lag too. When multiplayer, it lags even more. The combat is absolute chef kiss though and story is in the range of okay to good. The voice acting is troublesome, characters sounds like they just woke up in ENG dub. Please listen!

Gap between cutscene resolution Vs normal game mode resolution on my phone is too much 🤣 if you want to really enjoy this game better to have phone with a high specs or computer. I am not really hooked on the storyline yet because of the resolution, but female characters in this game look gorgeous , so that's a plus. However colored scheme is sometimes off so that is a minus point. I liked the game play it is quite different from what I am used to. I see lots of potential in this game~ so yeah.

hey there! I downloaded game only yesterday, so no pre-downloaded bonuses were available. and still, I would like to point that the game is sort of a fresh air in open-world RPGs. combat system just got me on my knees, the ability to dodge makes battles really fun! with my not gaming phone I haven't experienced any technical issues and the game is optimized in a great way. the story is unclear but captivating, especially the idea of post-apocalyptic world. have fun playing too!

I am loving the game so far! Tho, a lot if improvements to work on still but I trust the devs that they will work on it. The game has a lot of potential. One of its strongest asset is the combat and echo mechanics. Some of the players do not like the muted colors but I personally love it. Just one minor feedback - BGM suddenly stops after a few mins in the game. I noticed that this bug started happening after the latest update. Hoping it will get fixed soon. No troubleshooting works so far.

It's a good game. First of all, I like that it's not as laggy as I expected since my phone isn't that good, even at max graphics It also doesn't heat my phone. But the connectivity sometimes falls short as I keep reconnecting sometimes. The game overall is like genshin but more refined. The combat system is also great since you can evade enemy attacks. I like the concept of echoes, it's intriguing. But It's kinda disappointing that only 1 code works even though I played right after the release.

Playing for first chapter. Great open world game, great storyline, great movement, great gameplay, nice music and nice view. So far, everything is good except when in conversation, when I click one by one its fine but in autoplay mode, the story doesn't finish to the end and keep cutting off. The voice and sentence after several conversation, its like skipping the voice and text.

Amazing gameplay, and the quests are so fun. Not to mention, the skip button does wonders on the side quests. As long as you got a good device that can run it. Its honest so much fun. (Theres so much content so far, and the exploration is fun. Though I feel like theres some things they could fix, such as making it much easier to locate things that are underground). As a mobile player, whos downloaded genshin, honkai starrail. I would say this game falls into the same category if not gameplay.

This game has potential to be good, but it's just poorly optimized and full of bugs. The game is playable for me, but oh boy, sometimes it's so irritating. The monsters refresh unreasonably, the item doesn't spawn where it is supposed to, the game feels unfinished, the animation looks strange, etc. I think the game can still be saved somehow. That's why I will stay until the devs decide to give up.

Graphics 5/5: stunning graphics with detailed environments, impressive character models, and fluid animations that make the game visually captivating. Combat 5/5: dynamic and engaging, offering a variety of skills and strategies. Story 2/5: basic and lacks depth, with one-dimensional characters and a predictable plot. Gacha 1/5 : major drawback, with low odds, close to no pity system and a pay-to-win feel. It detracts significantly from the overall enjoyment of the game.

Rewards and combat are great. Characters are nice but I think they have too much accessories/overdesigned. Music is meh. Phone performance, be it on low-end mid-range or high-end is bad. Especially the first few days, really unplayable. The story is okay at best. Cinematics are great. Overall, flaws and issues included, decent game on phone if you can tolerate ping issues, stuttering, fps drops and heating. We'll see in 1.1 if anything changes.

For what I'm experiencing, smooth gameplay, going great at the story, inlove with the characters, the scenery is jaw dropping, and overall a game that I will be spending a lot of time on!! From my other device it was quite glitchy, and I've noticed this happened with many other players too, but I still have my hopes for this game and is fully aware that it has only released recently based on my timeline. Thank you!!

When I go on,it takes about 2-5 minutes to download which is fine,I've waited longer for other games...but once done,I would try to start the game but it'll crash and kick me out over and over again.i uninstalled multiple times and I even reset my phone... I've seen the graphics and it's so amazing! I really wanna try this game. I've gotten it on my laptop but SO much went wrong. Super laggy. I hope the issue can be fixed cuz I'm seeing that its happening to many people... 😭

Got potential, I would like to play more if my device allows it but sadly can't. I like the characters and the promo video of the game is cool. Negatives: It kinda throws you into the wild without explanations on what and how to do after the tutorial stage ends! Graphic is jumbled up between good and bad while playing (environment and event CG) which is bad. Last, (maybe just coincidence) but after playing and uninstalled this game somehow my other games also have trouble and crash a lot! [sad]

I was so excited to play this game when it first came out. Unfortunately, I had trouble in gameplay with cutscenes and gameplay freezing, as well as lag. I immediately uninstalled it. The quality of the game wasn't up to the standards which I've been seeing all over, as I couldn't see the world or characters quite clearly whether I set it to the highest setting or not. Eventually I realised it wasn't the Developers but the GPU for my phone, . I still opt to play this game in the future someday.

1. I really love the game itself: gameplay, the world, the graphics, etc. 2. It would be nice if the music (in the overworld and boss fights) are like PGR which is very good. 3. I am playing in mobile and I hope the sensitivity bug will be fixed P.S. - this one will be a little bit selfish of mine, but if possible, it would be great to have an option for mobile players to use a mouse and keyboard controls to ease our gaming experience. Especially if our device is strong enough to handle it.

This game is incredible! The story, the characters, and the graphics are all phenomenal! Too bad it's unplayable on mobile. 🥲 It overheats my tablet even though all my graphic settings are at the lowest quality, and I have shadows off the game, it just won't run properly. I've checked my internet and memory, but those aren't the problem, either. I don't have a PC, so I guess I'll just have to wait for the console release, which is too bad cause I really wanna keep playing! 🙏🙏🙏

The gameplay and character design are amazing, and I love the funcionality as well. However, I have run into a problem with even being able to play. Every time the game loads in, I get to play for maybe a minute or two before it crashes and closes out. I've tried playing on wifi and on mobile service, neither one worked. I just hope this issue can be resolved soon, I really enjoyed playing!

Amazing visuals, combat, and characters. I've played a lot of gacha games but this one is most definitely one of the best ones I've had the pleasure of experiencing. A big problem I have with 3d models games is that the 3d models normally look ugly. But for this game certainly not! Their 3d models the best ive seen ever! They are almost equal to the 2d drawings! It's insane! I would play this game if you haven't, but recommend to do so on computer/PC. game looks good on phone as well though

Absolutely phenomenal. This is my first time picking up a game on the day of its release, and I have never once regretted getting this thing. The lore, story, characters, exploration, interactions, music, the ANIMATION--- practically everything is amazing!! My main issue was about the English voice actors/actress' voice direction, but as of the latest update, I can see well that the Female Rover's voice has been upgraded! I'm so happy for her.

After the patch, And a little adjustments with the settings, my game now runs smoothly! Thank you Kuro, For always working hard on our behalf. I hope this game succeeds. So far, The game's story line is interesting, and fun. Especially the mini games. And how the combat style are unique! I've been waiting on the release, and was not disappointed.

very well, game design. There are a few bugs, but what game doesn't have them. overall, it is kind of like genshin impact, but with a more mature style than cartoonist style. There is an added echo assist for combat that offers stats and abilities. Futuristic idea puzzles and an intriguing story line, right now, there is many directions they could take this game. It's worth checking out.

It's an extremely fun game! I enjoy the story, art style, and gameplay a ton. The Devs are very fast at repairing bugs and seem to listen to the community. The only issue is the English voice cast. I like the voices, but the delivery is often lackluster (minus Scar, his voice is amazing!!) There are some similarities to other games, but it still feels unique!

So I just downloaded the game and its great soo farr buttt...the crashing is my number one problem. I play on my phone and pc and both aren't very good since the second it takes 1 minute to long to load it crashes out the game, or even when I try to log in; its so stressing for no reason😞. But, I would give it 5 stars if the performance was better but 3 stars is all in all for the whole game concept and designs!! And I would be glad to experience the new performance later on in the game!😚😚🙏

The combat is VERY FUN!!! I got addicted to combat that i forgot to do quests lol. I encountered some frame drops or lag issues from the first day of release but it's fixed now! Hopefully y'all can optimize it even more for the sake of low end device users. Also i want to mention that some voicelines in and out of the story, and cutscenes are very weird. But the story itself is pretty interesting!

So far, so good. I love the theme, and it's very refreshing for me. I would continue playing since the combat style— awesome~ The story quests are interesting enough for me not to skip even some side quests. The mini-games and puzzles in activities, although some of them make me dizzy, still make me want to deal with them. Lastly, the characters are good in their own way, and the voices of some NPCs are hilarious. Thank you for always hearing our suggestions ❤️

Wuthering waves is a great game with a nice combat, I really do love playing this game but there are several issues happening around the game. I can't stay or play properly since it was crashing and crashing, no matter how I reinstall or add a file, I can't last up to 10 minutes or lower. My storage is big with a used up of 28 percent from 100 percent. my phone is decent and work very well on other types of games from hoyoverse and others. I really do hope the developers can fix the problem.

The game is great. While there were initial bugs and a few things that lags, the game still proceeds beautifully. It's a good open world with great graphics and mechanics. Good character designs and gacha rates are decent. Optimizing and building a character is pretty decent and challenging but fun anyway. The storyline is good, but it gets confusing at the start as it drops unfamiliar details. Voices are fine and ok. Overall, it's a great game. Highly Recommendable!

Amazing game with great combat mechanics, memorable missions, characters and echo system. I really like wuwa and I want to see more and immerse myself in this new world. My problem is that I've finished everything and now I'm left with puzzles and chest. Where's our companion quest? We should get 3 or 4 like a character should deserve at least that much

I played the game on PC and did encounter some graphics issues before, but I did not complain, given that they did try their best to improve the game, so I waited. Now, I do not experience any lag or graphics issues. If anyone wants to play, they should not rush the game. It is best to enjoy the main story because it is good and the cut scene was amazing. Also, there will be an upcoming free five-star character.

The best part of this game would be the customer service and rewards, the time and effort placed in the satisfaction of players. However, story wise, it's still a bit jaded with so many terminology and lore being thrown at you once you awaken. Also, the main quest being locked behind Union levels is annoying, and some english voice lines feel very hollow and emotionless as they don't match the character expressions and actions. Overall, it was a very solid launch besides a few bugs <3

It's an amazing game, but here's a quality of life suggestion, whenever we're tracking something, like a store or a waypoint, make it show up where it is on our hud, just like the missions. Other than that, the combat is perfect and feels smooth, the story is really good, and the characters' show so much emotion, which is rare to come by these days.

The game experience is great! The feature of being able to block/parry/dodge attacks is exceptional, it creates a unique experience for playing an open-world game. Overall the story is interesting, waiting for more content about the lore; the SKIP Button is really USEFUL, The ability to skip dialogues is such a time saver if you're just completing side quests that don't need much attention, saves a lot of time & an easier completion of the task. I love the game. Hoping for a PS5 platform soon :)

The quality, music, and scenery are amazing, despite being laggy. The game control is a lil complicated that what I'm used to, so I wanted to play on pc. However, everytime I tried to launch the game, it crashed. I tried to reach out to the customer support but I guess because this is a newly launched game they have not replied to me since I sent it in :(

The game itself isn't bad. The combat is snappy and satisfying, the character design is nice, and the story shows some promise. However, the crashing and poor optimization are far too outrageous. There isn't any consistency in how or when the game crashes. It can be the only game on your phone, you can have good internet or bad, you can max out the settings or run them on the lowest. None of it really matters. Sometimes, you play for an hour. Other times, you struggle to get 2 minutes in.

Giving this game 4-stars only because the buttons are so small, I always end up misclicking. Everything else is beautiful about this game, hope we are given a setting to adjust the controls soon. Edit: The controls are already given settings to adiust, and the gameplay's smoother than the last time. However, there's still a bit of lag, but not to the extent of being a nuisance. It's already worth it to play. Keep up the good work, Kuro!

The game was very cool and all, Let me be completely honest, and I need yall to see this ASAP. Whenever I'm just 2 in a half minutes into the game, it's starts lagging, and somehow, I can't seem to swipe up and find my home button to exit the game. I just have to wait to pop up, except the game randomly crashes and auto exits me. I did everything to prevent the game from lagging or crashing, but none of it really works. I was already on low graphics, but it's still crashing like... why???

4* as the game at its core is a solid package. The game is easy enough that you don't have to be a god gamer to partake in the action gameplay. On the other hand, there is also challenging content for those who enjoy harder battles. There are tons of activities to do in the open world. However, the game has a number of flaws to it as well. I'd mark it a 3* or 2* if there wasn't an option to change the voiceovers from English to any other language.

the release day was not that great but I see the developers fixing the bugs, laggy gameplay, and other stuff, and they did a great job fixing it. im hook in this game for days (main reason, bcs of the game style) now and happy with the compensation we've been getting for the technical issues. but I've noticed that we can't save the pics in the game, so I hope you'll notice this issue and fix it, that's all, keep up the good work kuro!

I really like the combat and fight in this game, the story of the game is also good, but in my opinion the background music is still lacking, Epic scenes that should be able to give me goosebumps actually feel less cool because the music isn't enough... I hope that in the future this game can continue to improve, I will really look forward to that time, when this game develops and becomes as big as other games.

Seems really fun, just not made for mobile. It's more than 10 gigs, and tries to use all 10 every time you open the app. I don't even think the first Guide Wars was 2 gigs total. The art is great, gameplay seems fun when it works, it's too bad I didn't make it past the cliffs 10 minutes in. Graphics could be cut by 40% and the cartoon stories toned down to make this game bareable. It's playable on PC, but this review is for mobile. It gets an extra star for not being Auto. 3.2 of 5.

the game is amazing. everything is good, the combat, the sceneries, the characters, the animations, the lore. but i've been a day 1 player and until now i'm still experiencing lags and uncontrollable camera angling and it makes me so dizzy that it discourages me to play everyday. don't get me wrong, i enjoy the game so much. but the devs need to fix the controls and the lagging soon.

The gameplay is very interesting and fun, the characters are beautiful, and the music is pretty good. It's like a punishing gray raven version of Genshin Impact. However, the reason I am giving three stars is because when I boot up the game, it takes me to a loading screen. After it finishes loading it just freezes. I cannot log in and have only been able to log in a total of three times in the span of three days, and it was only because I cleared the data and downloaded everything again.

I think it is time for me to give a feedback here. By far it is the best game I've ever played, not feeling burdened or repetitive (maybe some but not all) to play just for the sake of playing or clearing the quest. The battle actions and animations, each individuals have different set of moves. Now the new 2.0 Rinasita map, the way they introduced the new place it hits differently! Importantly, the DEVS hears (with proper filter) and they actually delivers! Keep it up!

Pre-registered everything went smoothly, and the graphics are amazing. I found the movement a bit weird, but you get used to it. There are no lag/issues that I have found yet. It runs really smoothly, and unlike other tutorials in different games, this one gives you a very detailed one, and if you still don't understand, you can go back to it, pressing a button on the top right. I have high hopes and will continue to play this beatifull game.

Came into this game as a fan, and I wasn't disappointed. Everything feels good, the combat is crisp and clean. The reason I'm giving this a 4/5 is hopefully temporary. Unfortunately a lot of the game progression is unbalanced and it feels like you use too much stamina (WP) for farming materials that barely drop. However, the echo system is amazing. But the stamina costs need to be revamped if the rewards are this pitiful and I'm at lv 60 for reference (highest level for drops).

I've gotten this game on my pc, phone, and iPad, and it works on none of them. I've had genshin, star rail, etc on all three devices, and they've run just fine. The game seems like so much fun, and I want to play it, but the game is constantly crashing or just freezing on the loading screen. I can't play it for more than a minute or not at all. I am getting fomo seeing other people playing it, and I don't want to miss characters/anything else in the game!!

Game is good so far. Joystick controls are a bit janky and too sensitive (no walking option as far as I know). Some dialogue are a bit awkward. A bit blurry graphics even on medium and high resolution (likely not my device). But overall a really good game. Combat is nice and fluid. Characters are really lively and full of emotions. Story is nice, character building is a bit confusing (probably cause I'm an idiot)

Great everything! Satisfying movement system, combat system, and really unique way to fight using echoes and not just skills. Amazing story line, and I like the way they try their best to use different body types and just not copy n' paste. The skip button for side quests is such a game changer, And for a first release this game looks and feels absolutely satisfying. But one problem that I have is just about the photo album when I try to take a pic, it says I saved it but I cant find it anywher

I have been playing this game since the end of May. My overall experience of this game: - Love the stories. So this game is breathtaking, it's so beautiful and its combat style is very, very based. The combat is so fun in every possible way. Characters design is very beautiful, too, especially the main character and the two new limited characters. There are some amazing mechanics in the game other than combat, too. The gear system is a little bit confusing to me, but it's OK. The story could def get better, but I do know games that improved their story tremendously after years😉. Love this game a lot!

One of the best gacha action RPGs. I've played for a few months and it is constantly improving. Combat is great, really fast paced. Some teams are a bit tricky to control without a controller though. The main character you get for free is very strong. Graphics is incredible albeit a bit on the desaturated side. Looks better with in-game brightness set to minimum. It's rough on weaker phones though. Generous every patch and the daily loop is quick. Some sections of the game will be hard though.

I really like the overall mechanics of the game. I'm using mobile phone to play the game and I'm not sure if I'm the only one experiencing this. I adjust my sensitivity in exploration and boss battles but when it comes to timed racing minigames. Especially when we turn into a bird and pass through hoops while collecting tokens, the sensitivity and the controls can be quite hard to maneuver. I also try to collect the tokens and it does not registered to be collected.

The first time I played this game, I wasn't too impressed, the combat was cool, the exploration was smooth and easy and you can skip content, I only played from time to time, then the new update dropped: 2.0 and I must admit, the improvements are phenomenal, there are still some flaws but overall my experience has been amazing, I haven't stopped playing since the release, the music is beautiful, the scenery is breath taking, and even the story is better, I highly recommend trying it.

I have played this game since launch. although there were some optimization issues during the first month, which was warranted due to a large scale release. It is not perfect by any means, but traversing through the world is delightful. Combat is increasingly interesting and end game content is challenging. Graphics style and overworld design is so cool. Story is lacking in the beginning and ramps up, especially in 1.1. I did not think I would be so addicted to this game, it is really fun.

Meant more for PC, ping is fairly low one mobile, has great graphics, but sometimes lag and slow down during some scenes, but isn't much of a problem. Other than those minor issues, great game. Unique character design, interesting story, well animated, characters display unique personalities, open world game play, game company is VERY quick to fix bugs and glitches.

So far, (after some bug fixes and updates ) this game is doing better. The cutscenes looks a lot like a high production anime series and the environment. Also the character design- it looks the same as the artwork like 😲. Though gaming experience will vary depending on the devices, Wuthering Waves is doing so much to fix the issues. Wuthering Waves forda go!

Wuthering Waves is an absolute blast! The graphics are jaw-dropping, and the soundtrack totally sets the mood. I love exploring the vast world, filled with cool quests and challenges that keep you on your toes. The combat feels fluid and fun, letting you mix things up as you battle. Plus, the characters are super relatable (and beautiful), making the story even more engaging. If you’re into action RPGs, this game is definitely worth checking out. You won’t regret diving into this adventure!

Great game with nice visuals and music. It's nice to explore the game world just by traveling and learning the lore of the world along the way. I like the design of the game characters and NPCs, as well as the combat system where you have to dodge or parry the enemy's attack while adapting to their fighting style. The only small drawback for me is that it's as if everyone trying protects the main character after 1 sec seeing him. Otherwise, I like it, thanks to the developers for their work

I do really like the game, but the issues I face with it makes it almost impossible to enjoy it. The characters look exactly blurry on Android, the lag is so bad that my characters just slide around, the audio sometimes repeats itself or just starts halfway through the sentence. I also find that it crashes very often and it's to the point where I can only play for a few seconds before it just dies on me. I hope theses issues get fixed soon but right now, the game is nearly unplayable.

This game is sick. They nailed the action combat, all the characters (including 4 stars) look and feel really good, the world is fun to explore, and the boss fights are challenging and intense. But there is some lag even with lowest settings on S22 Ultra, and no controller support for mobile. I believe there are fixes planned for these issues, which would make this a 5/5 for me. Update: they added controller support, and the game continues to get better

Even though this game experienced a few shortcomings at launch, most of the issues are already being progressively fixed over time. Their response is so quick, ngl. By the way, the world-building and the environment design are so beautiful. The combat system is quite smooth, especially when perfectly dodging and parrying. It feels so rewarding to be good at this game. Keep it up, I'm always looking forward to what Kuro Games does next.

Best gatcha game I've ever played! The best part is you don't feel the fear of missing out on progress if you are not glued to the game 24/7. You can play the game for 15 minutes a day and won't miss anything. If you miss energy refill it is stored. The game is optimized for less powerful devices. Astonishing graphics and overall user experience. Voice acting is top notch. There is not much of a content yet. I've finished almost everything after 2 months but they are adding new stuff regularly.

The graphics is great, love that the enemies are actually scary. I'm just not a big fan of the story. It feels like a harem anime where everyone is so in love with the main character. It feels too safe that it doesn't leave a deep impression to me, as a player. The story so far is kind of basic and I hope it improves in the future. Also, the info dump of the different in game terms at the beginning is very overwhelming.

I really like the game and I could see a lot of potential in it! But it just gets annoying when my frame just randomly drops and just lags. I have a good device to play with, and I also have a game booster, but it just keeps lagging. And there's also the sensitivity which jst randomly goes up even though I had it lowered. Hopefully it would be fixed soon!

It's a solid game. It's got a pretty good OST. the visuals are amazing and even at low graphics, I still find them captivating, especially the characters, they're all so pretty. I do find the plot quite interesting too. Unfortunately, I can only really play when it's mid-afternoon and midnight when everyone else is asleep. Would definitely still recommend. Just pls chill out with the sensitivity of the camera Kuro games.

It's a good game from what I've seen. It has amazing characters and stories. From what I've played, everything is easy to understand. The only negative is that it's glitchy, it freezes, and it kicks me out at random times. It also, for some reason, has extremely high ping despite me having another game that runs smoothly. That's almost exactly like Wuthering Waves. I understand this is a new game, and that's why I'm leaving this so that hopefully, it gets fixed.

First review: First I like the character designs very unique. But I just want to say on my device(mobile) the camera is a bit shaky when I walk(run) around it's kinda hard for me to move the camera sometimes but that's all I gotta say about the movements, if there's anything to improve that—that would be great! I don't know if anyone is also experiencing this issue the shaky thingy in mobile or even in pc. I just wanted to share that. Maybe the developers can fix it.! But overall thegame isnice!

Kuro Games I gotta say, you created the most interesting and well thought game I have ever played. Starting from the story all the way to the exploration experience. There's still something's that needs to be fix/improve but considering this was just globally released a couple of days ago, it's basically normal. Let me just point out some things that need's some attention; 1. The ping issue, 2. The performance issue, 3. Some bugs. That's pretty much all, regardless I'll still give it a 5 star.

Good story and amazing soundtrack. The graphics are great and very detailed. This may not be too important, but there's a lot of details in NPCs appearance and personality, sometimes. Definitely can see why this game needs a high requirements for device. If you have an average device, maybe there'll be some issues. But the developer put a lot of effort in this game, maybe appreciate it more and keep the complains in costumer service? Please?

Love the game, characters look amazing, as does the scenery. And up to this point I have next to zero issues with the game. Any minor bugs or glitches I have seen I have seen in every other game. The developers have been fantastic in how quickly they respond to addressing issues that have popped up. So I forsee many, many hours going into this games, years in fact.

I really adore this game - the playstyle, story, and characters are all so amazing. But I've been experiencing some downsides, like extreme ping and frequent crashes, even though my wifi is usually great. It's frustrating because I play other games like Genshin Impact and Hsr without any issues. I wish I could enjoy this game more, but these problems really affect my experience and mood. I hope the developers can address these issues soon, especially the crashing problem.

I've installed the game after all the issues I heard about it thinking that maybe it had been fixed now. Unfortunately, despite having a device that can handle many other games, Wuthering Waves Unfortunately kept crashing making me unable to progress through the story. I'm giving it 3 stars because even though I couldn't really play it, the story I did experience was interesting as was the gameplay. I'll probably reinstall when issues are fixed, but for now it's impossible to play :(

Good gameplay. But a lot of optimization needs to be done. When the network connection is restoring, then game should be paused. I couldn't pause the game as a result I lost a lot of time reconnecting and the time ended. In illusive realm or some game mode like that my character died in that connection screen. If I could pause the game it would be nice.

My in-game experience is amazing. Overworld exploration feels smooth and doesn't feel so clunky... The game needs a little bit more optimization here and there but they make up for it with rewards that the playerbase requests for. I like the main story and plot too, but the voice acting could use a little bit of improvement. There are only some tiny tweaks that, for me, doesn't have a big effect. The game will get better and better as it progresses. This game is a must try❗❗❗🫵

The combat is really good. The UI needs a little bit more work. The story... You should have instead went with the CBT 2 story, having the side characters like the main character without any reason kinda sucks tbh, it feels forced. I'd rather have them on edge and cautious then learn that they judge the MC's character wrong then they become friends. The optimizations on some mobile devices needs work, the graphics and framerate of the game really bad. Hopefully 1.1 fixes the issues of players

Great game, one I've truly enjoyed. I've been a player since the beginning and have really loved seeing the new updates (characters, storyline, music, etc.) and the great improvement in graphics. However, I am rather disappointed in the lack of free rewards as of late, Kuro is very generous overall, but in comparison to beginning of the game, it's lacking. I get it, you have to pull in players at the beginning, but with newer characters and weapons, it's hard to keep up without spending.

The story and English voice acting drag this game down severely. Thankfully, you can switch to Japanese, Chinese, Korean, etc., but the story setup and plot aren't very interesting so far. The combat and gameplay are 10/10; which is amazing in-between skimming through tons dialogue you won't really care about. Fast-paced combat, parries, dodges, staggering enemies, finishers,...👍🏻👍🏻. Increased from 3 stars to 4, after some more time playing, because the game is enjoyable despite some flaws.

Despite being the first open-world game that Kuro made (also just released recently) It reached higher than what i expected. I've seen many people complain about bugs, crashes and etc but pls do remember that this is a new game and is only in v1.0. For me, the game is doing fine and yes, I'm using phone/mobile so to the other people complaining about the game being "extremely laggy" then the only thing I can say; the problem is (probably) the device your using. All that aside, the game is 10/10

Great game overall, good graphics, good storyline, and good character design. Though, there are some things that caused me to rate 4 stars instead of 5, first is the connection issues, whenever I try to join the SEA server, a pop up appears and states "The gateway connection timed out, please try again later". The only way to work around this is by using a VPN, which significantly reduces my internet speed and overall is a bit of a hassle, second is overheating, I'm not sure if this is a me prob

I played it since release, and I can only say that I absolutely love it! The story is amazing. The character designs are all very unique with even different body sizes, and the combat is really fun. After a few updates, the game has become a lot more enjoyable because it doesn't lag as much as it used to, which allows for a smoother gaming experience for mobile players. I can only recommend this game, not only for the character designs but also because exploration is really fun! GOOD JOB KURO!

As with any new launch, there are bound to be some kinks and issues, but the game itself is well done. After the long wait, it has not dissapointed.
