The world is beautiful, characters as well and the combat mechanics are great. Story lore will take some getting used to but overall Kuro Games Great Job!! And looking forward to more updates to come ^^.

So far really good, the game just got released so obviously it has a few problems with blurriness and lagging, but the story is nice, the characters are really cute and each different from each other. (We have women taller than men, which is rare lol 🙏🏻) The map is ok, didn't explore that much. Finally, the mechanic of the game, I just love it. From the moment I go to bed until the moment I wake up, all I can think about is this game. A new addiction? I hope so, if the story remains good.

The game is pretty good but the reason that I only gave 3 stars is that I have terrible frames when playing and when I'm doing the bird challenge where you get the coins in the middle of the circle, it annoys me that when I do that challenge it always drops my frames not only in the challenge, also when I'm exploring. Please optimize the game more so that it would be more playable in low end devices. Overall, great game.

The game play is good, but the story, god, it's bad. Every interaction feels forced, the MC is dull, and the cut scenes are where the world, that is really cool when you walk through it,goes to die. Every time I think I might play it, thinking about having to grind through that story kills me. Yes, I could just skip it, but in the end, no matter how good the gameplay is, it's the story that keeps me going. The only reason I haven't uninstalled is because I'm hoping things change going forward.

This game's greatest aspect is the combat system. The combat is fluid and feels responsive. I can't say the same for the rest of the game. The story and side quests are a snooze fest, the English localization is poor, and much of the English voice acting is questionable. The open world is serviceable and I really enjoy all the different mobility options, but many of the puzzles feel uninspired. Overall, I think the game is alright but it lacks polish in several areas and it really shows.

The game is wonderful! I love the story telling, wish they do more auto with the story or the side quests (I'm just a lazy person when I come to reading). I wish there was a way we can sell items like the food or materials that we pick up to get the shell credit in-game currency if you ran out. I love that you can fight a boss multiple times. The tuning system is like a gamble game you get a 50/50 chance on the sub stats. I'm still learning the game and the echo stuff.

This has to be one of the best open world, action game i have played so far. I really love the in-game unique character designs and the f2p support. There might be glitches, but that's to be expected because it has just realised, i am most certainly surprised by the dedication and caring for the problems bc they were/are being fixed as soon as they are reported(rare sight). I really love the various challenges we get to see while exploring and the story that i am definitely looking forward to.

An amazing game, the mechanics, graphics, fights, character design, it's so amazing! Yes the release was a bit buggy, but the developers are working on it! The story could use some more details, going deeply into the lore, since there are many plot holes as of now. Otherwise my rating for this game is a solid 8/10, and if you are playing it on computer, it's definitely a 8.5! Keep up the good work!!

best mobile game I have played. combat is incredibly satisfying. story is ok but starts to get better later on. graphics are great exploration is fun. some bugs at launch but team is regularly patching and updating. very generous compensation for down time. the gatcha system is fair enough that I don't feel ripped off. def worth it if you are looking for a game to sink some time into. just launched so if you are looking for a game to grow with and not feel behind you should give it a try.

Experience has been great so far, unlike others thankfully I didn't encounter any bugs or problems. I like the main story line as well as how you can skip unvoiced dialogue side quests. The echo mechanic is cool and unique, it brings a whole new plate of combos and exploration to the game. Fighting mobs and bosses are fun and skill-based, one would need to practice their dodges and dashes. Great characters. Overall a great game. Hoping to see new content in the future 100% would recommend!

The best game ever. Even though it was a chaos when it finally realeased, it wasn't for me. I enjoyed the game since day one, without problems. It's graphics, characters, the waveplate's sistem, challenges, events and quests, monsters and level up sistem are all great and entretaining. I am also in love with how much KURO GAMES is working to fix all problems, and even having the heart and giving us a free five stars and multiple pulls just for just, basically, keep with them. In fact, a 10/10.

I love this game!! From the combat to the characters and the story. But the only thing that's holding me back from giving it a 5 star rating is the problem with the mobile support for this game. Since I'm broke and can't afford a PC, my phone really isn't suited enough for the graphics as it lags and slows down alot, and I mean A LOT like I can't even go a few meters without bugging out or just moving in 3 frames per second. If it's not a problem pls help us mobile users out there devs.Luv y'all

The best and my top pick rpg game. I love the combat system, most stuff are just the same with Genshin but I like WuWa better, though the game still needs a lot of optimization but the experience in exploration, combat, character playstyle and more is way out of this world. And not to mention, the Devs are so generous and I hope they keep it that way. Worth every penny I spend in the game. Way better, than any other games I've played. MUST TRY!!!

I like the idea of the game. It lags a lot, though, which is something I rarely experience with my Samsung Galaxy S8 tablet, Maybe it's not optimised. Other than that, the gameplay is interesting and the mechanics are also contributing to a unique gameplay. Keep up the good work! I can't wait to see what you'll do with the game in a year or two. Edit: After 1.2 update, the game is way more stable for me. There's still the occasional lag, but at least it's playable.

The game overall is fun, the story is a little boring but the characters catch the attetion. Even though, the lack of optimization really affects the gameplay. I, for example, play on a Galaxy Tab S6 lite with mali G72, and its very lagy even setting the grafics to the lowest. So please, fix the opitimization of the game for weak devices, this game is close to being one of the best on the store!

So far the game is really good and enjoyable! The combat, the story, exploration, love it all!!! But still, since this is a new game, there's many issue such as lag issue, ping drop issue, graphic issue and more. Just need a little more optimization and done! Keep it up Kuro! I hope u guys doing well!

Very great game that has a good combat system, art style, and player movement. The only thing that I think could be improved would be the voice lines for some of the characters as it sounds...empty, no emotion I guess would be a better way of saying it. Besides that, I'm having a hard time trying to understand the story so far. Maybe I've just missed some key information on some events. Also maybe reduce the level requirement to play with friends. Possibly to level 10-15 would be nice.

I LOVE THIS GAME!! Especially the generosity of the devs towards their players! The animation and voice lines are cool and the sceneries are so sick! Tho I hope u can add a housing system where u can buy land and house in cities. But overall, the game is SUPERB!! Keep up the good work! Will definitely recommend this to my friends so we can play together.

This game, overall, is good, not perfection though. Yes, this game does have a lot of issues, but you also have to see that this game is relatively new, and in new games, there's no guarantee that it will run smoothly on every device. It runs great on my Galaxy A33 5G, at medium 60fps, It's playable. And again, it's not perfection, still a lot of issues to fix, and a lot of bugs and crashes to investigate and fix, but I hope this game will have a future like genshin or HSR, and shoutout to devs!

I'm really enjoying this game so far. The lore, characters, scenery, and combat is a wonder. Although, the graphics on mobile are a bit wanning. some of the smaller patches of certain areas or of certain characters, their skins, are significantly graphically lower even with higher settings. I am playing on mobile so this is a given, but it is my only gripe so far. thank you for this game! Please further optimize!

I've been playing WW since it released. Although this game based on anime, but I don't feel like one. The gameplay feels realistic in many ways, e.g. fighting, dodging, spamming skills, many more. The music is not overly made and it's enjoyable with or without a headset. The daily tasks are the most important, you can finish them in less than 15 mins. The game provides players with generous rewards in completing multiple activities. Overall, I enjoy following the main storyline.

I'm loving this game already, the story is interesting, and the characters design is just beautiful. However, one issue I had is the performance isn't very good. I kept having fps drop during exploration and cutscenes, and even more so during combat. It's just downright unplayable for me even tho I have good ping and I have over 100gb space left. I play on iPad so idk what's it like on mobile/PC. This is a big issue for other players as well.

Base on my experience on this game, I'll say that overall it's a good game. It's fun to play and cutscenes are good too. Maybe just because of the update, the game lacks of optimization. I think it's one reason why players like me experience frame drops and lags. But, to me Wuthering Waves, a fun and probably the best rpg game I've ever played.

Since launch this games has captivated me. The combat is just amazing! Never would have I imagined, just how much this game would improve over such little time. 2.0 has been hands down the best update I've ever experienced. The story, world, eploration and music improved so much that it feels like a different game. The skill based combat is something I thought I'd never experience in a gacha game, but here we are. I could go for hours about how amazing the combat is

I'm loving the combat style here, it's much more flashy, fast pace and adrenaline inducing due to parry and dodge. World exploration is enjoyable, I prefer the convenience of grappling hook and wall run (compare to that other game, ahem, which I play for over 3 years now). However, the game is a bit buggy. There will be times that the game is smooth after a patch/small update and then the next day there'll be noticeable framedrop.

I have a few problems with glitches but I don't mind – I'm giving a 4 star just because of the character design and story. I did enjoy the game because it was an open world – but the characters feel dull for some reason, its like they're blending with the surroundings too much. Also the male characters all looks gloomy and boring with colors. Character designs are one of the main things that get me going – like i can play a game w a bad story just for the characters. Wishing this game success

The game just doesnt run smoothly at all. Sometimes it runs smoothly, but then it just kicks me out of the game. And sometimes when i wanna play, its just so laggy that I'm unable to play, at that point it just kicks me out of the game again. I dont think my device is the problem since it can handle other high graphic games and run smoothly, I've set the graphics to the lowest, but it still lags and unresponsive sometimes. Its an amazing game, but this issue is annoying. Please fix this issue

The game is AWESOME!!! From the graphics to the characters to the story!! It's PERFECTION!! I'm only giving it 4* because I'm a stinky mobile player and during cutscenes, and sometimes casual gameplay, assets glitch in and out of my view range. It can get annoying from time to time but it's okay. A LITTLE bit more OPTIMISATION and more work on voice acting would help and maybe even boost my rating to 5*. That is if I ever remember to check.👍👍 Edit: NO WAY THEY ACTUALLY FIXED IT!!!

At the version 1.0 things go smoothly on my phone, works very well even it's low/mid phone. But still able to play with minor lags and connection issues. But after 1.1 came out, things doesn't go well now. The game lags so much that I can't even barely move the character let alone when fighting with enemies. But sometimes the game runs back smoothly for a couple of minutes and after that goes back to lag like crazy. Please KURO, please focus 100% on the performance issues first.

I recently downloaded this game and I really loved it. From the graphics, characters, combat, exploration and the story .This game is truly a masterpiece. The only issue I'm currently experiencing is the lag during combat which I find really annoying considering that I can't enjoy the magnificent combat mechanics in this game. But overall, this game is perfect for those who seeks peak combat, adventure and exciting story. I really look forward for more optimization in this game. #Lovewuwa

I absolutely love it. The voice acting is kind of bland, but it's still great, esp the JP voicelines. The graphics, the storyline, and combat are absolute peak. The game mechanics are fun to play with, and overall it's a good enjoyable game. Not to mention the fast response to bugs and glitches, my respects have gone higher through the roof. Although it lags and sometimes crashes, I can tolerate it because most of the time, it's mostly just my device. Give this game the recognition it deserves.

I love the story, I love the gameplay and I also love how much they compesate for problems within the game. The devs are really generous. To top it all of the combat is just top tier. So far, this is one of the best if not the best game I've played on mobile. But as a mobile player, there's just one issue, it is the graphics but even if I regard this my rating would still be a five star, I just love the counter attack, parry, and dodge mechanics which you don't normally see from similar games.

I have been playing since release, and so far it has been buggy and laggy each time I play it on my phone. My ping was extremely high, went up to the 400 ping zone, I was basically in the red. Even though it is new and recent, the game is incredibly fun, the combat is extremely fun and I love it overall expect the lags that had occurred to me. I hope this issue gets fixed!

Very surprised by this game. It does feel like an upgraded version of older open world gacha games in many departments, specially in exploration, combat and graphics. However, 1.1 had a huge increase in quality as an overall product, storytelling and music improved a lot, the art direction on some dungeons is incredible atm. Also, dungeon puzzles are the closest I have found to older zelda games. The only downside is that english voices are lackluster, but JP is impressive and full of life.

Now that I've played the game for quite some time now, the game experience and the overall rating exceeded my expectations. Rewards and compensations are very abundant almost every patch of bugs and other updates. Didn't feel left alone playing this game, had so many friends to help me and vice versa. Quests are quite a bit easy tho. Might need a bit of raising the difficulty :> Thank you Kurogames for letting us experience such a wonderful game.

Great combat, good exploration (a little clunky for me). The story and characters just are not interesting enough to make me want to stay. If you're just here the action, this game is for you (I'm pretty sure there's a skip dialogue button, too), but if you want an interesting story to hook you in, you'll probably be disappointed.

Loved the combat, the system, the animations. But if there's one thing I want to point out is that I wish to see characters interacting with each other even more rather than the player. I want see the depths of the relationship with them and the others. For example the Black Shores, I want to see Shorekeeper and Camellya interacting with each other in the game. The same goes with Carlotta and Cantarella. I want them to at least have a go on each other (a fight). But anyway the game is good.

A great game.... Just not user friendly. If you're planning to play it in low-mid range phone. Forget it.... This game run by unreal anyway so the graphic is gorgeous just a bit heavy for the control. The story is pretty nice too. The new Echo system is also fun. Kinda remind me of the summon system from the Final fantasy series... Overall, good game

Absolutely amazing. The game itself is so good, there are fun mini games, puzzles, and challenges to do in the open world. There are also great characters and the designs are superb. Currently there are bugs and lags but the developers are working overtime to fix it!! Even going as far as giving us compensations!! I hope the devs don't overwork themselves. Please don't tire yourselves out!! We appreciate your hard work and your game! ❤️❤️

The gameplay is really interesting and I like the game in general, but I can't really enjoy it because by how laggy it is on the phone, which is just sad. I have a gaming phone and genshin works just fine with even high graphics. I won't change the review until they at least optimize the game for the phone too. To at least work fine, it just destroys the experience. I hope one day it will work without being so laggy :')

The gaming experience has been nothing but a pleasure for me although I have one thing to complain about. Ever since I started the game, it has been overly laggy and as much as the quality makes up for it, it's hard to enjoy the game properly with the amount of lag that I've been receiving. Hopefully when this game progresses along, this wouldn't be a problem but please remember that this game is meant for players to enjoy, especially the ones who uses mobile rather than PCs or Laptops.

This has got to be the best gacha RPG game for me. It has improved a lot since release, and the devs really care about the people playing. It's very f2p friendly, the audiovisual experience is amazing, and the combat is just perfect, although I'd prefer using a controller, which the game also supports! I love the characters, the way the story is unfolding, and the amount of lore we're about to get in the new version will likely be even better. Well worth playing, I hope this keeps up!

For someone who spent max of fifteen bucks on this game, it is not at all pay to win like genshin. There are multiple opportunities to get five star characters and weapons. I really enjoy the play style of the game and unlike genshin, it takes up less room in my room. I hope to see new updates to the game eventually. My only downside is that skmetimes, it lags but mainly it's because of my old phone. I got a new phone and it runs perfectly now. With my ADHD, this makes a perfect distinction!!

As is the case for many, the game is just too demanding on devices, so it's prone to crashing/whatnot. Attempted smooth play across multiple devices, all of them high performance, none of them having issues with other games.. That said, it appeared to be a decent game, though the experience was overshadowed by it's needy demands on a device. It's rather bothering, tbh, there's no way they didn't know this game wasn't ready for mobile. If you know gaming as I do, then you know what that implies.

overwhelming power!!!!!! bro even the 4* are cool as hell and have ult animations. this is the first time i was drawn to purchase a PC to play a game, yeah Kuro influanced that! and I can't wait to fire it up. this game has great potential and to me has the perfect balance between the G game and ToF which are both games im highly invested in. i also love the fact that you can go straight to a character tutorial from their info page.

Can't play it at all because it won't work on phone. The quality is absolutely horrible on my tablet and overheats it every time I try getting through a couple scenes. For the love of God, please add to ps5 or xbox like all us ps5/xbox wuwa lovers were told you were going to. Don't be like hoyoverse, where they take 5-7 months after release to finally put it up on other platforms other than mobile. Everything else is great, the designs, characters, story. Wish I could actually get through it tho

So far, i got to say its a very nice and addictive game with a nice story line and a variety of enemies "TD's" to fight. Very good graphics when played on advance ( not the best but really good ). I can say for sure go for it, it's nice and you really going to enjoy your time playing it. I just hope more events and more things being added to the game and what i really would like to see MORE BOSSES!! That for me its gonna be 5stars+++++. Good job to dev team so far for this game !

LOVE the game! The best aspect of it is the Combat system. It has some DevilMayCry5 elements to it, with the dodge and parry mechanics. It actually takes skill to play which is a lot of fun in its own right. The only issue, as pf now, is performance. There are some frame drops here and there but aside from that, its an excellent game and the Art Style is Magnificient.

Wanna feels like a badass instead from just pressing buttons and swapping characters? Try this game!!! The combat system are souls-like, action packed, fast paced, F2P friendly, and highly detailed. And tons of contents aside from exploring. Compare to 1.0, the games are improving a lot, especially the main quest. Since this game just released not long ago, surely there's something that not up to what the player's are expected, hope the game will be better and better. All the best for Kuro Games

Despite being an amazing game, it's EXTREMELY unoptimized. Without a high end phone, the game run likes you're playing on a phone from 2015. Another problem is that no matter what network you have, you're always lagging no matter what. I've tried playing on a PC (mid to high end btw) and it's even worse than my phone. My ping is extremely high, my graphics are all the way down and I'm still lagging despite having amazing wifi. The only device I can truly play on is my laptop at school.

I love this game, I've been playing since release. The quests are great, the gameplay is awesome, the npc's look amazing, graphics are alright (but only for tablets/computers), and the characters are really cool. The characters are definitely fanserviced, but it can't be stopped, lol. I rate 4 stars because there are honestly way too many female characters, and I'm pretty sure everyone wants new male character/s. Overall, though, I think it's a really fun game.

Out of all the RPGs, this is the game that piqued my interest the most, I've pre-registred in the official website and playstore, pre-installed and played right away on launch. And with the way that the developer gives away compensations for the inconveniences and listens very well to the feedbacks really impressed me as much as the game did. The graphics, the gameplay among the other phenomenal things, really exceeded my expectations, hence, I will play for as long as its playable ~♡

Probably the best game of its genre. The combat is fluid, reasonably varied, and overall fun. The story is decent, and you can skip parts that don't interest you. Character design was initially weak but is now up there with Hoyo games. If this game had the courage to unsaddle itself from some of the toxic vestiges of its genre (stamina system, time-gated events), it would be a near-perfect game. Unfortunately, they don't trust players enough to let them off the daily grind leash.

Best game ever in my opinion, well, except for the fact there's so little male characters, but I love the female characters too, it gets kinda boring when it's all just females. Also, the rewards are great, it's very easy not to spend money just for some pulls, f2p friendly indeed. Also, there's this weird thing I saw in the game, I think it's not supposed to be like that, nothing major, just the text is weird. Other than that it's definitely a 5 star game to me.

Would truly love to rate this game higher but it's completely unplayable so far. I know they will eventually get it working, well hoping. Love the company and everything they are trying, but in 5 days and 30+ hours of trying, I'm maybe 2 total hours of game play. It's crazy because everything the first 3-5 minutes is great. But once it's been running and loading, it just becomes too overwhelming all of sudden. At this point, just playing for the hope that golden patch comes in to bring this up.

10GB of space for a game I can't even play because it's so dang resource demanding. I cleared my ram and half my phone storage, optimized everything and its still too much. The game is graphically amazing and from what I can tell by the first 5 minutes of game play, seems very interesting. Too bad I'll never get to move past that. My phone has never had an issue playing games before. Galaxy A23. 4 stars because it's not the Devs fault my phone can't play it. But it also kinda is.

Hello! I hope you read this guys haha i really love the game, the combat is amazing, the exploration is top notch! I cant ask for more, but i think we players need to have an option on the graphics settings in which we can adjust the animation of the overall environment(grass animations and stuff) especially on mobile so that players with mid range phones can enjoy the game more! Thats all guys!i wish you all the best and I hope your game gets more successful in the future! Looking forward to it

It's ok, but if you're going to directly rip off another game in almost every possible way the least you could do is improve things like giving us gear loadouts or making multiplayer more than just lip service. We should be able to quest and explore together in meaningful ways. Lastly, omg, chill out with the dialogue, PLEASE. I don't normally skip the story, but I just can't with this game. They talk SO MUCH I don't need every little detail

It needs some work. The game can look nice if your phone or computer can run rings around this game. The story is terrible but improves at the latter half. Combat is the highlight of the game. On the other hand some systems here made me feel like I'm playing a knockoff of a more popular game. The generosity? They handed out a lot of free stuff recently. This shouldn't be representative of how generous they are. Wait for a few major patches just to get a feel of this.

Absolutely Love this Game. I was previously a Genshin Player, and while I do still love the characters, the game just started to feel like a drag after a while. I fell behind due to college and getting back into the game felt more like a chore than it was fun. Wuthering Waves makes things easier by having the option to skip cutscenes, and now they're going to introduce a content summary you can read after you skip? Phenomenal! Love that! Love how considerate Kuro is of their Community! 💖

I REALLY want to play this game but I have hardy been able to because of the lag. It's honestly gotten worse recently, rather than crashing every 5-10 minutes, it's crashing every 1-3. I wouldn't say I have the best phone, but it is new and it is functional. I hope the devs can optimize the game for more devices because I find it very cool so far. Update2.0: It's bad again. I can't even progress and I'm gonna miss yinlin at this rate.

This is a great game. While like most gacha games there's some pay features, for the most part you can play the main story without paying. The open world elements are quite fun to explore. I think this has been one of the best battle plays I've experienced. I love the custom keys element too. The events are quite interesting, introduces some Chinese cultural festivities, which is quite heartwarming. I play on mobile so the text does feel a bit small and I can't run the full shadowing effects,etc

Good game actually, yes the game has a lot of issues right now like bugs but the good news is that the developers are working on fixing those issues. I just hope that the game has more event and contents, as one of those players that grind hours a day that has farmed and explored all the collectibles like puzzles, chest etc, the resources is pretty limited for now. Overall love the game and the story.

Really enjoyed most of this game. I can't wait for more. I'm crazy impressed with most of this game, not crazy about the daily energy costs for dungeon rewards, their kinda high. but they're still fairly reasonable considering it's early in the game, and you can chew through most of the story pretty quickly. Oh, the story isn't great at first but gets kinda better later. Would also like if they'd add more puzzles to the older areas and newer areas have a larger number of difficult puzzles.

The game is so awesome. The only thing that stopped me from playing is because its way too laggy. I figured out the reason why so. It's because when I'm on the open world it lags like hell but when I'm on a small space like a domain, etc. it isn't that much laggy. I suggest having a rendering distance option on graphics settings because there's way too many going on with open world.

Edit[3]: they fixed the constant frame drops! no more red 999ms ping on me, lol. I love Wuthering Waves, honestly. And that was the only thing I hated about the game—ping. But, since it's been gone and clear, I can play for hours without a lag now. Thing is... it's crashing. Not always, but from time to time, it just crashes. Idk why. Anw, Rinascita's here! I'm excited for it.

Yes it's a good game, they had so many good characters and stories and all. But there's so many bug's in this game when you are playing in your "Android phones or iOS" It keeps lagging, Your network pings is low even tho my network is currently fine, and when I open the game itself it's crushing even so...I will rate this game 4.5, I still have a high hope's they will fix the problems in "Android phones and iOS". I'm will be waiting patiently Wuthering Waves until I get those good news!.. <3.

The negatives. The English dub is atrocious so I highly recommend playing in any of the other languages. This is the first game I have willfully chosen not to play in English. 2nd the story right now is only average and fairly forgettable however the portion with Scar and the finale of the current chapter were quite good. Now the good. The combat is absolutely phenomenal, you can't P2W certain content it's truly challenging. The art is great the world is huge and enemy variety is plentiful!

Its understandable that there are bugs at the beginning but honestly thats normal. I like this game and how its progressing, I've played many games (GI, HSR, PTN,HI etc) and ofcourse there's some parts that reminds me of them in this game but the genre of WW is totally different, I love how "dead" the world is maybe just a little bit more details in the BG will be nice but not really required. I love the characters and the story isn't bad but overall WW is doing great! Thanks Kuro!!!

This game is overall good, as it just released it has some bugs as expected. Though, I find it hard playing this game especially when fighting because of a glitch, my camera would move quickly more over sensitively. I don't know how to say it😭. While would fight some enemies, my camera's sensitivity would increase, I thought it was just me who was experiencing this bug but when I looked on social media I would find other people having the same problem.

It's an amazing game, the update is amazing and the graphics just got better. The reason why i didn't rate it 5* because of the ping. It's like it's back to 1.0, my ping is unusually high even though I'm playing on the lowest settings and i have enough storage for the game to run in my device. It disconnects me in battles even when I'm just farming for echoes. That's basically the whole issue and i hope it goes back to normal. Thank you Kuro

The game is soo much fun, gameplay is unique, and the graphics is really nice to look at! though I sadly have to use the very low settings since my phone isn't that good, but from my brother's pc it looks 10x more better than on my phone. The story's beginning is interesting and I like it! My only problem is the slight lag, but Kuro is working on it!! So I can't wait!!!

Good game, I have a lot of fun playing it. I have zero complaints besides it being a bit laggy on mobile, especially if I'm playing co-op with friends. (but tbh it's understandable since this game has absolutely stunning graphics.) also, as someone who isn't engaged in the story aspect of games most of the time, WuWa I can make an exception for since the characters aren't just standing in one place speaking. They are actually lively and move around quite a bit which is nice

Insanely good. I literally have nothing bad to say. Some people talk about bugs, i have had this game since the first day it launched and I never, EVER had any issue. The grinding is super easy, the animations are splendid, the characters are great, the music is beautiful, the voice acting is... Okay 😭, but other than that, i love everything about this game so far. The developers also seems to pay a lot of attention to what the players think. I HIGHLY recommend!!!

Here are my comments on this game: Combat is quite fun, the mechanics and combat styles are easy to grasp. Performance is a bit slow. I feel as if ths game is demanding a bit too much from my phone and the graphics are just terrible no matter what settings I use. Too much infodumping at the beginning of the game. If you're going to make a story, maybe narrate the story in proper sequences instead of just shoving all the lore into the early stages of the game.

For an early open world class game, it is as wonderful as it gets. First of all, the game is great in both aesthetics and gameplay, featuring unique battle style, as well as wide variety of mobility for travelling from place to place. In addition, the story felt nostalgic or somewhat similar to other open world game, but I genuinely loved the story and almost made me tear up. Lastly, it is not a punishing game for grinding as f2p "yet". Overall, it's really a good game!

The story and setting are very intriguing. Combat is very dynamic. Interesting mechanic of taking abilities from monsters through the "Echo" system. The English voice acting is great. At the time of writing this review the game takes up 9.4 gigabytes of storage space for my Android device. I hope it doesn't grow more than that like GI did. Since launch the game still crashes unpredictably. The most I went without crashing was around 10-30 minutes. I still like the game itself tho.

I've been playing this game since the release basically non-stop on mobile. The game isn't without bugs but the Devs have done a great job listen and fixing the issues, they have even been insanely generous (unlike other games). Overall I love everything about this game from the aesthetics to the combat. Great job guys. Can't wait to see what the game will bring next.

This game has potential. But it tends to crash alot. It's a bran new game so that's understandable. I really think this game will definitely play better on a PS5. I am really waiting for it to release on console. I would play it on my laptop but my laptop couldn't even run Genshin properly so it's def not going to run this. I definitely do prefer console over PC. Overall the game is good so far and the characters are nice. Can't wait for the next banner tho!

I believe this is gonna be my new number 1 gacha, everything from the combat, music, and characters, and everything in-between is so awesome. My only concern is that we will be getting the game on consoles such as PS5 because I'm currently playing on my phone. Pretty much everything is lagging, and the graphics are pretty rough. I really hope a console release is soon so I and many others who are having performance issues and properly enjoy the game.

This game is amazing! I really love the fact that it's an open world. And there's always something to somewhat do. I have officially completed all the main quests and other quests in the game , and I can not wait for more gameplay in the game. The only problem i have is how expensive it is to spin for the characters :/ But overall, it's truly one of the best games I've played on mobile. Looking forward to more version updates!!!

Honestly its a very good game. I started playing when it first came out. And really this game improve so fast. The plot, combat, and plot are really top tier now. For combat wise, this game does actually have some challenges for a mobile game. I guess some devices might not be that supported. Quiet heavy, but not too heavy for this kind of quality. Honestly its like a PC game, and I do play in PC and the experience is so much better. Just my honest review. Anyway, overall 5 star.

I have fun playing. Like those big gacha games, it works well. But there's room for improvement. First, it's battery-hogging and heating my device faster. The graphics arr mediocre even at the highest level. Blurry. Some voice lines were cut mid-sentence, including the idle animation, which make the story experience a bit poor. I hope it'll all get fixed soon.

This game is FANTASTIC! The combat is so well done, it's so gripping, and it just feels so smooth! It's really the best part of the game, bar none. I would also give this game a try if you like open-world rpgs, and cool anime characters. The only thing is it is a Gacha game, so if you don't have a lot of money to spend, you're going to be playing and grinding a lot using your time! The characters are really stunning and designed well, they will tempt you to buy! Well done Kuro games!

Listen I like the game, it has a pretty interesting story, but as of right it is very laggy both on mobile and PC, I mean stuff like this expected when a game first launches. I do notice that there is really bad ping problems, it'll jump from being in double digits like 74ms, etc to triple digits as high as 999ms, etc. And I thought maybe it was my PC but it was the same on mobile. I do wish they could let us turn down render distance because that would probably cut some lag down.

I think the game is nice, but what's bothering me is it keeps reconnecting especially when I have to fight the boss. It's so annoying getting attacked while we can't even move around. I have no problem while playing other games. So I don't think my internet is the problem. And please please fix the co-op rules. Let us play with everyone from other region, please.. Thank you for reading it, would appreciate a lot, it's a nice game to begin with.

With experience with Honkai Starrail and Genshin (Joined both games when it was first out /OG), this overall game is much more better with great graphics and awesome characters and their design. It's a bit laggy but it's a new game right? You don't expect NEW things to be greatly build. Last of all, I love how you can skip quests unlike most games, there's a 4th skill (echo) And it's just better overall, 5/5 recommend if you're looking for action and exploration and maybe even character design.

Ok, the game was good very kind to the players, plus it was unique, but I'm still having a hard time on coop mode about the chatting system I hope you can add a red sign at the side of the message box (‼️) so that I can be notified if my coop members are chatting to me. Plus Idk maybe it's because it's on the phone, but it keeps going up to our first message, so I have to scroll down to check if there's a latest chat or not. I hope you guys can fix it overall. The game is nice and wonderful.

For such a new game, the graphics and playstyle is fantastic. As with any game, there are bugs & issues but I'm sure the game will continue to improve with each update. My only real concern is how much battery it consumes on mobile. My phone heats up immediately when playing and it dies after an hour at most. I'm not sure how much of the problem can be resolved but I'd love to play the game for more than an hour.

This game really puts skill into account which I appreciate. Once I got the dodging and parrying mechanics down, it really heightened my reaction time and anticipate my enemies' next attack. Overall, it's a great breath of fresh air from the likes of Genshin. Although I would say that compared to PC, this game really needs to focus on proper optimization across all Android devices. Once that hurdle has been passed, this game has great potential.

This game is fun and enjoyable, it's cute and it also has well-written characters and a game that is story-rich. I believe this game mainly focuses on combat with exploring at second or maybe even both at the same time. What I like the most is that it allows me to switch characters mid fight and dodge and parry too, you can literally defeat an enemy or a Tacet Discord using a level 10 character if you know how to dodge, parry, and handle said character. Highly recommended, pls play this guys 🙏

The first part of the story was a bit boring, but there's a skip button so you can skip the storyline and its controller compatible (I use one for PS4). All of their characters are good, even the ones given in the beginning. The weapons and characters have separate banners with the weapon banners having a guarantee 5* drop. The developers are always listening for player feedback for optimizing their game and are fast to make improvements depending on the issue and give compensation if needed.

I love this keep. I like the visual, the story, the animation, the cuts scene, the rewards, the gacha, the characters, the desigh, the music, the effort you work on this game I just love everything. The road this game has on the future might be uncertain but I hope you'll become successful and will be something that a lot of players will live and something that will be recognised by many.

So been playing since launch, this game is awesome I'm loving it so far, the character designs are beautiful the story very engaging. The combat is great, I've always had a problem with phone controls though and it doesn't hook up to my PS5 controller, these phone touch buttons are useless when it comes to dodging. Regardless, it's still very fun and I can't wait till it comes to console, I'm hoping I can carry my phone data to the PS5 version. Please console ver. soon so I can continue to enjoy

Hello, Kuro Games! Edit to my review: The characters in mobile is blurry and when I turn the setting off, I can see the pixels. I play in my laptop as well but it's not blurry like the mobile. It just bothers me that I can't see the characters' faces clearly. We also need more expressions for taking pictures of characters. Overall, I enjoy the game, combat and story. Thank you for your efforts!

Absolutely loving the game. I've been playing it constantly and I would just like to give the biggest gratitude to all the devs of this game. They had been fixing everything that needs to be fixed in the game. Really appreciate it and thank you so much as well for the generous gifts within the game. As for my experience, I haven't really gotten much problem with the game. I can easily follow the story and mechanics. The characters are also interesting especially their design.

Loved playing this game! However, I do get issues such as lag spikes or random crashes, and the performance drops by a whole lot after 2.0 I did get to work around it sorta, but when I do get it to be smooth enough to play, I always enjoyed my time. Besides that, the story, animations, voice acting— everything improved soooo much after the 2.0 update💜💜 Definitely recommend!

This game is great; from the visuals, the music, the stories, and details of characters, settings and monsters(the enemies). But- but why is it so big though, from 22 GB to 30 GB. Not to mention the updates are so big. I know it's just how it works, because of the great things i mentioned that makes it a big game, but is there a way to like... maybe make the game file... smaller... just a bit... thank you. GOOD GAME WOULD RECOMMEND, MATTER OF FACT I RECOMMENDED IT TO MY FRIENDS!!!

I have a Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra. I understand it's not a gaming phone, but there isn't a good reason for this game to chug on lower settings. Mechanics are okay. Resonators are fun, monsters are not. Lots of odd hitboxes and ridiculous collision. The parry system is unreliable. Even when I hit an enemy as the halo meets the line, I'll get hit anyway. Despite all this, I'll bring review to 4 stars once Kuro decides it wants to finally bring controller support to the game. Ty and have fun!

So I started playing this game like two weeks ago. I like the design and graphics, but when I got to the gacha pulls, things went down hill. The five star turned out to be the one base character I had over the new characters. Didn't even give me one of the other base characters. Literally the one five star I had. At that point I decided this game wasn't going to go well. It's very type and build dependent, so missing out on characters hurts in the long run. Game should want new people to stay.

I'm playing on PC. In my opinion this game is amazing The animations, the battle system, the echos. Unique approach. It's really a cool concept which implies that is an open world game instead of doing domains over and over again. Of course there are some bugs and issues with optimalisation but it was to be expected cuz it's a fresh release. I'm really satisfied!

Huge fan of Wuthering Waves. The devs are extremely generous and listen to the community's feedback. The resources are very fair. Almost every update there's more QoL to make the game feel better. The combat is fast-paced, and may actually challenge you a bit if you're under leveled. There's no PvP, so you can go at your own pace without worrying about getting demolished/falling behind. There's also plenty of exploration and puzzles. As the game continues to improve, I can't recommend it enough.

just wanted to say that while I understand that many people are having issues with playing this on mobile, the game itself is extremely fun. if one is available to you, I recommend playing this on a computer or tablet. but I also know the frustration of not being able to play a mobile game on a mobile phone. I guess what I'm saying is: don't give up on this game yet. as a f2p I've been finding it enjoyable, engaging, and beautiful. thank you devs for your continued efforts!

The game is good initially overall. It definitely has some great stuff about it like ease of exploration and combat style which I really like. I rated this 3 stars because, this game has lots of room for improvement particularly in story writing, world building/lore, and the english voice acting; and I'm really looking forward to it. I'll edit my review once this game has met my expectations. Nevertheless, I'm enjoying it up til now and I'll continue playing. Good so far!

I love this game so far! The graphics are high quality, even on mobile. I've had little to no issues running this game on my android phone. The story is just beginning and already very intriguing, not to mention If it isn't to you it's skipable. The characters are great, and the devs listen very well to the communities feedback. I've had a great time playing it.

Downloaded the data and stuff, started to get into the game, but when I got even a bit far into the game, it kicks me out. I don't feel like having to go back in just to be able to play the game. It also doesn't save too much of your progress so you have to go through the dialogue all over again. I'll try it again when they make it less crashy for androids and stuff. Update: I suggest making a cloud version for your game like genshin Impact did so that mobile players can play.

Gameplay-wise the game seems to be really good. I love the combat animations and the intro/outro thing. I also love the perfect dodge. But story-wise? Oh, boy. I’m a lore heavy enjoyer and so far I hate this. I have no idea what they were thinking dumping so much information in the first hour of the game. This team doesn’t seem to understand anything about narrative and storytelling. It’s a bummer, cause I really enjoy the gameplay. I will play more, for sure. Hopefully it gets better

The story is all over the place and that's a problem when everything has to go through stories. Even with a skip button, I still find this exhausting because the story isn't interesting imo. I don't even care much about the characters but I love how they animate them to look very expressive. The combat is fun as well. The exploration is fine ig. And something else is giving me a headache while playing it, not sure what exactly. Had to uninstall it because of this and my phone storage. 😔

Great Gameplay, Graphics, 3D Animation and Story. This is an Action rpg meets Open world, the combat is fluid and the enemies all have their own moveset, that makes it rather fun to fight against. Also these monsters become yours, so a plus that they have their own abilities. The Characters have various combat styles and are easy to understand, with a few exception, but that's a real skill issue here, if your bad at dodging and parrying. I tried both mobile and Pc and say, pc is so much better.

🌸I'm playing, and my experience is wonderful. A lot of people are having problems, I didn't have a problem, so I'm happy, well, just a tiny one😅 I'm a player on the consoles, but mobile game play, which is not my thing, I'm having a great experience on it. The control on mobile is obviously ✨️annoying✨️ for me, since it is a mobile game, but this game is good, I'm just hoping It comes on playstation 5 soon. Anyway, play the game. You won't regret it, in my opinion.

This is the best game I've ever played! Everything that I'm looking for, is already here! Ease in exploration, wherein you won't have to stress yourself out, climbing buildings or terrains. The combat mechanics! It's perfect and cool, along with the storyline that you can skip, and read the summary of what's happening, it saves time, and you'd be able to do a lot of tasks without feeling bored. I also loved how the developers added the option for players to interact with cats or dogs in the map!

For a game which has just come out, it's amazing. I love the designs, the game play, the style, everything. I cannot wait to see what comes next! Pulling for jinshi when she's out, so I'm excited to see how she plays. My only issue is when on pc when I first load in it lags, but honestly it's only then so I see no issue. It's a new game and I won't complain since it's in progress. Mobile for me has bad graphics but I never play on mobile often. All in all love the game.

Review number three, I love this game but I can't defend wuwa anymore. Okay, the update is ehh, a bit tacky, the story quest is boring, it's a bit too short and the side quests are pretty limited, so you don't have anything to do at all besides leveling up your characters and grinding materials which is kinda boring for me. kuro is pretty generous with their rewards, but the game needs more stabilization. add more side quests, and reduce the lags and optimize the controls

This is the greatest game that has been fun to plays with a lot of great stories and content to explore as I was playing and it kept crushing after a little bit and saying connection issues even though my connection was fine on my side. So I think this game will go far in the future. Just need to work on connection issues on different phones and platforms that are older devices.

When I usually increase the graphics of other games, they will start to lag. But as for this game, I'm confused how I'm able to run it with high resolution, special effects and bloom without it stuttering. Though, when I choose the lowest settings possible, it's still the same. Frames aside, this game is a masterpiece. The writing is as beautiful as the combat animations. Solid open world game!

I am enjoying this game even though my device could not run it well, since i have a budget device. Even though my device is on the weaker side, i can at least enjoy this game despite the performance issues, it shows that i greatly support this game. The story is okay, nothing to be compared of, but the combat, it is very fast paced and requires more skill than resources, for the most part and i love that. Overall, this game is really good, and i look forward for more optimizations!

This is the first version, so it's a bit laggy- but still SO much fun to play. Lots of free in-game welcome gifts, cute characters and complex, interesting fighting mechanics. I love the world building so far and all the characters (did I mention they're adorable?). Huge map, so perfect for gamers who love to explore.

Absolutely love this game so far after 5-6 hours in. I find it immensely more enjoyable than other similar style games as the main aspects of the game are very fun. For example exploration is more fun and relaxing because of being able to sprint without using stamina and also being able to run up walls instead of slowly climbing. The character and world design is beautiful. The combat is one of the best parts because it feels fluid and exciting. The only con to the game for me is the lag.

This is potentially one of the best (if not) the best gacha game of all time. Movements are better than any other gacha games and the combat system is off the rails. It feels like I'm playing a dark souls game in mobile. The downsides are: this game is not mobile friendly. Either you buy a really high specs or stick to your midrange phone and settle for the lowest possible setting with 25-30 fps. I still gonna give this 5 star because it's really good and I know they can fix these problems.

I feel bad for the people having issues with this game. My experience has been great so far on my Galaxy S23. Besides performance, the game does have a boring opening act and bad EN voice acting. Switch to JP or KR voices to save your sanity. As for gameplay, the combat is top notch and the exploration is seriously addicting. If this game piques your interest, I would highly recommend trying it out for yourself!

Im so glad I decided to try this game. At first, I thought it was just a cheap copy of GI until I played. The graphic, performance n storyline is far more than I expected. The characters designs are also amazing! I personally love the grapple feature. Overall this game is great! I wished i could add more players to the team tho.. 3 characters only is too little for me since there's so many characters that I want in my team.. I'm sure this game will have a bright future. Looking forward to updts!

Make no mistake. This is still a gacha game. Your main form of getting new characters is gambling. But it is the best gacha game. The gameplay is fast paced, end game content is challenging. The character designs are amazing, they all play differently from each other. There are so many quality of life features other similar titles do not have. On top of that, the devs listen and address player concerns fairly quickly. They are super generous with rewards.

Hi Kuro Developers, I am from Pakistan and have been playing your game since its mobile launch. I love the combat mechanics and everything about the game. I spend 3 to 4 hours daily playing and have also spent money to support you. However, I have an issue with the ping. My ping is usually between 200 to 300 ms, sometimes going over 400 ms. During combat, this high ping often causes me to die or get one-shot by enemies. This makes it hard to improve my skills and enjoy the game. Please solve it

Love this game so much! Combat is super fun, exploring is an absolute joy, and the character models + fight animations are so good. Definitely prefer playing it on PC, but it's great being able to do dailies/events on mobile when I'm out and about. Everything runs perfectly on my Samsung Galaxy S24 — no frame drops or lag — but it does overheat after running it for a while, which is expected.

I have a fun time here, though some characters' design makes me uncomfortable, but this is one of the gacha games I love playing! The story is incredibly immersive, generous with rewards, and the art style is by far my favorite (both MCs are hot). Yet, I hope Kuro can optimize the game more and make a feature where we can delete past quest data to reduce the size. It's already 30 GB, and if the number increases further, I'm afraid I need to say bye-bye to Shorekeeper...

Graphics, voice acting, character design, story and combat mechanics is just absolutely amazing. I honestly don't think there is another open world cross platform RPG that can top this. I will admit that combat in this game can be quite challenging but not too difficult to the point you want to throw your phone out of a window (based on experience from other games lol). It also almost feels like I'm playing a souls-like game due to how punishing some of the enemies are in the game.

Hands down a great experience. Starts a bit slow, but once it picks up, it's an absolute banger that will never fail to amaze. Characters feel powerful, with beautifully tailored kits. Graphics and OST are superb and the story is something else.. just perfect. Daily experience is pretty well done. It can be either short, or long, depending on how much free time you have. Probably the only game in the market I've been playing for about a year and don't regret picking it up.

A lot of potential, the big problem is that it is increasingly laggy. At times barely anything loads and you get kicked out constantly. The wifi is good one second and becomes 999 in a blink of an eye. People are impatient and want everything to be quick. So I recommend trying to make a setting for mobile users with low fps or just making something to drop ping. You don't need to change much. But, don't always take my word for it. I am very inexperienced with these types of things. Good day!

Peak combat mechanics and experience for a mobile game. That's their selling point, after all. Characters' facial expressions also deserve praise. However, the story and some characters' voice acting are mediocre. Specially the MC, and particularly the female. Not sure about the male counterpart. Anyway, I hope it improves as the game updates in the future. Still, I am enjoying this game despite the issues other players are so pressed about.

game is so good, but so unavailable.. The storage is insane, the lack of platforms available are insane. Even if you have a device big enough for the storage, the quality is so good that unless you have an expensive, good device, you'll just be lagging to the point you can't move, nothing will load, it'll overheat and more. I actually burnt my hand that's how bad it overheats. I really hope they make it available for others, like PS4. the game is good, they just need to fix these issues.

I have been playing this game ever since it's released, I think we all know that the game had a bad start with the voicelines, bugs, lags, etc. As time goes by, the game is getting better, improving so fast. For the style and aesthetics, the models and animations are so cool and unique, although the character designs have more room to improve. The open-world, personally, it looks apocalyptic, still I love every bit of the view through the wilderness. The mechanics make the game fun.

I really love this game! The character designs are great, and the world is beautiful. The method of collecting echoes through open-world battles is awesome, and I personally enjoyed the story (I made it through the first main quest). The only thing is, I struggle so much to play on my device. I don't think it's something to criticize the game over, but it's honestly almost unplayable. Could you maybe have a cloud version? It made another game I've played work perfectly on my device~

Overall, the game is good. The story was great . The gameplay is fun, too. My main problem is that the game crashes every now and then. This makes the experience of playing the game sometimes irritable cause of the frequent came crash. FYI, I'm using Samsung s24 256gb and exynos processor. Hopefully, I get help on why the game always crash when I try to play it.

Proving that you don't need to be greedy or have giant worlds beyond comprehension when starting a game. I loved Geshin until the greed set it. I don't mind paying some money for a game here and there, but I don't need it to be how I play. This game does everything Genshin does but better. The machanics and scenery are amazing! My only complaint is the lagging. To anybody trying to play in high res, don't. Most devices can't run it well. That will fix half your issues alone...

i love this game so much, it ran perfectly on my device, but after rinascita 2nd update it keeps crashing, especially when i dont skip the story. I want to buy characters, but if it crashes everytime i get invested...it feels worthless. Please, find a way to optimize it more. i want to play like i used to, but i dont feel like getting a whole new computer or tablet just because the game updates. Once again, thank you for your hard work.

Technically I would do a 4.5, but I viewed the "problems" as nitpicks and satisfied with the results as a whole. My phone is on a mid range scale of capabilities and able to run fairly smoothly with all options on higgest (I guess I'm on a high end? Though it could only handle 30 fps) the graphics have improved especially with the color scale. My only gripe here is that, new players might be overwhelmed. But people can get use to it after a while, its a big leap if you're not use to games.

I have been playing since the release 05/22/24 because I've heard about this game a long time ago, pretty much when I was still playing PGR and heard about Kuro. the graphics are really good like the scenery and all, as well as combat. I heard that this game was mostly focused on dodge and parry, which is true, and because of that it makes combat interesting. the characters are very well- designed as well and other body types likw Taoqi, Chixia, and many others. in mail, SO generous too.

I absolutely love this game, it's the only game I'm willing to spend. There's a bit of a problem in control when flying, it's why I bought a controller just for this but for those who don't, controls are bad in phone when flying. Also, idk if it's a bug but in echo flight challenge VII in Rinascita, I always run out of time and can't ever get to the finish line. I watched in yt and somehow they fly faster than I do. I hope this gets fixed or add more time to complete this challenge.

Incredible in so many ways!! I've been playing since day one, and this is definitely my favorite gacha. The combat system is very intuitive and fun. The story is deep, captivating and keeps getting better and better. Character designs are very thoughtful and unique. Team and character building is very well designed. I recommend playing on PC or console when possible. I play on PS5 or on my s24+ using a Bluetooth gamepad. You can play using touchscreen controls but its very difficult.

Amazing game. Gameplay is great, animation & scenery are beautiful, stories are unexpectedly compelling even for a side quest. And best of all, it's a player-driven game. You can play it at your own pace. Do all quests at any kind of order you like, you don't have to follow a linear progression in the game. I really enjoyed this system. Especially as a career man. Sometimes I want intense gameplay, but sometimes I want casual gameplay. This system allows me to play the game however I like

The game is AMAZING! Ive played for several hours nonstop, and all I can say is that I can't get enough of it.. the combat system is so unique! The dodging, parrying mechanic is what broke through all my expectations... The game actually required skills that can be honed over time of practice, which made it enjoyable.. the echo system is also very unique, unlike what I've seen from other gacha games.. and it runs smoothly, I don't even know what y'all talking about performance issues and bugs..

Overall a good game. Needs lots of QoL improvements as well as graphic polishing. The controls are bad tho. For example, the button to let go of grabbing somewhere is totally unnecessary. Also, there are many instances where some structures are not made well and characters kinda hover on them instead of climbing. Edit: the game is great but my phone can barely handle it. Needs optimization

I love the game, but it needs more optimization. I play on multiple devices, iPhone, Samsung Tablet and a computer. I have never run into any problems on the computer but i couldn't say the same for the mobile experience. It often crashes and for some reason on my samsung tablet it looked so blurry, even though I have it on medium to high graphics. I hope they fix this, because I am enjoying the game.

literally the best open world game right now. there is no game that can match the quality, gameplay, exploration facilities and overall experience of this beautiful game. the gacha system isn't an issue, in fact, I think it's pretty fair compared to other games. the only problem i would see is that it requires really good devices to play smoothly, but i think they have done a really good job until now. love you Kuro.

Very F2P friendly, has beautiful visuals and story. The game and its devs are constantly improving with every main update, most issues are quickly addressed and fixed.. however there are still a few problems, there is a severe lack of 4 stars, both weapons and characters, the game recently seems to also be leaning towards limited units also needing their signature weapons, however with all that said, theres next to no Powercreep, and the game has so much more to offer other than just characters.

The game itself is really good, and I'd totally recommend it to people wanting to get into a new gacha game. It's definitely f2p friendly, but you do need to invest time. I love competitive games mostly, but this game is still enjoyable because it's still challenging. You really gotta get used to the mechanics and have good reaction time. A problem is the a slight lack of combat events and end-game content, also for the love of God add flying to the starter area (Jinzhou).

The combat and movement is smooth if you are inside of the domain or inside the simulated universe(I forgot the name) but when you're in the open world it becomes a little bit laggy, but it is not laggy compared to the first day of release, there's also the problem with the high ping, whenever I enter the combat in the open world it will always show "reconnecting" which really affects my gameplay. But overall I'm pretty satisfied with the game. Please fix the optimization 🥲

I love the game a lot but this review stare is about the mobile version. I can't even play for long, it crashes so quickly. If I could play for long, my device might start to heat up. I have been playing game from the very start of when it came out. I was playing it on my laptop, that broke. I love the game and wish able to continue the game right at the moment. But mobile version doesn't work and I don't have a ps5, only a ps4 and it's not available on ps4. Only on ps5.

It was good, different playstyle than what I was expecting, and the graphics and stories are already amazing. Even the rewards and characters are good. The only problem is when I'm playing and it just randomly disconnects. Idk if it's my wifi or not, but overall. It's an amazing game. I hope the devs don't overwork themselves, and wish them goodluck and congrats 🎉🎉🎉👏👏👏 Edit ( it's really annoying me now that it keeps randomly disconnecting even when I'm in the right server )

It's a very good game, I've been playing it casually, and it doesn't take much time to figure out its mechanics. The fighting is especially fun and makes me have that satisfaction everytime I dodge and parry in time. This game is overall pretty fresh and I could only imagine and look forward on how KuroGames would be able to improve it. Just imagine if there was a gyro-mode... it would really be fantastic to have.

This game is absolutely incredible. The devs are so generous with the rewards and the bug fixes always come with well written apologies and some actually insane gifts. The animations are so smooth and well made. The story makes you want to know what's going on and you get very invested in it from the get go. The prices are very affordable and over all, the best gacha game I've ever played. The only issue is that I would ask to increase the echo leveling rewards because they are very few.

The game is extremely awesome! Although my phone is a potato I'll really love the game.. the skills, fighting style, the story and more! I've been waiting this game for about a year. What's the reason to rate the game low? Is it Lag?, Bugs?, glitches?, crashing?.. can you guys just stay calm until the devs fixed the issue? don't expect the game on not having isue on its first week of release. Just stay calm and wait for improvements..

Hello devs, you deserve my 5 stars. You listen to players unlike the other games. You guys are also generous, that's really rare for most games. I will continue supporting this game and so do my friends. I hope for better controls in mobile since the target focus is annoying sometimes and it wastes so much time to unfocus especially on Bell-borne. I also hope for the multiplayer party to be less complex because if one of us is offline, we can't kick them out and we have to manually party again.

What a great game! It's open world where you fight against monsters, bosses and so on. The fight quality is one of the best I've ever experienced. It feels so satisfying to even dodge or parry an enemy attack. For a gacha game, the developers are quite generous. The voice acting could be a little better, but other than that, truly a masterpiece.

Nice experience, I especially appreciate the fact it isn't as money grabby as other gacha games tend to be. Yes, there is fanservice, but I don't find it annoying or overwhelming in the context of the game. Love the character designs, amimations and exploration. I just find it very very hard to keep up because of the increasing difficulty of pretty much everything.

Very good game, good story and graphics I love it and it gives out lots of rewards probably one of the best open world games I've played so far. But it has it issues like lag and all so I hope one day they make an account transfer option since I've seen a lot of players who went abroad and have issues with signal because of the country they're currently in or they can't join their friends because they're in different servers so I hope KURO adds an account transfer option in the near future.

Might be biased but I am loving the game so far. Released pretty late though so haven't been able to play through the story that much. It made me remember why genshin impact was so fun for me at first, I read the story and learned how to play and it was a fun time during those newbie days. Witnessing the gameplay once I have a better grasp of the mechanics I'm sure the game will be more enjoyable than I realized.

The best game in my opinion, and definitely a breath of fresh air after Genshin. I love the gameplay, and I love the mechanics. The characters might need a bit more work, but the diverse animations and the lore really made up for it. I don't mind female playable characters, but I do wish there's more male characters. Kuro Games seem like they have the potential to make good-looking male characters than Genshin, I hope we have more characters like Brant, Aalto, Xiangli Yao, etc. Overall, amazing!

Hi, im a SOL 3 RANK 8 Player Level 80, its an Immersive world teeming with gorgeous animations, an enthralling plot, lovable characters, and meticulously designed enemies that will push new players to their limits in strategic trios, using a variety of elements or even the same, as they learn the game mechanics and, if they choose to continue the story, push their limits even further. F2Ps can and will have fun with this game because it's more than just a story; it's an adventure. Have fun.

This game is amazing and it keeps getting better. The combat, the story, the world, the characters, the music, the events, the rewards... I had problems running the game on my old device but since I got a better one I must say the game runs amazingly well. Outstanding job Kuro Games, you keep making the game better with every patch and taking in the community's feedback. Keep it up!

One of my favorite games ever, keep cooking, Kuro! Although, I wanted to suggest that you could make the echo leveling system the same as the weapon leveling system; that is, allow non-leveled up echos to be used as exp material to upgrade other echos as well. The fact that there is only one kind of echo exp (although divided in levels) and the fact that we have a daily limit to waveplates, makes it hard since not all of us have the time to farm every day TwT That was all!

It's the best gacha open world game you could ever experience! Why? Mainly because you are not forced to whale to clear content, if you don't have the skill you can't clear it anyway. The game is not easy and that's what make it fun. Parrying, slowmo after dodging. The combat just feels so smooth. The best thing abt this game tho is the dev. Most of the stuff players ask for is getting added into the future patches. Not only that, they are very generous, the signarue weapon banner is GUARANTEED!

It's a gacha game that I thought would be the same with every other game, but turned out to exceed my expectations. Now it's the only gacha game I play. If you love good combat, complex mechanics, and skill-based content, play this game. Even if you don't like complex stuff and just want to chill, wuthering waves also has something for you. The game has something for everyone to enjoy.

I don't normally do reviews, but this game is really far beyond anything you can imagine. The graphics are astonishing. The story like amazed me so much that I'm hooked on to it. The part that interested me most is players can absorb the enemies you fought and play with them by using their skills, making the game more versatile. No complains can be make.

okay, so..why is there co-op if we can't even explore together? For example, moving those things to do the puzzles , I mean even if it's allowed only by the owner of the server, it'll be way more fun rather than just be restricted for both , like cmon should we just fight..? It's so fun to play and 'explore' with friends and others yet we're not even allowed that , and don't even get me started on the chat , like when I open it , it lags so hard and it sends me to the top , messages aren't sendi

Beautiful character designs and open world, a lot like genshin. The best part is definetly the battle system. I love how easy it is to farm for echos, and how they actually give you abilities. For a gacha game, it's also pretty f2p friendly, at least for now. The devs also seem to care a lot about the community, as they fix any bugs or issues quickly, and always compensate the players. great game, I would definetly reccomend.

Overall the game itself is good, of course for its upcoming first week of global release there are some issues but the devs did their best to assess these issues ASAP and I am grateful that they listen to the audience. I hope players will value the content of the game and the team behind it as its own, give the game a chance— exploring is fun, the story doesn't feel rush- just enough and enriching, and the battle mechanic is quite tactical (dodge and combo mechanic).

Very good game, although there were some bugs, but eh, it was fine. I can deal with it. The game overall was good. I don't care if it's laggy since it's my phone that's the problem. Honestly, Kuro, you shouldn't overwork yourselves. The game just released, so take time to relax. My experience with this game is good. Decent rewards, no element reaction. I love the characters. The story is also good; not too short, not too long, very good pace. I highly recommend it. Once again, thank you, Kuro.

the team did a great job!! they listen to the players' complain and even gave us many apologies gift for their mistakes, i love the exploration and the combat style, i just hope it won't be too laggy since my phone isn't the best, but it's definetely okay, it's a new game and it's reasonable to have many bugs. for everyone: just be patient and please don't be mean, they're trying their best to fix the bug asap :)

This would be a full five star if the game didn't heat up my phone and crash when the game isn't hooked to wifi/5G. Otherwise, this is a beautifully done gacha style rpg with a rich storyline, and choices that let you interact with both sides of the battle while keeping you on your toes about which side are the good guys. Also, I would love if this game, or another allowed you the choice to play either for the yin or yang side.

One of the best open world game I've ever played. The gacha system is good, even though I get what I didn't want, it still gives me plenty of characters that are strong regardless of meta. They are all useful in there on way especially the MC who's really busted and powerful, never regret building him. There are more ways to play the game and one I love the most is traveling the world, collecting scattered treasures and farming echoes.

This is a great gacha game with incredible graphics, combat, exploration, and content. The developers are extremely generous and should be commended. On the first week of playing, I got 6 five-star characters. Only by their generosity was I able to get more five-stars in a single week than I got in any other gacha game, and I mean any. Keep in mind that being generous doesn't mean we won't spend money because I will definitely be spending money on this game despite the devs' generosity.

A free to play friendly open world souls game done right. The characters are beautiful, and the boss battles are challenging with great AI. The devs gave everyone a free 5-star character selector and a free 5 star limited character who is very strong and relevant even now. If I just update this review every time they give out something for free, I'd run out of space. The free main character is also very strong. You just have to get over the rough start in the story for the first 4 chapters.

I think the multiplayer aspect is somewhat lacking. We get events where players can play together or against each other but in the normal overworld unless you're a lower level player coop mode just exists in a weird state. So what if in the future there's a weekly boss that has 2 phases where players are attacking different sections of the boss with some gimmicks. I don't know but i think that will be cool

I love this game a lot. Great characters (wish there were more male designs), but overall a really solid game. However when the new update dropped, I think 2.4 I was asked to download an extra 33 GB, which my Pixel 7 just couldn't handle.
