I wish the Wuthering Waves team could compress these files so everyone can play without running out of space on their device.

Installed this game because I got a new phone and my friend asked me to test it, it was only supposed to be a benchmark run. About a month later I've completed the game up to the latest patch, by complete I meant it, 100% exploration on all regions, main story, companion story, you name it, literally nothing else to do but a few stages of end game content, but that's unnecessary unless you're a hardcore player. I also spent a considerable amount of money for a mobile game so be wise!

game is really good, lots of things to do, combat and exploration is fun, mechanics is not very complicated. This game fixes it's problems FAST. Clearly the devs have passion in this game. Fixed the problems in just a matter of hours and the amount of rewards is ridiculous, this game is so generous I never saw a game this generous to it's players. The gameplay keeps becoming more fun the longer you play. Overall this game is a must play.

I love this game, and I'm very picky with my games. I also like the exploration aspect of the game, even though some 100% completions and resonator/weapon leveling requirements are a bit annoying and grindy to obtain. I look forward to any expansions to the world of WuWa! I also think it'd be a great idea for your character to have a "home" that you can decorate while exploring the world.

First time I've ever spent money on a gacha game. The story is good, the gameplay and graphics are amazing, the music is great, and the character design is good and improving. You can switch between two genders of the MC, and so many quality of life features like sustained sprint. The only gripe I have with the game is it heats up my device fast, but I'm playing on the highest settings so I guess it's understandable. To keep my device 42°C and below, I play in front of a fan or somewhere cold.

My expectations before I started playing the game was very low. After about playing for a month or so, I have to say WuWa is actually such a good game. One of my many reasons for liking the game is because they took so many aspects from Genshin Impact and vastly improved upon it. For example, the stamina bar, the mobility, and the free rewards they give out. I would go into detail about how they improved upon these, but I feel like that should rather be experienced first hand.

Great graphics / visuals, a slow start and a little too much dialogue when you just want to play. More of an epic RPG than a mobile game. but better than hoyoverse's installment of the same, for sure. don't expect to be able to bash anything out in a quick 5 minute play session. excellent fighting moves and lots of variation moves/character. get it you'll like it. Just give it a chance.

I played through launch and I didn't mind the bugs and imperfections of the game but I quit, since I didn't get Jiyan as my 1st 5 star, a year later my friends adamantly forced me to play, but I thought that it was a lot of work and was hesitant. But when I tried it myself, I found myself having fun, the stories were phenomenal, the voice lines improved, everything in general improved for the better, not to mention the banger soundtrack in the main story line, game's better than a certain gacha

The game has been SMOOTH since the release of 1.4, I still experienced a bit of the lag but all I know is that compared to the release of the game, it's getting smooth now, I'm getting maybe around 50-60 FPS now depending on the device temperature. I appreciate Kuro Games staffs for their hardworks on the game, I know y'all must be tired on improving the game for our enjoyment. The game has been improved since the release. I'm looking forward for the new features to come out, KEEP IT UP KURO! 🔥

One of the "best" games I have ever played along with Dragon Nest. The developers, I commend their hardwork in regards to resolving issues in the game as well as giving a generous amount of rewards and compensations. I wish to see how the game will progress in regards to their development. I like the story, gameplay, gacha mechanics and all of it. I hope they kept doing what they're currently doing for the best of the game itself. Kudos to you Kuro, your efforts are appreciated more.

Probably one of the best games currently out on mobile. The combat is pretty fun and the game is balanced. You get three good characters without having to spend resources. Fun minigames around the map. Beautiful world that's free to roam - it's HUGE - with no loading screens or anything. Very responsive app with little time between fast travels or loading it up. This game is wild to be a mobile game, but probably takes up 20+ gb. Damn worth it though.

Game is amazing. Amazing combat, visuals, and graphics. The story is also very enjoyable, and even if it weren't, you could skip it with a provided summary. Character building is decent, graphics are phenomenal; and the game is very f2p. So much QoL, and devs listen to player feedback (mostly). My one complaint is that I literally cannot play it on my phone. It takes up an insane amount of space, and it overheats my device very quickly, and it crashes. I highly recommend just playing on PC.

The game has a semblance of skill-based combat, but don't be fooled, if you want to beat timed encounters, you need to make sure you have enough gear and characters that can dish out the damage. As all gacha games, many currencies exist to make you lose track of how much money you really need if you want to guarantee a drop. For example, at the time of this writing, the only way to guarantee the limited-time resonator is to spend £100. Looks good, many game modes, the story is boring.

some things in this game were a little hard to do but I got to union level 40 and I couldn't figure out how to do the quest that allows you to get higher levels. otherwise I loved the game, the graphics where so good and the character designs are honestly better then genshin impact which I used to play. another down side is I had to delete a lot of my other apps because it takes up a lot of storage

Honestly one of my favorite games right now, mobile or not. If you like Genshin, this is that but better. Honestly, I only have one small complaint; the translation. It's not awful, it's mostly just word choice. It feels like the translators were trying to be very accurate which just ends up feeling stiff. For instance, someone losing control of their powers is called overclocking, but the theme of the game is sound. Why wouldn't you go with cacophony or something, it's out of place.

Everything is great, they're improving little by little. One thing I'd like to mention is that the phone heats up after running the game for even a few minutes, and the characters' voice lines in English are kind of horrible, robotic and I'd rather listen to Japanese or Korean ones. Hope they will fix that as well. Oh also the game is more pleasant if you're either male or only like female characters. Lovely fan service, for men.

In my 1 month of playing this game all I can say is that it's a solid RPG. Gives you a ton of things to do while giving you a lot of rewards and grinding here is easy. Characters are amazing, the plot is better than I expected, mechanics is easy basically just parry then you'll be okay and the graphics are pretty cool, parkour is a thing in this game, the challenges isn't bad but it's not good either, anyways you can just skip it if you don't want to do it. Overall this game is a solid 4.8 or 5

So far, so good. I've been playing on my Samsung tablet, and it's not laggy. I've seen some bugs, but nothing too bad. I have to mention that the story is very interesting and the battle experience is fun. They copied Genshin a lot, but that's not necessarily a bad thing. It makes it easier to comprehend. Since I am a Genshin player, I felt immediately familiarized with the game. Also, I think it's more F2P friendly... for now

Love the game so far. I have noticed since launch, I still can't enter the log-in info myself and it acts as if my account doesn't exist yet when I click on google (or even the other log in options) where it puts the info for me, I have no problems. Learned my lesson the hard way when I couldn't log back in on a new device and had to start over.

So far, so good! The game so far is very generous and I love the world building. I'm aware that optimization especially on mobile devices is an issue, but I'm sure KuroGames are doing their best to fix it. It's very sad when people have to compare new open-world RPG games like this to Genshin, as if Genshin didn't have a rought start like lag issues on mobile. I'm sure as time goes by, KuroGames will find a way to optimize the game, just like how every other game does so. Keep up the good work!

It may be a little rough around the edges, but this game has huge potential, and you can already tell the devs care more about the playerbase and their opinions than a certain other similar game and their greedy devs. All of that aside, and despite the mildly rocky start, this game is beautiful and a blast to play and has many unique features that help it stand out from the others in the genre. Easy 4, with potential to be 5 stars one day. Especially at the rate it's going.

Open world gacha game. With combat as the main focus and the best part of the game. Having a variety of mobs and bosses along with different characters makes it fun. The story starts slow but gets better down the line. Music is decent in the beginning but also gets better down the line. The developers are the best. They listen to the players and shows it in the updates.

This game has a lot of potential, I mean A LOT. It is still starting so a lot of bugs and many service problems. Lots of player are complaining about the game and I think that's a pretty ridiculous. They should wait for the developers to act not just giving low rating the game. We should consider the potential of the game. And please, PLEASE DON'T COMPARE GENSHIN IMPACT to wuthering waves. They have many differences.To the developers, please continue to develop the game. Thank you!!!

Beautiful characters and scenery, overly verbose dialogue scenes, moving stories, and one of the stingiest gachas I've ever had the misfortune of encountering. More of a tease: "Look what you could play if you use your credit card." Would not recommend unless you have disposable income. Play Nikke or Aether Gazer if you want a legitimate chance at playing with characters you actually want.

This game has the potential to be one of the, if not THE best gacha game existing. The graphics are beautiful, combat is amazing and the character design is great. However, despite all this, it's missing originality, you can find most of the things in this game in other gacha games, it needs something that seperates it from the rest. I found the mechanics to be extremely similar to another gacha game, same things, different names.

Dear Kuro games, As someone who played a lot of gachas that poorly incorporated open- world mechanics into it. This game is certainly different from that and special compared to any other in the mobile market. Diff. curve is fun and nothing is forced. Exploration of Solaris-3 has been truly rewarding in terms of level progress. The more I explored, the more I was visually enriched by the beautiful sights and sceneries. Also the lore and concept behind WuWa is just as enriching intellectually!

I really like it, the graphics are cool and amazing. The characters are original and really fun to use in combat,their personality is also amazing, the only thing I don't like about this is that u can't have materials from certain characters u got from another region in the game, and can't level them up above 40,it was really annoying and I resulted to using non meta units but it was kinda hard. I would really love it if you would add a store to purchase/obtain that material easier

Yo, so I tried Genshin and ToF, but I couldn't even finish the first chapter. But Wuwa, man, that game is different. I don't know why, but it's just so much more enjoyable. Maybe it's the combat. The parry and perfect dodge mechanics make it feel so much more alive. Or maybe it's because the developers are so generous with the gifts they give out for rolling banners and upgrading materials. And the characters, they're so lovable and feel so much more alive. Jiyan is totally like Zhao Yun.

I play this on PC mainly, but honestly my favorite gacha game, you don't even need to spend money on the game and can still catch up to whales that spend money lavishly pretty easy, the combat is so fun, the visuals are stunning, and the story has me in tears, I love it, genuinely a 10/10 game, AND YOU CAN PLAY IT ON THE PHONE?!? it just keeps getting better, devs are actively working and pumping content and shoving rewards down your throat, I want to spend money but the devs just give it to you

Played on launch and dropped it. Came back for version 2.0 and I have to say, this is one of the best open world games. Exploration is fun and rewarding unlike another open game. Story is more interesting now. Combat has always been good. Reserve AP should be a bit higher instead of just 400. Needs a theater mode as well. Love that the devs care and don't encourage players to stay logged in for more than a few hours since a pop up will let you know that you've been playing for awhile.

This game— how do I say? Is very unique in its own way, from the gameplay, to the artsyle, qnd even the sceneries in game. However there are some lackluster elements in the game which is the story, and the character personalities itself. Aside from this game is overall fantastic and amazing, and I hope to see more future updates for this beautiful game.

Let's be honest in a lot of ways, this game is just genshin. BUT imo this is far better than genshin. The combat is far superior, the exploration and puzzles are far more interesting. The farming doesn't feel as tedious, and the company seems to ACTUALLY care which is great. They don't just want your money. Hopefully, they continue to be a great company and hopefully, the voice acting will be improved, and some of the more grindy bits are made more lenient and they add more co-op stuff!

I would give it a 5, but the constant lagging and crashing had made me lose my patience. I mean, it was good, so far. But when the game got updated, I hated it. I can't even play properly. Actually, I can't even play because it keeps crashing every time I open it. I understand, though. The game's graphics are amazing. The characters, gameplay, storyline, everything! It's amazing. But, I'm upset that the game isn't optimised for phones. Hoping for the next update, the game would be optimised!!

This is my first time playing a game like this and I like it so much that I played despite the lag (My phone has low RAM storage). I'm hooked! The stories in the quests are so nice so far, I really love the story & the art is so good too. I especially love the hidden achievements!! 😂 I've only found one so far but I'm definitely keeping an eye out for more. Thanks for the awesome game !! <3

This Game has been a blast. Ive been playing since release and the game has been improving ever since. The characters are great, no doubt every single one of them has effort put on to them during their creation. Open world Exploration is ridiculously fast and dont even get me started with the skip button for those lengthy quests. Overall, Its a great game, keep it up kuro.

I've been playing this game for 5 hours straight and I'm having fun, I don't seem to have any of the loading or glitch ingredients issues other reviewers seem to have, the only time I've gotten kicked was when I went to another app, and even then it was only once. I love the character designs and the graphics are beautiful, then again I just love open world gacha games so I may be a bit biased. Keep up the amazing work I plan to keep playing.

Some of the character designs leave a lot to be desired but otherwise a very fun game, I love the characters and the worldbuilding and the events have been exciting and fun as well. I just want to have the option to use my own characters in trial areas as opposed to the given trial when I already own them. My own personal Jiyan was 6x stronger than the trial when I finished out the Jinzhou story and I would have liked to have used him instead of the much weaker trial version.

the graphics in this game are absolutely gorgeous, and even if sometimes I get a bit of lag it's quickly fixed and I don't think it's the game's fault. I think the exploration in Wuthering Waves is the best I've ever experienced and the grapple and flight features make it incredibly easy and relaxing for me, also the unlimited sprint. I find the gacha system to be good as well with the max pity being 80 and weapon banner getting it's own wishes. over all, I recommend playing it♥

actually it's good, because it's still in the early stages of launch, it's normal for a little problem to occur... I hope the next patch will improve again soon, I have full hope for this game. Additionally, please add more languages, especially Indonesian, to the game, and fonts that might be a little more attractive, and more optimized so that playing battles is more comfortable. I expect a lot from developers and games, LESSGGOO KUROOGAMEEE!!!

The game is amazing! Kuro games and it's Devs are very generous and are quick when fixing bugs. Frankly I don't know why some are complaining so much when the game has just been released barely 48 hours ago. The game play is great, characters are life-like and I don't know about you guys but the colour palette is refreshing! Although you might see a lot of criticism about how the game has been crashing and has multiple issues I have not experienced any of them. Keep it up kuro games and Devs! <3

Great game, the mechanics on this game is excellent, especially wall running. The events are free to play friendly too! And the combat is just amazing, theres nothing bad about this game, since it is very friendly towards free to play players, you could also want to spend money on this game to progress faster. Since the release from 6 months ago, you guys have been improving! The devs are also kind, they listen to players thoughts. Overall, a good game that has been rapidly improving. Kudos!

Hehe loved the characters, the gameplay. I honestly admire the essence that the beasts have, they feel real and cool. I shamelessly used a game booster in order to play smoothly, and it was worth it. I hope one day I won't need it anymore. This game has a lot of potential, so until proven otherwise, I'll give the game a five star review.

i really love the game, it's so much fun my favorite feature in the game was the replay dialogue of the main story, companion quests, etc. i was wondering (and suggesting if possible) if y'all can add the replay scene(s) next time, alongside with cutscenes, etc. that would be great overall, i like the game, please keep in mind this is just a suggestion, thank you!

I love Wuthering Waves! I recently took a long hiatus from it due to Echo farming being incredibly annoying. However, i recently downloaded it again to give it another try, and i was thrilled to see a lot of the issues I felt ruined it had been fixed a bit! i love that they listen to their user base and implement qol updates that continuously improve the game. other than that, i love the game play mechanics and i enjoy that some of the events are more chill and silly rather than only serious.

Although first impression makes or breaks a game, wuthering waves is a diamond in the rough. With the feedback they are receiving, the developers are actively fixing the issues we are encountering and as of writing this review, make the mobile version playable. Stick it with it and ride the (wuthering) waves and I am sure you will have a good time if you like dmc combat with dark souls dodging and parrying.

Playing on PC (and strongly recommend to), came here just for review. Good game, outstanding by some parameters. All basic systems work as usual, but... We have actually acting protagonist. Game allow them to be smart, strong and have own cool moments, not just breathing wall that everyone love for some reason. You even have some space for rpg, even if its just some shift in movitation. Our times already This exceptional, and... yes, it is. I can respect my hero, and who made him as well.

Okay so far, this is a pretty good game compared to genshin and stuff. It feels like there's more story, and you have a reason for doing stuff, unlike some other games. It feels like I'm playing one of the older Zelda games(windwaker, twilight), because of the story and execution. Combat is good, the style is nice. I like the character design, and dialogue. It gives more options for player dialogue than usual which I appreciate. Im super excited to continue with it, hopuflly it's not like totk

I played on both PC and Android, and oh boy. What's my favorite? The combat- I mean, you can parry & dodge, what else do I need to say. The fast paced high octane action complemented by the amazing music, chefs kiss. And complains? The overworld music keeps stopping and this weird echo keeps reverbrating as the character walks. The walking is a bit janky, funny even. I don't think it runs as smoothly as it should on both platforms but I'm sure those things will be improved in upcoming update.

Congrats Kuro Games. IMHO 3.1 is yet another top performance on top of 2.2 and 2.5. If you like any of ARGM, this is definitely an enjoyable game for you to resonate with the story lines. it's like watching a cinema rated movie. Kuro Games is listening to players and not arrogance since day 1. keep up the production.

Wuthering waves is an amazing game, and it's not just because of the gameplay, story, and characters. It's also about the developers being able to listen and agree with players, which feels like we have a say in things. Kuro games also wants players to have the best experience, and it shows with the rewards and the effort put in the game.

Having a lot of fun exploring and fighting, but as soon as I have to get back to the main story I instantly wanna quit. I get it's a gacha game and people prefer female characters, but it's simply too much to the point it's really annoying me. There are like 3-4 female "companions" besides the already female main companion. It's impossible to actually emerce myself into the story. For every 4/5 females there is maybe only 1 male, it's too much. The LingYang story was great.

Amazing games for people who are thinking of genshin while playing this game to compare the two. It's important to keep in mind that this game just dropped while you are comparing genshin, who has had time to build itself up. My honest answer is that this game has a lot to improve, but it's amazing as is. I love the combat style and character design as well.

What makes this game really good is the story and characters, even if it is bland, they're fighting skills are fun to play, although it's laggy and glitchy, you don't have to buy stuff, just play and earn a lot, and Kuro you guys are awesome, I like how you will fix a game if players are dealing issues, thank you for that, this is my opinion, but I say play this game because, how do you not like it if you never tried it?

Beautiful game. I love the combat style and how each character has a different play style, even if they have the same exact role. Ie: Carlotta and Jinhsi both deal damage with attacks considered Resonance Skill damage but they both have different play styles. Echo system is also handled beautifully. You can go out and farm in the overworld. Combat is flawless. Dodging and parrying is so satisfying. Not to mention, you can swap out and do different attacks during long animations a character. 5⭐

this game is SUPER cool, man. like, actually. I love how all the characters have slightly different body types from each other despite being off the same base. their facial proportions, how beefy they are, its awesome. no two characters look alike except the ones with the same shade of hair color. the combat is so expressive and fun, too. I can't wait to see more. 😎👍

In the first launch worldwide, I didn't experience any bugs or whatever. However, I think that the optimazization it's quite lacking at this time and in the 2nd day, my phone seem to be force close after trying to login in game. But I believe with Kuro team that this problem will be solved in the meantime. So thank you for making this game. I love the character style, the world in Wuwa is also so huge, and the NPCs/monsters feel so alive here. Good job Kuro Team.

This game....I love it. I'm waiting for this game to come out on the PlayStation, but yeah. This game is amazing. There's no stamina cost for farming your echos. That's a definite win for me. The combat is like Kuros' other games. These guys, btw, are the people who made punishing grey raven. Another game you guys need to check out if you like this one. Both games are something you're definitely not gonna be disappointed with. I'll see you delightful bastards in there!!

I haven't touched RPG for years, mainly because it's very time consuming and as a working adult, I don't have the time and energy for it to concentrate, but for wuwa, theres a skip option for most storyline and let's say the quest is ongoing and you need to leave, you can join again without restart from the beginning, it's very easy with all the guides that's going on, especially for newbies, there's also many options for you to teleport and if you don't have time, u can synthesis it on the spot

I absolutely ADORE this game to pieces. The graphics are stunning, I love the lore, characters and the world building. But since the 2.0 came out I cannot play it for longer than 10 minutes at a time. I had to set my graphics to the lowest of low and even then it says they're too high for my device. I didn't have that struggle before 2.0. My game is constantly lagging ever since. I cannot open up the in game news or the banner history without the game closing. Pls fix this for mobile players.

Have been playing it since the start of it. It's a really good game and every time a new character comes out, I can't help but feel so excited. I love the story and everything in the game. I love how Kuro updated the waypoint that can heal. The fight in this game is hella awesome. Kuro is so generous with the waveplates and astrite. Also, please add more male characters 🥲, a handsome one too. I need more male characters 😫. Maybe a male character with aero element.

Combat is top tier, i just hope they fix the info-dump of yangyang on the prologue. I feel like i missed a lot in the story, couldn't focus at all when she starts talking. She dropped 10 patches worth of lore in the first 10 minutes of the game and it was a lot to take in for a begginer. She said a lot of jargon and terms i couldn't understand, it doesn't help that the lines are bugged and kept cutting off ^^` Overall, this game is on par with that other one, just the story.

It's great! this is my first time truly enjoying these types of games; I've been playing it for 2-5hrs a day and even reached union 45 yesterday. However, after the new update my game kept crashing after opening it for less than a few minutes along with the screen sensitivity being way too high. I tried adjusting it from the settings, placing it at 10 or less, yet my sensitivity is still too high. Also the lag is much more apparent than it used to.

I can't even lie to you guys, and I simply won't. Wuthering Waves is like another gacha game.. Okay. But the cutscenes, the graphics, the voice acting, the characters themselves are literally astronomical. And building the characters, is easy! You can see the exact amount of materials you need left.. even if the character isn't out, like when Qiuyuan originally wasn't. Or others that will soon come out. Please download!

Yet this games isn't a 10/10 on phone, this game in general is amazing. The characters are pleasing to the eye as well as practically everything else in the games such as landscapes and battles. I do highly recommend this be played on PC. I love the story and there are many things to do in the games such as collect characters, understand characters better, side quests, daily quests, and finding chests and locations. I'm not joking when I say that I can't even play Genshin Impact anymore.

This game is amazing,it has gorgeous graphics and battle mechanics! The only issue is me. I don't have time to play it,I have work and more work to do and attend to😅 What can I say, growing up sucks.I can't keep it on my phone cuz it takes a lot of memory(even though I have enough),and let's not talk about how GORGEOUS IS ON PC!! So if you want amazing graphics and battle mechanics then this is for you. (The story's amazing too let's not forget about that) Thisisan amazinggameifyouhavetime!

If you haven't played this game, you are simply just missing out. In modern gaming industry, there barely are devs that listens and reacts to comments and advices from players. These people do, and makes the changes basically within the next few patches. This already simply put this game a great player base. Gameplay wise, there are so much difficulty and exploration variations. Movements are very streamlined and modernized, with fast wall climbing, and spot dodging and parrying. 5 star.

I absolutely love this game. The exploration, the story, the characters. As a Genshin player, sometimes when there's nothing to do, I just come back to Wuthering Waves for a while and play what I missed. I never feel bored in this game, even though I 100% everything! I love how easy it is to build characters and get Echos too. I never feel like it's too boring or grindy. Definitely would recommend if you need a break from Genshin or just want a generous gacha game, I'd definitely recommend Wuwa

Hooked from the first swing! Combat is insanely smooth even for mobile version (as I mainly play on PC) , the world is gorgeous with UE5, and every character feels unique and different from each other with they Forte system and mechanics. Sure, it needs some tweaks like the echo system (Gear system in this game) has way too RNG, but overtime they always improving the game. Overall, a great ARPG with huge potential and devs who actually listen to the community. Definitely worth playing!

It's very great, has a ton of huge potential however I do not think this game is really compatible with many devices. I've played genshin impact, honkai star rail, zenless zone zero. This game has a lot of interesting things like the games I've just mentioned but it's missing compatibility, both my laptop and phone which should be considered very great for games like these lags a lot, even in the lowest settings. I recommend optimizing the game to be even just slightly less laggier. That's all.

Game is great can be fully played free to play, you can finish game in 10 hours or so, after that however is where my issue is. After main story all you do is wait for wave plates ( energy system ) to claim reward from bosses or material farm dungeon and then you log out, takes 24 hours to get full wave plates and it takes you 5 minutes to spend it all. Not much to do at all in " mid to late game " Its a very slow over time grind. Some of the movements are kinda off as well. 6,8/10 my rating.

It's one of the best gacha games I have played. Awesome story and great cutscenes. The feature I wish the game has is the ability to replay past completed story/chapter again; the game only had text logs to review past events. Even though co op is available, most of the content can be played solo. It is also possible to switch playing the same account between multiple platforms, and the game runs smoothly both in my mobile and PC. 0 issues so far.

This is a breath of fresh air in the gacha game space, with engaging action combat that sets it apart from others. At UL 61, I've felt the progression to be well paced and to be rewarding, the events, mini games, puzzles and alternative game modes to be very entertaining. The story, as any, has some slow moments, but compensates with beautiful cinematics and cool moments. On top of this, the gacha itself is rather fair in my op. The only counter, is the mobile performance and game requirements.

very fun and entertaining game, but 1 thing I don't like is the fact that in the 1st phase you always have nee zones to explore, fun events, great main quests and everything is absolutely amazing. but in the 2nd phase, you barely have any events going on, nothing to do or explore and if you want the character, you can't get him cause you got nothing to farm for him.

this is the best, and i mean the BEST gacha game I've ever played. The characters are AMAZING, especially in design and uniqueness, the combat mechanics are too. It's generous with the ingame currency, and the thing I love most about it is the little things that makes the game easy to play, like grappling hook, flight, instant healing, etc. (especially skipping dialogue) its just extremely well made overall, props to everyone who had a part in this game.

Phenomenal game. I love the characters, fast paced combat, exploration, building characters, the music. It's all great stuff. It's a really tough game to run on mobile, though. I play on a SD8+Gen 1 tablet and it can get pretty laggy. Version 3.0 has been especially rough. Apart from some optimization issues, it's a great game and I highly recommend.

For the first time playing, it was fun. the rng drops is why I left. I spent money and in game currency for 3 months. Still could get the character I wanted even with choice selection. It was beautiful story, graphics, not bad for an anime game. This is just like Geshin impact. I was able to get the character I wanted no problem. couldn't in this game. Finally I uninstalled, because the elemental combat is getting boring. Can't play who I want most. For me this is a "Dead End Game"

I love this game beyond my heart. I love the graphics, the story, the challenges. But with the recent update, the battles are getting laggy and usually ends up the game stopping and kicking me out of the game resulting for me to go back again from the start. I don't know if it's a bug from the update recently, I tried checking my internet connection and resetting my phone it always ends up the same. I hope this gets fixed.

After the new update, the game crashes and has bugs, even in log screen, and also the first five minutes of any combat I do. Then, after 15 minutes or so, it kicks me out of the game completely!! There was no such problems before the 2.8 update. please fix the issues. Edit: Stop ignoring the mobile players. Even my high-end phone can't handle this anymore. Don't make me quit the game, Kuro.

has one of the best combat gameplay out of all the big name games out there. where its dropping the ball is story, once a banner character passes us by, they are basically removed from the story. I don't know of many other devs that do this aside from Kuro Games, but here we are with this situation. I understand the new character has to sell, and you need a setup to allow that, but will whales really sit and play through the entire update before pulling? No!

it's superbly interesting and very engaging , the mechanics battle is more diverse and entertaining , maybe my only complaint is in the graphics or art style , i think it's doesn't mean it's bad , it's just that I'm new in the game and not yet accustomed to the game , I'm usually playing Genshin Impact after all . do you have any recommendations for the guaranteed 5 star characters ? hopefully the one you can fully invest until late game. Thanks. . Good Luck .

Been playing since release, and while the launch was messy, I can feel the devs' willingness to improve their game with every update. The combat is stellar and just so satisfying that it makes me think it's the core of every Kuro game. The open-world gives Triple A game vibes and I'm here for it. The characters are loveable, and the story is poignant. The English localization has gotten better, but I do feel like there's still some room for improvement. Overall, I enjoy this game an awful lot.

The game is way more amazing than I thought and I also really like the combat a lot it's really engaging but I'm having ping problems even though I picked the recommended sever.... sometimes I pick an item it's delayed even though I clicked on it so many times...... And some of the voice lines are sometimes cut off or just doesn't say they're lines 😕

I've been playing this game for a month now, and there's no word I can say that can describe the feeling I get whenever I'm playing it. The graphics, soundtracks, characters, the fast-paced combat experience, to name a few, and the story that comes with it are just so rich that it captivates me every time I'm doing my main quests. I know Kuro games worked very hard to make this game, and I hope you continue to do so and make it better and more enjoyable than ever. I'm going to log back in, so...

Love the game it's very similar to genshin but I find that the combat is so much smoother in ww and I enjoy it more. The characters are also nice and balanced with a good chance to pull someone good. I find that it's very hard to pull a good character in genshin and even the lower stat characters skills combat etc SUCKS. Meanwhile in ww even lower stat characters are enjoyable and balanced However I had to stop playing at some point because the file became too big for my phone.. 🥲

I love it, I've been waiting to play since beta. There is still polishing up needed for certain things. But kuro is working really hard to fix it. They were so generous for what they have given out so far from problem. This game has so much potential and I can't wait to see the future. I'd be so upset to see the game end. So kuro if you're reading this YOU GOT THIS! CANT WAIT TO SEE WHAT YOU HAVE IN STORE FOR EVERYONE!. -P.S. also waiting for PS5 release. ♡♡♡

Really good combat system, quick acting & generous dev, fun overall. My only issue I had with this game is the real slog that is the weirdly written early story chapters which got better past chapter 3. I hope that we get more variety with unit designs, and for already existing units to receive attention every now and then, hell I think some units have more potential if given new combo/movesets. Overall, great game.

I've played since release and overall it's been reallyy fun and enjoyable to play since i didn't experience any lag or buggy issues. I love the post-apocalypse map and the combat experience are trulyy to my liking. not to mention the characters are so well-made, and this game is really f2p friendly. shoutout to kuro games for creating wuthering waves !!! "LOVE YOU KURO GAMES" we all say in unison. (they deserve 5 star rating!!!)

Hello, just going to ask here for a quick sec, am I the only one who's lose my grappler in game? mine gone, after a few times used. is a bug? I would really appreciate it if you could fix it for me. I really do enjoy the game but the laggy and the side bugs such as this problem of still occurred. I hope you can take note of this problem and fix it.

Very good game. I play this on my pc at home but thought I'd leave a review here anyway. The graphics are beautiful and all the characters feel unique in their gameplay combat, I never get bored of it. Pretty decently f2p friendly as well! I of course, wouldn't recommend playing if your device can't handle heavy games such as this but overall I think WuWa has a lot of potential and is one of the better games out there, especially in terms of the devs listening to their community for QOL.

Amazing game with cinematic cutscenes and a cool storyline. As someone who played a gacha game or two every year this is one of the best experiences I've had with a gacha game. ESPECIALLY as a newly released one. Of course there's a few bugs, some lagging issues and a few typos but this game has genuinely opened my eyes to what could be a cool gacha game experience. I've even bought in-game purchases when I never do that and stayed f2p. Thanks for your work Kuro, I hope this continues on ♥️

The gameplay is good, the story is amazing, and the characters are so pretty. But the size? Insane. It went up to 5 GB from the last update. (29 GB before. After the update is 34GB) I love you Kuro, really do. I spent money on this game. But it's just the size that infuriates me. Plus, there's no delete past mission resource. Like, what do you mean I still have that cutscene from 1.0? It's just a waste of space. Please do something with the size. Or just make it exclusive for PC and PS

Game has improved dramatically in 2.0. Brand new map, new Echoes, bosses, great story & fantastic music. Rinascita's map is a joy to traverse with the new glide wing mechanic, or with the gondolas. Despite its many improvements, I still only play on mobile if I have no other choice. This game is just made for phones that don't exist yet. The loss of graphical fidelity & playability is too much for me, even with recent optimizations.

I LIKE THIS GAME SOOO MUCH !!! IT HAS SO MANY SPECIAL FEATURES THAT ALWAYS EXCITED ME IN MANY WAYS. The story didn't take lots of my times, good for lazy players, beside each of every stories are well made. It also has a co-op mode to make it easier to play with friends (but you need to reach a certain levels). DEFINITELY RECOMMENDED FOR PEOPLE WHO ENJOYS PLAYING GAMES😍😍

Really fleshed out systems, ranging from combat to plot. Having a blast, but the game is horribly optimized for Android. I have an S23, which I consider to be at least a pretty decent phone, and the frame rate spikes and people/objects won't pop onto the screen until you get close. the game is really fun, I love the open world, the characters, gameplay and the story. the graphics is very beautiful even on low, and runs decently smooth on a low end device. although there is 3 problems I have, 1 - WAY to many cutscenes, 2 - no Africa servers (I think) so that means high ping, 3 - CO-OP takes way to long to unlock. even with all those problems I highly recommend this to anyone who reads this

Great game with excellent designed characters which are easily controlled in the mass world of wuthering waves. Great! This is what I can say about this game, the gameplay is so good and cool special those cancel animations, switch characters. It's unique for me I love how the story going. Looks like a Genshin clone with many similar features, but get to the combat and you'll see a major difference. I'm having a problem with the graphic, everything is so blurry even while using the advanced graphic settings and it's kind of off putting, i was wondering if it could be my device's problem but I never had any issue with other heavy games, other than that i think the controls are a bit clunky and the animations can be smoother, i believe that the game has a lot of potential since it's just been released so i'm hoping for improvements in the future.

After both of the updates, version 2.0 and 2.1, my game has started lagging significantly, and crashes have become more frequent on my device cause of the continuous frame drops and ping issues even though I use good internet. Amazing game! the story and game mechanics are absolutely astonishing, especially the characters and how generous the Devs are, however I'm a mobile player and the only problem I face is the overheating of my device, even on low settings I still face the same amount of overheating. This is the perfect Gacha game, Combat is amazing, Rewards are Great, world building is spectacular, the story is kinda mid but it Improve on arc 6, One of the first if not the first gacha game that actually listen to the players, have not experienced any crashes yet, but I heard some people crash, but mostly of them it's their devices problem. Keep Improving kuro games I have high hopes on this game.

this game is lit, like i would literally rate it 10/10 because it is literally free & great map! and recommended for those who are not really interested in the story/lore and only play it for the battle. however, there were some issues that needed to be fixed, such as lagging, fps drop, battle opt., and so on. and, DIO MIO please add some MALE characters 🙏🏼 thanks ! !

My main game and one of the best so far! KURO is super generous and has more passion for their product than some gacha games nowadays. This alone still amazes me sometimes. its a very nice game, its just that developers forgot to put setting on login page. The visuals are amazing, the world feels immersive and the characters are fun. This game is an incredible open-world action RPG with stunning visuals, fluid combat, and an engaging story I've ever played. The character designs and animations are top-notch, and the exploration feels rewarding. The combat system is smooth and skill-based, making every battle exciting. This game is absolutely beautiful. From the scenery to the animations, to the sound effects to the character designs. Everything about this game is phenomenal. So if you have a complaint about the game or something and it has a pretty good popularity support, the devs will consider it and sometimes even go through with it! Very impressed with this game, I already like it more than others of this genre. Combat is insanely good and fluid! The overall movement in the game is. Great story, fluid and satisfying combat as well as peak character design! I really enjoy my time with this game. I LOVE this game! I feel in love with it a few days before it official release last year, I do have one thing I want the devs to know. Great, it's fun and the unique combat style really makes it for me. I love this game. From the combat, the art, the overall gameplay, and most important of all: the Devs actually listens. Everything is great, story is worse when compared to Genshin, music isn't quite there yet and the story doesn't establish as strong an emotional connection to the characters. Being a game with strong inspirations from the pioneer of open-world gacha games, Wuthering waves aborts something reminiscent of Korean mythology (I apologize if I'm wrong) with interesting additions to combat such as counterattacks, perfect dodge and parry attacks. Hey I'm just gonna say this straight. Hands down one of the best gacha game I've played, combat is really fun I like the combat mechanics so far. Great game, great character design, great, difficult but enjoyable gameplay (but really difficult for me because it crashes often especially in mount firment and I'm on mobile). Doesn't have character synergy which is great you don't need to pull for another character to make your current ones work, which makes team comps easy. (just put your favorite characters and your done).

I'm not understanding the hate....I'm honestly not. Maybe the expectation was no human error on launch and a game that washes your laundry for you?idk All I know is the game is a lot of fun to play. Great game. Designs are amazing, environment is gorgeous, combat is spectacular, and the story...well, okay, the story isn't there yet, but it has promise, at least. Wish I could give it 5 stars but the translation is often just unedited machine nonsense. No one QA'd this. Voice acting improved tremendously in 1.1, but the translation is still wonky. Overall there's a lack of care toward the global audience that puts a bad taste in my mouth, though the rest of the game makes up for it, for now.

Maybe it can be improved again so that mobile players can play more smoothly. Play it, it's very good. The complaints about the story are unfounded, it's slow but it's first patch. I like English VA's, in my opinion they are perfect. And even side quests were so so good. Was skeptical about playing this game at first but it is extremely enjoyable and the developers actually care about their playerbase which is nice to see. New players and current can get so much stuff for free (gifts) because the devs are constantly trying to improve the game. I've had to play it on mobile which is a bit rough because my phone gets really hot from playing for like 2 minutes and my battery drains so fast too with it. Once I'm not on my vacation I will install it on my PC.

Honestly, I experienced fps drop, lag sometimes, and the aim for mobs or monsters are a bit clunky, but I really love the game. I rate it 5 star because I've been waiting for this game, I'm inlove with it, the art style, characters and skill set just like PGR. It seems like it could be fun, but it's difficult to play. Joystick doesn't move the way I point it so it's not easy to control my character. Very similar play style to games like Honkai and the like, the art work is beautiful. Once these are worked out I can take another look at it, but while I have good Internet, my ping keeps peaking to points that the game becomes unplayable.

I really enjoy playing this game. It's relaxing, fun, and the graphics look awesome. I think the performance of this game will depend on your device. The story is really complex and might be difficult to fully understand but overall it's a great game. From my experience, it's not a pay-to-win game. After finishing the main story and the side quests, there's daily and exploration quests or you can grind for resources and maximize your resonators (characters) or spin gacha and enjoy events etc.

The game looks slighty promising. The graphics are gorgeous, and the world is very detailed. The combat feels smooth and the story is intriguing as well. The characters are well-designed, and the voice acting is top-notch. However, I went for a little update to this game, and then the system said my recent acc hasn't registered/existed at all. I want my account back. Overall, despite of my acc getting unknowingly disappeared, it seems it's going to be a cool game to dive into.

I've been playing this game since it launched over a year ago and stuck with it despite the lackluster story and poor optimization. Since then the game has improved with almost every update and managed to turn its weak story into something truly enjoyable. The areas are a blast to explore and the combat is intense and rewarding when you learn how to play your characters. The echo(equipment) system could use some improvement but overall the game is a lot of fun.

This game looks real nice and the combat looks interesting but I feel this game needed a bit more time before releasing. The main issue is the lagging when I'm just walking around. The mobile version is a bit better but PC version is just horrible. I hope they fix it soon or just port to PS5.

An amazing experience for a gatcha game. From the combat, generosity, to the character designs, this game is a joy to play. Take your time, enjoy the fresh scenery and enjoy all there is to do. My only criticism is that things a touch expensive in terms of in game currency grinding on resources but the devs listen and so this will improve likely as we go along. Keep it up WUWA!

I've been enjoying this game for a while now, from it's dodge system, combat mechanics and even how developers gave F2P players a chance to obtain 5 star characters. Second, the graphics, I have a highly capable chipset of sd 8 gen 2 yet graphics are somehow looks pixelized and unoptimized..

My friend convinced me- so I quit the other one to play this, AND I DIDN'T REGRET IT!!! (I can't handle two gatcha games at once cause it became a chore to play them).. In terms of combat, Wuwa is more complex and requires actually skill than just a tap tap, the enemies are satisfying to fight (for me), veryyy balanced. The visuals are very pretty, to the point where I take pictures everywhere I find aesthetically pleasing. The characters are also detailed and beautiful 😍

To be honest, the game has a really entertaining gameplay in which you can do various things and i like how sprinting doesn't cost stamina because i find it to be more comfortable in a big open world. Also even tho the story is not that entertaining at the very start cuz it needs to build up the momentum, the story gets more fun and very good the more you progress. About character designs is already good with various clothings and appearances. I like it

I love wuthering waves so far. The game has such good characters and graphic designs with really thought through stories. I'm still getting used to the game play because I usually play genshin, but overall, the game is worth it, and I'm glad I've started playing. But I gave the game a 4 star because it has crashed multiple times whilst I've been playing. And to anyone reading this, yes, everyone's game experience will be different depending on your device and graphic settings. Hope this helps!

The game is really fun due to the combat and I wish I could play it all the time but the problem is that it doesn't run properly for low end devices. Absolutely amazing! Everything about this game is just peak. Story, characters, world and especially the music and gameplay. This game does something that others don't usually do. I'm playing this game on mobile phone and it's running smoothly, the combat is pretty decent it has some dodge,parry,running while climbing and able to parkour any obstacles in a way which is pretty awesome to see with a game like this. This is one of the best games ever. I really love the designs and im very curious to see where the story is heading. The intro was very intriguing and the Mt.Firmament quest was the best one so far. Overall the game's was good eventhough there was some bugs, but i know it can be fixed in the future, can I suggest can you fixed the ping in server Asia, I'm experiencing some of connection issues, it fluctuates 100-140ms and also actually I choose the wrong server and I can't change my server to sea because I started already my progress and have a high level to that server. I've been playing this game ever since it launched so I figured it was finally time to give a review. The most fair gacha game out there. Nice world, great characters, good music and the best combat in gacha games. Wuthering waves is an amazing game so far. I installed it the day it came out, but despite me lagging all the time and crashing whenever I fast travel. Its overall a great game. The game feels objectively better. Logging in is much faster, There are more optimizations than initial launch, and the gacha animations? Chef's kiss. The good thing about this game is the well executed combat system & the exploration on the open world map. It also offer a lot of contents during the launch and overall I enjoyed this game. Really enjoying the experience. My phone isn't that strong so im hoping for a console release but even through the frame rate drops it's so fun. WHAT is THIS? Game was good enough! BUT new patch Renesccita map is only the best I have seen. Decent game with some QOL advantages over Genshin. But the characters do not have enough energy to pull me in. It feels like watching a dull post-apocalyptic movie everytime dialogue plays. Great combat mechanics, fluid animations, beautiful world, amazing cutscenes and runs fine on my phone (Google pixel 8). After completing all side quests, and main story, I can confidently say Wuthering Waves has great potential. Taking time to talk to the NPCs makes me appreciate the story it tells. Though it's still early in its release it's a great experience with realistic and beautiful graphics. If you're thinking about playing Wuthering Waves, give it a chance!

So far I really like this game. The story is quite interesting though unfortunately the lag makes it near unbearable to fight or even play the game for longer than 3 minutes. My phone is fairly decent and is capable of running wuwa but the lag makes it horrible. I have every graphic on the lowest setting but it's still incredibly hard to play with the lag. WuWa is really awesome! After playing alot of G.I my expectation were really low, but to my suprise, they surpassed by expectations! Yes, there are a few bugs and all, it's normal for a game that just launched to have errors and bugs BUT the most imporatant thing is that KuroGames always make sure to take action from their players feedback! The only thing the game made right is the combat. Everything else was shamelessly copied from that other game, without any changes. The game is beautiful, with an amazing story. The story with the Storekeeper almost broke my heart, it is amazing indeed. I do like it.

So far, so good. Here are my observations that I hope will be considered in future patches: 1. The game itself is great! The characters are beautiful and the gameplay is good! Amazing!!!!! This game is fun, the gameplay is amazing and they give you a lot of rewards for starting! The story is pretty good as well with interesting "villain" characters. This game is WAY better than other certain game in almost every aspect, the exploration is enjoyable, the characters are more interesting, the combat is perfect, and the music is pretty good, the only complain I have is the optimization, it leaves a bit to be desired, but overall is one of the best mobile games I played, hopefully they will fix that in the future.

4. 5 The game is off to a great start. It is going to be a glitch in the beginning, but I better enjoy the rewards early and then miss out. My overall experience game play is really good. I really love this game when I first started playing it. But I have an issue. Somehow everytime I play this game, I immediately got laggy when my internet is fairly good. It's a good game. It has good f2p options and it has the best potential. SOME people are a bit harsh and, yes, I get that lagging is annoying but either it's the servers, Wi-Fi, or the phone. Very unique combat system, and the gameplay is beautiful, with awesome character designs. The only problem is that since this game is combat based, it's hard to get the full experience on mobile. WuWa is an amazing game. I love the graphics, the characters, and the story and I totally recommend it, but the optimization of the game on mobile is bad. Have been waiting forever for this to come out! The lag just means a lot of people are playing so good for you guys! it's a really good game, I'm saying this being a genshin player for more than 2.5 years and I think it's a really good game the combat the characters, the concept of the wave of the sound everything its really interesting for me, i think the gameplay is more fun than genshin. but i don't give it a 5 star because the lag, is soo hard to run it well on my device a galaxy tab a8 (i try it on my phone a samsung a21s too, but was impossible to play in it hahaha)

Tbh it's really good!! They said it's laggy but I haven't experienced lag at all, but ig it depends on your phone? I loved the combat system, the world's apocalyptic graphics and the characters! The problem on mobile is it slows down after playing for too long.. The game is really good in my opinion, so far all the bugs and issues that the game were having are mostly solved. The game has a very unique world which is beautiful and as well as dystopian and demonic. Lots of crashes and bugs!! - The game is really good and fun but it crashes way too much, especially on cutscenes. For the bugs, this is just informative so the devs can fix it when they update it! I simply adore this game. There are some issues with voice acting, typos, and some of the story can feel cringe, but, overall, it's a pleasure to play with interesting characters and a world that feels lived in. The NPCs feel like actual people and look cool, and I often find myself stopping and admiring the designs. I love some of the fetch quests because they can be random and silly. You can also play how YOU want. Want to explore the world as YOUR favorite character? Go ahead.

After spending a small amount of time playing the game on my phone' i like the game so far and i already prefer it over Genshin Impact. However, since my moto stylus 5G phone can't handle the game well' i uninstalled the game and I'll wait for the PS5 release of the game. I like that the game allows me to sprint without consuming stamina. It would be nice if at least one of the future characters that gets added to a banner has the ability to fly besides gliding.

combat is so unique I can honestly just go around fighting thjngs without getting bored since mechanics change for each character. Game is also well paced as it takes a good while to "farm" for characters meaning that you're not forced to slave over a certain thing and get bored of it easily. I would understand how this is a turn off for some people but I think it's better this way as it kind of forces you to take a break from the game.

Out of all the mobile games that I played, this one feels right. No headaches, no forcing you to spend, no locking you from content. Just play and level up, grind, and get rewards. This game is so fun that I can stop for one second and come back without worry about losing content. I spend money to support the game, and I don't regret one bit.

The combat and exploration are great. And the concept of echoes is cool. However, the story and voice acting are lack luster. I tend to zone out during the storyline. Also, I can't play too long because the game eats up my phone's battery and overheats. Also also, I tend to get disconnected from time to time, especially during combat. Hopefully, these issues will be fixed. It's overall a good game but needs more improvements.

This game is so unusual from the other gacha games, like how you treat your MC like an anime MC itself. I'm glad that I'm waiting for this game since the first release. But i faced some issues where the game is kinda constantly lagging due to high and far rendering distance. I would like to see and update where we the "Rovers" could adjust our Render Distance as we like, to avoid crashes and fc in the game.

The game is very good, I love the combat and the characters. but my only problem is the game keeps on crushing, and of course keeps on lagging as well. Game has potential even though the launch had full issues like bugs, unoptimized etc. Story is honestly boring. They should have sticked with the story from the beta. Combat is their top selling because it's honestly smooth and enjoyable. You will enjoy exploring because of the parkour applied. over all is great. i really like the battle style of each character especially the rovers and the details of them too! they're so expressive, even the npcs. but it's still need a lot of improvement. I originally started playing because I really liked pgr and its fighting style, and this game did not disappoint. One of my compliants, though, is how extremely laggy it is. I'd wager Wuthering Waves is the definitive open world gacha gaming experience, and both this game and it's team need HONEST reviews now more than ever. Even w/the inclusion of dialogue skip, the story is enthrawling and at times even emotional, the new areas are breathtakingly beautiful and huge but easily traversable, the combat feels intuitive yet challenging in a perfect balance, and the ludicrous effort shaped into the characters and their designs is inspiring. Most of all, it's fun.

I'm so satisfied on this game, The devs are so generous for their players with a tons of rewards for compensation upon a problem, well it's true it was still lagging and have a lot of things that needs to be fix, but hey it was just released and things like that are expected to happen to a game, i really had fun on exploration, and unique battle style on this game because it has dodge and counter mechanic, I've also seen some monsters fighting, so yah i suggest you guys try this game too.

Been playing since day 1 and I've enjoyed every minute of it. Only getting better and better. You'll never go wrong and it'll put pressure on your competitors 😉

Everything is great. I love this game, but there's a few problem. At first, the game was badly lagging but then I reinstalled it. Only this time, it keeps crashing and I had to download it again. I was playing at a very low graphic (since my phone is not very high end) and it was still laggy even though I have a high speed wifi and crashes multiple times. I understand this game had just been released, but I really hope to see this game improved more in the future.

This game is incredible. At first, the content may overwhelm you and the story -at the very beginning- is rather lackluster, but if you give it a go, it's sure to impress & hook you! I truly enjoy this game, it's something I can actively look forward to spending my time on, even after a hard day! Sure, it does have its flaws (e.g.the performance -low end to above average devices- still leave a lot of room for improvement) but it's ruled out by ALL the work these devs do! Thank you, Kuro Games!

I played this on my iPhone and it worked great, had great quality, and amazing story and characters. I can play it now! it was a bit to take in at first with all the mechanics, but it's been about 5 days now and I've mostly gotten better, the combat is soooo much fun, exploration is pretty cool too, lots of enemies around (love it), the story is nice, but I feel like it dumps a lot of lore at once. overall, it's a really fun game, one that loves to chug my battery :D.

ohh! a great game with similarity to Genshin so jumping from GI to WuWa isn't actually that hard, now I'm a fan of both games, Wuthering Waves offers something different from other games that you will only experience on the game itself, a vast open world with a 3d and modernized graphics, also the attack animation feels great! the simplicity of GUI also captured me and I'm hoping to get myself hooked up to this game.

Despite the issues the game is going through, I had an enjoyable experience so far. I did have issues with the game freezing during combat with bosses, world structures not appearing at all, and NPC dialogue skips. The game excels in it's incredibly satisfying combat system, with it's parry system, and inclusion of echoes system. It breathes like fresh air compared to the other gacha. I trust that Kuro Games can excel given more time. Wuwa as of right now (2024/05/26) feels unpolished.

I really love this game. It's super fun and I play this with my friend! I highly recommend this. I really wish there was an option though where if you changed servers, all your data would be saved. I want to play with my friend but I don't want to start over the whole game again. Other than that, this is a very fun game, the story line is consistent, the combat options, and enemies are really good too. Would rate this 10 stars if I could.

It is totally a great game but unfortunately I cannot play properly due to lag/ stutter issues. I love the combat and the animations. Didn't went to deep into the story because wanted to farm a bit but so far I'm enjoying it. This is the game i want for a long time now, openworld, anime like gacha with better combat and mechanics. I play since release and the game runs pretty smooth even tho theres lag most of the time. Enjoying the game, characters design, and open world. Suggestions for improvement would be to reduce movement sensitivity as it feels a bit clunky right now. Wish developers made it more smoothly. this game has a lot of potential but its lackluster story and english voice acting in 1.0 are going to turn a lot of people off. the combat, movement and artefact systems are what really set it apart currently, so far (im at the mid game) artefact grinding is actually fun rather than a complete slog. the gacha rates on certain banners are also much better than competitors. for now i cannot rate it 5 stars due to the bugs and story but hopefully one day

Great combat. It's not too difficult or too easy. You can find challenging game play, too. Amazing exploration and stunning visuals. Different from other, this game got an insane combat abilities, even with controls combination to create a specific attack movements and other stuff. One of the best gacha games I've ever played. As a casual player and quite the busy person with school and stuff, this game is the only one that I can still manage. The exploration is not hard but also not easy, so it's a balance. The events are fun and challenging to do. But by far, the stories and lore of this game is what really attracts me, the rollercoaster of emotions when playing through. That rush to find out the ending. And the occasional plot twist. BEST GAME OF ALL TIME

The game itself is great, the graphic, the aesthetic, the characters, the storyline and etc. but I'm not entirely satisfied with the voice actors, especially Lingyang and Scar's. Truly a great game. I, personally, enjoyed it. The explorations are nice, they have everything set out and marked for you, except for some things on older regions. I wish I can give you guys 6 stars, really an outstanding game, I'm hooked, the game play is really what I'm looking for, the dodge, parry, the beautiful open world, engaging story, bautiful characters design, what more can I asked? I really love this game, especially the playstyle. Although it's not optimized for mobile and is often laggy, it's tolerable for me. Regarding the 'skip' option, it's nice to have, but I hope you remove it during the main story quests since that's the most important part of the game..

Gameplay wise, it's 10/10. I absolutely love the ease of exploration due to how flexible characters are. They can traverse ANY terrain due to wallrunning and parkour movements. Flawless combat and character swapping. But i give the game 4 stars because I'm still suffering from poor optimization... my game frequently lags, and my game crashes AT LEAST 5 times a day. I really wish this game was available on consoles at launch. I really wanted to play this on my PS5.

If you like Genshin you may love this game. Beautiful artwork, smooth graphics, the bit of story I didn't skip seemed well thought out. However there's one large (IMO) difference.. CUSTOMIZABLE CONTROLS!! There's also no elemental skills, for better or worse, but there are lots of combo ideas between characters. I also like the special skills being customized through the monster essence you collect. Really opens up options for giving characters real specific roles or keeping them all balanced

This game has potential, but its a bit hard to play. It's buggy and drains battery on my phone. It went all squished last time I played? On the laptop, the frame rate was headache inducing. I also really love the style and characters. I hope it runs better soon, I really do want to see what the story has to offer.

Tried honkai star rail, genshin and now I like this and everything is so, so good!! I’ve been playing Wuthering Waves for a while now and honestly, I really enjoy it. The combat feels super smooth and responsive, especially with the combos and dodges—it makes every fight exciting. Been playing a lot of gacha games in the past few years and I just want to say that wuthering waves blew the competion right off the bat. It's a good game but.. progression is painfully slow .. You're often left with nothing to do at all.. Difficulty level is too high . Nice game play ,like playing an edger version of genshin impact. Game has had it's issues at launch, but with how much we have been compensated, it shows the devs care about giving us the best game they want to deliver.
