The graphics are breathtaking and the gameplay is among the best I have ever played in any games. I wish Kuro nothing but the best success with the game!

I love the combat mechanics and my playstyle from Punishing: Gray Raven (game by the same company) actually has a positive influence since the mechanics are pretty similar. The sheer detail and expression on the characters, even the NPCs, is something I applaud and I'm proud of the dedication that was put in. I'm also quite happy with the story, as in my opinion, the content is improving since the game first started.

First of all, I don't know if it's a bug or not. But whenever I'm walking while tapping some controls, the control will suddenly going to left side. It's difficult to walk without the control suddenly going uncontrollable. The Graphics is good and the I love the fighting. Also, the movement isn't that smooth.

I personally love this game so far. Interesting story, nice characters, satisfying pulling system. The graphics are pretty good too. HOWEVER, please do something about the constant lagging! I've tried clearing my storage, setting the graphics to low and so on, but it's still horribly lagging. It kinda ruins the experience for me, especially in challenges. Also, it's really annoying if it lags terribly every 15-30 minutes.

The game is seriously wonderful. But what I really hate is that this game's developers don't seem to focus on the real issue of the game which is their optimization issue, focusing on these little details(leaves, escalator, water physics when flying) that if I had to be honest, is unnecessary. it makes the game almost unplayable for the majority of mobile players due to overheating and frame rate problems, which is hence why some are uninstalling(including me), please fix this issue Kuro.

This game has so many bugs, especially on PC/Desktop. If it can't download, you can't play. If you can download it, it wont load. I hope Kuro Games will fix it's launcher in PC because I've been trying non-stop to download this. Though, on mobile its quite good but still buggy. The graphics are absolutely breathtaking especially the games cutscenes.

On Day 1 and 2 of playing there were some bugs and lagging but to my surprise, on Day 3 it was already fixed. Seriously Kuro, thank you so much for the hard work. Really really appreciate it. Other than that, the story line are well thought out, the characters are well designed and I love the extra features like running up the walls. Super fun. For Kuro's first time making an open-world game, it's so good 🫶

Tried WW a few weeks after release. This game has an immersive world, cool characters, fun combat, and a captivating story. I probably would've gotten super into it, BUT, mobile controls for a game of this type are naturally clunky & awkward, console release information was vague at best, and the week I spent trying to play it on PC was plagued constantly by glitches & lag. 🤷🏿‍♂️ Maybe I'll try it again if I ever get a more powerful PC or it releases on PS4.

Very good combat mechanic, I really like open world game, fight boss and even challenge myself by doing hologram. Even got all limited character 😊, only lose once 50/50, while you don't have to worry about weapons banner cuz it's was guarantee. So far it was good, I play both on pc and mobile. Update 2.0 is the most game changer so far.

The storyline seems interesting as the story goes on, just a little push to truly understand its depth. Though it could be better, as future updates come. The combat style kept me playing the game for hours even though it's laggy after approx. 10mins, hope the devs fix this because the gameplay in domains are smooth for me and it felt amazing and cool :D The compensations for the lags and bugs are the best too (￣∇￣)

the pity for gacha is 10 pulls less than that other company, weapon banner is guaranteed. the art is gorgeous. using the monsters is unique and fun, and QoL mechanics like running up walls is amazing. also, devs are very generous with rewards. the game runs really smoothly on my phone, my only issue is the movement can be kind of jerky when running around or fighting. otherwise 10/10.

it's a great game, the only issue is the internet connection or is it? There is time that it goes higher and become laggy, the sensitivity also affected that is so hard to control. Overall, the game is fun to play and also we know (player) that you were doing all your best to improve the game so that it can satisfy its player, keep improving the game and we were here to support!

Absolutely GREAT GAME! The combat is nice and the character designs are actually very detailed which I didn't expect. Even though the gameplay is good, the performance for low-end devices could use some optimization. My fps usually drops when I'm using my phones data (which I don't know why?) and runs okay-ish when I connect to my wifi. Still though, the cutscenes, the combat, the generous developers, everything is GREAT! In my opinion, this should be everyone's first RPG game. Well done devs!

The game is good. It's unique and I like how the characters in the story have varying movements and actions. I just like how the story is delivered that it didn't even bore me. However, there's one major issue though. When I set the story into auto mode, the characters' dialogue would get cut off ending up not finishing the whole sentence. I hope the developers will fix this issue since it can affect the game's story or maybe the game in general.

this game is great. really. from combat experience, quest, characters model, etc. is just so great but still left a space for improvement. the only problem i face is just the frame drop is too much for me, but i can guess because my device were too hot so i don't really mind it. but if there's anything to do regarding this issue, please do, because I've been playing another game similar to WuWa but still can run smoothly although my device is considered hot. overall i love this game!!!

In short, it has great storyline, interesting gameplay and decent graphics. Some improvements to do : loading speed, map during coop (dificult to find coopmates location), missed shooting (pistol characters), gyro aiming, optimisation of questionnaire (I can't answer cuz it says i dun have good internet connection (I use 5G). Hope to see more improvements, good job and good luck devs!

best gacha game by far and I think they will still remain at top with the development they are doing. The story and Storytelling is just fabulous. The animation,Movesets, characters everything. involving NO PAYLOCK FOR ANY FEATURE. if you want a character it's your choice, but whatever their feature are, you can do better with the given devices you have.(like fly faster, swim faster, travel faster). MUST TRY GAME, if it fits your taste.

The game's combat system is sooo good, story-wise too!!! The Developers listens to the players' request and suggestions, Plus the bug compensation for the players are over the top?!!! I can quite say that it's unbelievable because there are another game like this that I've been playing for years and they could never do the same 🥹, I feel overly joyed that this company is very generous when it comes to their playerbase, and I'm sure that the players are happy about it too. 11/10 game 🎯

I absolutely like the game, although there is one issue, hence why it's only 4 stars, This bug has been bothering me since I started playing, for a while it didnt appear, but on my 3rd visit it would say "gateway connection timeout" (yes i checked if I have bad wifi, but it doesnt take 1 second for youtube videos to appear) so if you fix this, I'll change this to 5 stars, Thank you for reading this, and thank you in advance if you fix the issue. Edit: Nevermind, yall bumped up the number up to 7

I absolutely love this game! The fighting is really smooth and the design of the world reminds me of Honkai Star Rail but maybe better graphics and interactive ability. I definitely recommend trying this game out, I was a bit worried at first after reading comments on how laggy it was for some people, but I haven't had a problem with, except my phone (Google Pixel 6) getting a little hotter! I do recommend using a laptop if your phone/tablet can't handle the game, plus it's less crowded looking.

HOW IS THIS A FREE GAME?!!?! The world is beautiful. The graphics and art style are insane for a mobile game (literally looks exactly like what you'll play on the Nintendo Switch). The combat is engaging and fun. The story is well thought out with multiple side quests and companion stories. Yes it has micrtransactions and it is a gacha game, but the materials are easy to come by if you just grind and do quests. Also, I literally got an achievement from being 1 hit KO'd by a random boss LOL

Great game, I would love to continue playing it but my phone can't handle it without over heating, so until next time when I have a better phone or a pc :). Also the story of the game is pretty interesting but I think the execution was a bit lacking. The pacing at the start was fine but then it got a bit boring in the middle when I was playing. Besides that this is an amazing game

I really enjoy this game, but as a mobile player, I've noticed some optimization issues. My phone tends to overheat at certain times, causing the game to lag and even crash. I'm not sure if it's due to high server traffic, but I hope the developers can address this so that mobile players can fully enjoy the game. Additionally, please fix the camera during combat so it consistently keeps the target in view rather than zooming in or losing the target off-screen.

I absolutely love this game! The gameplay is absolutely fun and I love how unique the animations are for the selections for characters, theres so much to do even after you run out of waveplates. And its amazing that the devs listen to their community. My only problem is the random zooms and echo upgrades but im sure kuro team is working on a solution

I haven't really had any issues with the game. I'll agree it's very similar to genshin, but the combat feels better, and the character models are good. I don't care about the story, so I just skip that, and it's annoying when I can't skip stuff. Pretty good game IMO. The open world feels busier than genshin did.

The game is good. The combat, the designs, the exploration is all a praise from me but I want to talk about the graphics. The anti-aliasing makes everything look blurry and without it, the game looks so rough. The LOD is still low and the render distance is very limited. These two problems have been an eyesore for me but I guess that's how they got the game running on mobile devices for now. Hopefully this will be fixed in the future. Fantastic game nonetheless

Devs really care about their players—they want us to touch some grass cuz the game is very addicting. Wanna know why? Because they have 3 hour gameplay reminder that most games don't have. It's fricking cute and I love it! Gameplay is great especially the combat mechanics (events not included) in general. Although it's not a beginner-friendly system so you have to get used to it over time (experience wise, it took me 5 months to have a decent but fast enough rotations for specific team comps)

The game is very beautiful and I like the game style but I've been experiencing this bug. I don't know if I'm the only one but no matter how much I lower the graphic in the settings it just remains overload. Not to mention that it's laggy sometimes and keep crashing. Sometimes I even have trouble logging in even though my WiFi is not that bad. It's starting to get very annoying. Because when I first play this game it's working okay but when I re-download it, it just keep crashing.

Aside from a few minor bugs that comes with every newly launched game, I love it. Seriously. The game is fresh with its exploration and map. The Echo system is also amazing, it's like I'm catching pokemons. Although the story was quite boring at the beginning, it got better at Chapter V and VI, I was seriously shocked at how good it was. Also the animations, the cutscenes are so detailed that I had to rewatch it at YouTube to find even more details. A solid 5 stars ⭐.

Although this game was amazing, better then Genshin I dare say, around the patch Lupa was added, it became completely unplayable on my device, crashing consistently not even a few minutes after being opened. I wish I had it in me to continue playing but this issue is too much to continue playing, not to mention the fact that games like this become absolutely massive and unplayable on mobile after some time anyways. Thanks for the memories.

Great game with amazing combat and fun exploration. The mechanics are fun and technical without being overly complicated. There were some pretty rough edges at launch but the devs seem to be working through the major issues. One critique would be the voice acting. Some of the female VAs seem to be forcing lines or trying and accent that isn't coming across very smoothly. Either way, this is a fairly small issue overall.

For me it may lag a bit and I did experience some weird glitches where everything would gradually slow down and get very laggy but that was early into the launch of the game and right now the game has given me no bugs. The game also is skill-based, which is a good thing so no character will be bad if you know how to play them right.

Literall, the most exciting and adventurous game I've played in a long time. Wuthering Wave's Echo system is so fun. It's nice to be able to have a great mix of Gacha & Grind system. Collecting and battling against different Echos makes it feel like Monster Hunter and Pokemon and Pal World w/ Genshin Impact all combined into a beautiful game. 5/5 Stars for sure. Bugs are hot fixed almost immediately! You can tell how much Kuro games really care for their players with feedback and suggestions.

Story gets good after a few chapters and ending is hype af. Combat is orgasmic and character designs are beautiful. World is great to explore and changes according to your progress in different exploration quests. English dub sucks currently, but that doesn't affect me since I play in JP. Currently I've encountered one quest that had translation errors so bad it actually worsened the experience for me, but I'm used to ignoring errors since I play Kuro's other game Punishing Gray Raven.

i honestly love the game so much, but after the update, it has been lagging so much and i couldn't even play longer than 2 minutes. I've never had a problem with lag since release, just now that i updated the game. I don't know if it's just my phone but i hope you can fix this, i can still play on my laptop but i would really appreciate it if you fix the game on phones. Also, the camera sensitivity is annoying, one move of my finger and it will spin like crazy

Pre downloaded and pre registered and since the release I've been playing non stop! The graphics and character designs are beautiful, any issues/bugs are resolved quickly and even given in game compensation for them (thank you Kuro Games). Exploration is so fun and great, the combat system is so unique and definitely my fave over all other games! Can't wait to see what future updates bring!

I'm a day one player who has played consistently. The character design and animations are amazing, and the game is very f2p friendly with the devs caring and listening to the players. The beginning story is a little hard to understand, but as you go, the story is amazing with deep emotions and cut scenes. The game has fanservice in a decent number of characters (including males), but most gacha games have that. They have a lack of male characters, though the ones they have are amazing.

This game is very Awesome! It has very high graphic, and the story is really good! Especially the character design, skill and abilities are very unique! My Favorite is Verina and Jinhsi. As, I really like Healer and Jinhsi's playstyle! Not forget to mention, they give us a lot of pulls! And they listen to us! Please, don't forget to say a simple "Thank you"

I love the combat and game design, the open world experience is lovely, but find the story quests a bit lacking. The amount of dialogues is just right, but they are not eventful/meaningful enough. And by that I mean nothing much really happens outside the main story. Other than that I would definitely recommend giving it a try.

I will start with the pros. Combat feels great. the game is very generous, characters look great and have good animation. Body details are really good, too. Some of the best-looking male characters in Gotcha games. We have male characters with Beard for once or with muscle. Female characters look really good, too. The open world was fun to explore. Now, with the cons with the story, the story needs more work. Echo needs more fine tuning. game just needs more polishing, as it has potential

Its a good game dont get me wrong i just have one complaint. The stories for games like this are always linear there's no real choice. The dialogue literally doesn't matter. I'm one of those people where if my choice doesn't matter then what's the point. A lot of games do this. You are a good guy your dialogue doesn't matter because the end result and overall dialogue options is good. Overall happy with the game just a niche complaint keep up the good work.

I quit the game a few weeks after getting Jinhsi. I get bored easily, but the game's awesome, it's just me. My friend told me to come back because there are new maps. So I tried it again since I wasn't playing anything else. Wow, version 2.0 runs so smoothly on my ROG Ally and phone, I got Carlotta after 11 tries (the free 10 pulls, plus 160 astrites). It makes me super happy and makes me want to play even more. This game is the only one that's f2p friendly. Awesome!

I really love this game. Even when I'm not playing the story (which is very interesting btw) ,I still find things to do e.g exploring. The breathtaking graphics and unique game mechanics make it all the more fun to explore. I like how you can use skill and strategies defeat enemies rather than just using op characters as it makes the game more fun and interesting to play. The developers also do an extremely good job on listening and acting based on community feedback. Keep up the good work!

I love the game quality as well as the uniqueness of each character. In addition, the stories of each character can be quite similar, yet it did show amazing backgrounds of those characters. However, I wanted Kuro to implement Physics from the characters like the tail of certain characters or the dress or clothes of some characters even the hair. If you consider adding physics on your models that would be great.

I understand it's a new game, so here are the problems with it. The frames just drop whenever there are enemies to fight after a cutscene, hope you can update that as soon as you can. And i think the sensitivity is a little too high. Camera goes crazy with one swipe. But other than those, very good game, very nice graphics and gameplay. Thank you!

Gameplay is incredibly fun. But I feel like I'm talking to NPC more than fighting them... the one major downside is the performance. I have a Samsung Galaxy S23 and it just doesn't run well at all. Constant frame drops and constant hitches. I would say wait until they do performance updates to actually experience the game and all it has to offer.

One of the good open world game, the small details, scenery, the combat is fire, the parkour is so cool, character design, the EXPRESSIONS during cutscene though i experience some problem like the optimization of the game it needs improvement, and the story idk but i feel like bloated already, i hope they build the plot slowly of the story. I'm giving it 5 stars cause kuro is really really really generous. gonna keep playing i wanna see the improvement of this game ❤️❤️

It's nearly the best game on the mobile platform that I just can't play because of some unfortunate connection issues that is beyond my power to fix it. Although my phone doesn't play this game with the best quality settings, I would've had put up with it if the ping and connection issues weren't as bothering as they are for me. More devs of these games should be on the look for their game to be more time conservative and offer a better time for it's players.

A very neat game. Graphics are quite nice in mobile. Story is engaging with multiple npc traits/characteristic with diverse design. If I were to point out the downside is that some phones might lag due to frame issues. Some powerful phones also lag. Trying to lower the settings for it kills the joy off the art so it's unfortunate. Hope kurogames improves the mobile frames for better experience and gameplay for some mobile devices.

I love this game with all my hearttt!! Its got surprisingly great quality for mobile, especially my phone! I've never had issues with lag, maybe a little bit of loading time. But, its all made up for by actual gameplay. My phone doesn't heat up, doesn't freeze, nothing! Maybe I'm not too tech smart, but I've always had issues playing games like these on my phone (even though I LOVE them), and this ones great!

Wuthering Waves is a great game. It's extremely fun to play, and the combat feels unique and special for what it is.. however, there's a big issue that has stopped players from enjoying the game. That is, that the game keeps on crashing. For some reason the game will crash at random times (in combat, opening mail, etc) This is a huge issue with the game, preventing players for enjoying it for what it is, and instead, having to go through a tedious task to try fix it, because the devs won't.

All in all it's a great game, graphics, character design, combat, voice lines, exploration etc are just phenomenal. But it does have it's bugs sometimes like the occasional camera locks when doing challenges. One thing I'd like to suggest though is that you add to the exploration the other factors that affect the percentage like mutterfly's and such because I've noticed they add to the percentage but they are not represented on how much is left and maybe some alternative to farming echo mats.

This game isn't suitable for older devices/devices with lower capacity because of the lagging and freezing that happens. I deleted the game after a few months because of this bit got it now on a better device and it's AMAZING. The story telling, visual and gameplay are entertaining and feel very comfortable to play. Recommend this game if your device can handle it~

I really love this game personally. And if you asked me about lagged yeah it is but what can say it's a new game.. so it will for sure had little lag on it but the game and the storyline were great 🤌🏻🤍🤍. If you like to explore and had stories in it you can download it. And it also had a skip bottom so you can skip the story if you lazy to read it. The gacha in this game were good as well and if you pulling in weapon you will guarantee. So far one of my fav✨🤍

The games amazing! However the main attraction is the combat and not too much else- The world isn't overly interactive, the character designs are nice, and the story is ok. The graphics are stunning and the compensation for players is really cool as well. However, as of right now, the most you can do is just fight things. I'm sure in the future the game will have more to offer, and I look forward to that! The gacha system is also a bit bothersome, especially when the first 50/50 can be lost.

Not really recommended for low device users, it may say that your device is compatible with it until the game crashes and stops multiple times and it's very annoying. I haven't even started the main story, I just signed in and downloaded all the resources and at the end — it keeps kicking me off. I have enough storage for the game that's why I don't have any idea why it won't let me play. (This is already my 5th attempt downloading the game.)

This is by far one of the most cleanest games I've played in awhile! The Storyline is so thrilling while also pulling at the heart strings! Not only that but, the combat is so well made! Every Character has their own unique combat system, via combos and dodge mechanics! Events of plenty and even fair to f2players! The exploration is absolutely stress free and beautiful!! The only downside so far is the imbalance of 4 stars to 5 stars! Other than that, I'm proud to say I'm apart of this story!!

Will withhold any criticism as the game just released and there's time to improve. With that being said, voice acting and looting are a couple things i hope are addressed soon. Female Rover's English va sounds like she's reading a book when she speaks most of the time, same for a couple of the other characters we interact with, while a few va like Scar do their best I feel like the others need to do better, also dialogue overlaps sometimes when on auto play.

Solid gacha game with the new 2.0 and 2.1 updates. The new zone is very polished and introduces flight to add a new way to explore all of the peaks and valleys. Most content is very laid back and you can roam at your own pace. Obtainable characters skew female. Spending on character pulls seems a bit pricey but you get a decent amount of freebies each patch.

I mostly play on PC but find mobile to be convenient for when I can't make it to my PC that day for dailies. The game has been refreshing for me in many ways, the story never let's me down and the music is definitely my favorite! Haven't had any issues that aren't easily fixable and seems to run as intended for me!

I have play this game for a month since release. I really enjoy it a lot. For beginners to be given a free pull and a free 5 star Resonator is such a blessing. Although, there is still some laggy issue. I don't know wether it's my device or the game is still working on it's optimization. Anyway, overall. I have really enjoy it a lot. Waiting for the future update to this game.

This game is fun the world is interesting and gameplay is engaging, characters are unique but my phone can't run it, took a while to figure out the issue was my device as results in high ping making you think its a server issue, but having played on PC over same connection and not having high ping and looking into the minimum requirements on mobile a galaxy s9 can't run this game well enough to be playable. its a great game though I just have to play on PC until I get a better phone

Definitely one of the best ever. The fast paced action where I can skip and actually start where I WANT to start, the exploration is just TEN times better, its amazing how much content it has for game that came out a year ago. The combat feels a little bit like PGR(Punishing Gray Rayven) in short I love the combat system the parry, dodge, but I'm not a fan of how difficult to level up your Gord where you have to collect echoes to level up. But despite that the Eng VA just seems a bit of a meh.

This is the BEST game on the market right now in terms of sheer gameplay. The combat is absolutely unparalleled. As for everything else, the story has a slow start but doesnt take long at all to go full steamroll. Hits just right. Looming forward to the future with this, Kuro Games! Keep up the good work.

So fun and sooo rewarding to play. The scenery in this game is incredible plus the combat style is literally peak. The music is so relaxing and the variety of accents in this game is honestly so refreshing. In wuwa exploring is genuinely fun and doesn't feel like a chore. Also the different body types and facial futures in this game is so inclusive. I love this game and I'd say Wuwa is one of the best games I have ever played. I am obsessed!

Wuthering Waves is a very amazing and beautiful game, with wonderful sceneries, characters and gameplay. But the joy killer is that as soon as I log in, I get from 1 to 3 minutes of play before it lags and crashes. Every single time. It has been like this since the last month. So I can't play at all. Please fix it, because it's a shame that such a good game cannot be played just for some technical issues. I'll be glad to give a full 5 star review then.

you guys been through a lot since the first release and since the server has opened for the first time. I respect it. and there's a lot of compensation as well! even though I play in a potato mid-end device, still framing a bit, but it's ok. the improvisation from the first release is so much better in the latest version. keep it up!

One of the most fun gachas out at the moment, haven't experienced a gacha that was as nice and generious as this in a long time. Combat is fun and can be genuinely hard, boss fights are rewarding, and the only gacha to make me sweat in a boss fight. Exploration is great, and it feels fresh because tools aren't limited, and we can sprint endlessly. Did I mention the devs are generious and always listen to community feedback.

What best of this game is battle mechanism and echos (pokemon like system), you can explore anything move with complex variation. Story is mid, graphics is pretty, character design is the best imo. But the optimization of this game is very bad, really bad. Overall, this game is good, but good is not enough, Kuro you can do more !

easily the most fun f2p game I've ever played and I've played hundreds over the years! the art is absolutely gorgeous and the environments are breathtaking. by far, my favorite aspect is the gameplay. combat is robust and varied, not just between classes but also characters. i also enjoy the parkour and flying mechanics. the devs are also very responsive and receptive to feedback which is refreshing.

WUWA definitely is my go-to game. beautiful characters although lack male 5 star characters ... amazing graphics and all that, but the mobile app has a lot of problems. for example, after the new update, every time I go in the game, it will kick me out after a couple of seconds. please fix it. I work most of the days, so I don't have access to my console. I really need this mobile version ☹️

The combat experience is awesome and dynamic. You can dodge or parry the enemy's attack with smooth movement. The world building is also rich of detail. But, the exploration experience is a bit meh. Lag occurs when panning the view and heating issue comes to my device (snapdragon 870 with lowest 30 fps setting). Overall, it's still a good game despite of any problem that can be optimized next.

Kuro I really like the game.. In 1.0, the problem I have is gone but 1.1 latest version, the graphics is became better and I feel like became smoother but at the same time it's became worst. Bug, sensitivity, frame drop, it came again! That's the problem that I have in 1.0. The annoying framedrop that in 1.0, you already guys fixed it but why I came again in 1.1??.. Edit:latest patch Well there's still problem about optimization but it's getting better. Keep up a good work kuro!! 3* +1*

Wuthering Waves has quickly become one of my favorite games I've ever played. My problem with games like these is that the camera distance is too close, triggering my severe motion sickness, but WuWa has been the only game of this sort that doesn't make me sick. The gameplay is extremely fun, and the graphics are beautiful. The game definitely had some rough patches in the beginning, from long loading times and frame drops, but Kuro has proved themselves to be a company that listens.

Really enjoying this game and the creators seem more generous already than hoyoverse ever has been. This is a game I won't feel regretful spending a bit of money on here and there. Also characters are really intricate and interesting. The only small detail I would mention is sometimes it can be hard to see properly in battle because (usually on hold attacks) the camera seems to go a bit crazy rotating absolutely everywhere.

I play this on high res on my phone and able to play without much lag. But for some reason, it's no better than low/medium res. Imagine having bad eyesight and going out without your glasses. Additionally, the pacing of the dialogue can be weird at times. During dialogue scenes on auto the speaking character will end their sentence and begin a new one in the next dialogue box without ever pausing talking in run-on sentences as if trying to connect the 2 dialogues together.

Wurthering Waves is a beautiful, dynamic game that has really grown since it first released. I tried it when it released, and the graphics and designs pop out so much. The style and art is unique, highlighting the different features and designs of every character. Even the nations are gorgeous in their inspiration from different cultures. I stopped playing Genshin after that Natlan thing and have been hooked to WuWa ever since. It's such a gorgeous game and I really hope it continues to grow.

I've played all the Android RPGs, and none of them come close to this one (not even Black Desert Mobile). The graphics and immersion are just WOW. It's skill based. Finally a game where I feel I'm actually playing, and not just watching cinematics. Wide variety of quests, sub-quests and things to do inside this world. Has amazing elements from Hogwarts Legacy and Palworld. Characters and voice overs are fantastic. The game isn't optimized enough and it's sometimes challenging to play on Poco

After a few hours from it's release I can definitely tell that the lag problem has lessen. The only problem right now is the glitches like climbing up walls, zomming in the camera makes your character move, the dialogue box is too small I hope it is adjustable, I also hope the UI too is adjustable, font size too. Overall I still would play the game, I hope they optimize the game further because I'm positive that my phone can run semi-high graphics, somehow in this game I'm stuck at low.

This gameplay is actually so fun and I'm really excited for its future. But as a potato phone user I experience constant frame drops and ping spikes, I know that it's just the first release but hopefully they can add more graphic settings to further lower it and also more optimization updates. What I really love about this game is the developers, they always listen and that's something that would make a person continue playing this game. Overall its a great game, would definitely recommend it.

I play on PC and this game is a breath of fresh air in the gacha scene. Wonderful graphics, movement, and FANTASTIC combat system. And the best part is the devs seem to really care about the community and how the game functions as a whole. There have been multiple hotfixes since launch and great compensation. I hope the story picks up a bit as far as keeping my interest, but I really don't have any major complaints. Hope all good trends continue, as I know I will be playing this for a while.

Though, I wish the game had lower requirements so other players could enjoy it too. I could run all games smoothly on my phone, but Wuthering Waves lags for some reason. I wish for this to be fixed because I can see lots of people having a same problem.

This game blew me away. Absolutely amazing. The characters are insanely beautiful, alongside the graphics. The storyline and cinematography are perfect. Despite this, I have been experiencing problems such as stuttering and sudden frame drops. I hope it'll be fixed soon. Thank you, Kuro!

We had a rocky start, but in just a few days Kuro has pulled some wild strings and are constantly working to fix issues and improve the game. Aside from that, combat is amazing, there's so much depth to it, it's fluid, and every hit feels like it has weight behind it. The world is beautiful. It's gorgeous and well designed. And also... the parkour is phenomenal. Gonna be playing this for a while 😀

After hours in playing the game, I've collected my thoughts. 🌊 First, the combat mechanics and overall fluidity of executing combos is really satisfying. The only problem is optimization which results in lag but, it still runs quite well. ⚡ Second, IT'S CARRIED BY THE SOUNDTRACK, I get goosebumps and pumped everytime I fight lol. 🤟 Lastly, its highlight has got to be its character animations and expressions! Really vivid and full of personality! Devs are really fast in fixing bugs too! 🚀

Needs fine- tuning, shows tremendous promise. Seems the drop rates aren't that great, but not many gacha games are. great story, and wide character options keeps the game running forward. Not sure why the game has a poor overall rating. I'm enjoying this more than similar style games. again, please fix your drop rates.

Spent money there, absolutely no regrets, might do so again.. But not if the game doesn't optimize. It's becoming too slow and laggy for certain devices, phone being the main issue on my part. My phone is only 1 year old, yet it's heating up very fast and stops the game on certain occurrences. It's been a real pain to just finish my dailies with the recent updates. Fix it please, deleting old files could truly help. Wuwa will be the first to leave if the game becomes too heavy for my phone.

Can't even play the game cause of performance issues. Over the course of each update, the performance is getting worse and worse each time. I used to run WuWa at max settings 60-ish fps at launch with my 888, which I consider a feat and would only crash if I teleported too much, which was acceptable. But now, in 2.4, it's literally unplayable at lowest settings 30fps, which is a big drop from launch. Kuro, I know you can fix this. Currently, you are the only devs that truly listen,and I need you

The single best gacha game in existence. It's not perfect, but overall it is better than everything else. Good exploration, really good combat, beautiful scenery, gorgeous characters, good music, story is bad and confusing at the beginning but it gets really good from act 5 onwards, most generous of all gachas, devs listen to player feedback. My only real complaint aside from the story beginning optimization, the game is a bit laggy (more on mobile than PC) and it could definitely be improved.

The game took a turn for the worse starting at 2.0 in my view, with a lack of polish across the board. It feels like the devs see the "open world" more as a chore, as exploration too has been very boring and unexciting since that very same update. Just because flight makes world traversal easy doesn't mean it makes it more fun. Imo, with the direction they are heading, Wuthering Waves would have been a far better game if they fully focused on the combat aspect, no half assed open world

Love it! although... it's really hard to play this game, especially if you want to level up your new characters. but overall its a great game definitely better that genshin and Honkai (although honkai is more giving), Just one concern tho. They really should focuse on balancing both the genders of the characters since the male characters was my main reason to download this game.

This game is still pretty new so far. It was rocky at launch by their teams have been working so hard to smooth things out, and the game runs smoothly now. The character designs have actual variety and character, unlike genshin. The game is also very fun to play. Combat and travel feel AMAZING as well. And you're actually rewarded for the time you put into the game. With time, this game will definitely surpass genshin if the devs keep up the good work like this.

fun and addicting! the world is amazing, the characters are really likable (some of the designs do feel a bit... lackluster to me? but i really dont mind it since the art is beautiful) the 3d models are absolutely fantastic, like, i genuinely appreciate all the effort they put into the game's aesthetic and into improving. that being said, it does lag sometimes, and when im fighting i often get stuck on random objects (same for the tds npcs) which is annoying unfortunately

I am a veteran Genshin player, but I really enjoy WW for having some machanics that aren't available in Genshin, like the evasion-counter system, skippable dialogue and fast pace combat. The combat system is what I like about this game. But, the companion stories and main quest story, are too lengthy and what makes it worse is they aren't skippable. Overall, it's a good game and very addictive.

game is alright, but w a few problems. there are times though when the game audio just suddenly cut or become choppy out of nowhere. one time i'd use a characters ult and the effects would blur the screen blocking my view during combat. the "save to gallery" button doesnt work when taking ingame pics since the beginning. the game never saved the pics and hasnt made an album in my gallery no matter where i search. i would just result to screenshots and cropping instead. ^^

For all those saying it's lagging and crashing give the game some time, it's only been over a week since it came out so the optimization is not good yet aswell, but it's an overall a really good game mainly because of the mechanics and the pull rates, yes the graphics need optimising and the lag needs to be reduced. But it's all about enjoying the game and if you don't then don't play. The game is also F2P friendly so you DON'T have to spend money for pulls like, genshin.

I am a Genchin Impact player and I generally love old-time games. I started playing day 1 but eventually dropped this during the first half of 1.1 because of the abysmal mobile optimization that I just couldn't take anymore. This game It's a great experience for me, the story might start off boring but it will get exciting, and the gameplay well it's similar to some other open world game just with more/less mechanic. And yeah nice art for the character and map and overall it's worth it to play, ah yeah the difficulty of the enemy is not much just built your character decently and that probably enough for story and other that's all.

Greetings! I've been playing this game since its first launch but went hiatus for months because of busy schedules. I just came back to the game this December 2024 but apparently encounter some bugs. Love this game and am excited to play in full once all the bugs are worked out. Minus one star because for me it is completely impossible to play on PC even with the lowest graphics and settings. I enjoy the gameplay, it's kinda similar to genshin but the combat is like much better. Only the downside, this game so unoptimized, can't get a solid 30fps even with lowest setting in my device, whereas I can get a solid 60fps in genshin with high settings. Nevertheless, this game is still fun despite the low framerates. Edit: after a few patches the ping problem is fixed apparently, but the graphics lag still makes this game unplayable.

After finishing the 2.2 update and going back to finish off all that I missed from 2.0 and 2.1, this game definitely deserves 5 stars. The combat and world exploration are magnificent as you can be exploring for hours (even to the point that they send you a notification saying you've been playing for too long) The development team at Kuro are some of the best I've seen in years as you can tell that they respect their players and love the game. Definitely looking forward for more!

nothing much to say cept its a really good game. story, graphics, combat, music, basically everything about it is just 5/5 for me. ive yet to find a flaw in this game, and even if i had, the devs will just make it right next patch. all the new features in the game were added via ideas from player feedbacks, goes to show they actually listen to their players.

The setting is good; well made for what I have seen this far. Combat is interesting and well thought out when you aren't in connection or bug galore hard mode. There are consistent grammar issues. There are plenty of optimization issues for mobile devices. Story and characterization DELIVERY issues; they make some children's games look like masterwork writing, even with their flaws. Overall, a 1.5/5, rounding up to spare the feelings of work crunched staff.

world map is great and they try a lot with different sorts of environments, tons of qol for exploration, character design is vibrant and gameplay mixes fun with difficulty. unfortunately it falls under a gacha caveat, though necessary, it makes the game inherently feel pay to win. going as far as some characters gaining less value without the proper pulled weapon. its also gonna feel difficult for newer players. aside from the meta perspective, as a free game this supplies my dopamine in spades

The graphics are amazing, the controls are easy to use IMO. since I'm using a Tab s9+ I never experienced any kind of stuttering. The character design is 10 out of 10. There are two issues with this game, one's minor and the other's not. The minor issue is the names in the game which are Chinese and pretty similar to each other. The major issue which made me quit the game is the LOOOOOOOOOOONG conversations between characters which is pretty BORING.

While the game may have some technical issues such as lag and an unusual en dub, the story and overall gameplay are so engaging and enjoyable that it's still worth playing. The story is so compelling and the characters so engaging that you can look past the technical issues, looking forward for more updates in the future!!

fun and very engaging. the puzzles are easy to understand and the explroation is simple, combat is phenomenal and the dodging is hard to do but you'll get better with practice. keep a healer in your team and put it random chars and your good to go. easy to play, 10/10. dont get me starte on the animations. the budget is high and clear. especially the recent announcements on Jinshi and another character.

One of the best games I've played. The gameplay is incredibly fast-paced and engaging. The world looks beautiful even on mobile. In another, it made me feel giddy and had me kicking the air while my face was red. Overall, it's one of the best games I've experienced.

Looks everything is good and amazing till the game story ends. But after that, there is a lags what to play because there is only to do, defeat the enemies and level up the character's. Pretty well so far, very smooth gameplay for me and quite interesting setup like running on the wall and dancing turtle. Require some skills while playing since the enemy could dodge but I like it. Pros: This mobile gacha game offers the best graphic quality for an open world game, a great story, more battle experience, more rewards for drawn characters, guaranteed limited weapons and you can choose standard weapons. Cons: You need a mid-range device for a better gaming experience, which makes sense considering the game uses Unreal Engine 4

The game is a bit glitchy. The voice over during story quests sometimes abruptly skips and starts a whole new line. The animation sometimes glitches when you skip. The overall movement in game feels a bit glitchy. Since it's still early, this might just need some small fixes. The graphics is good, I love the small details that they have added. The rocks and leaves look so real. Additionally, the combat is satisfying although could still use some improvement. They are generous with rewards.

Honestly I started this game about a month ago, sped ran my first account and restarted because of how good the story and animations were, characters are all very unique and interesting, lots of free rewards you can gain by "grinding" but this is one game it doesn't really feel like a grind because every fight is different. Really love the open combat design instead of turn based, true RPG, and you will not be disappointed.

The game was great, enjoyable especially the terrain and places that looks like tourist spots, the fighting mechanics was really acrobatic, almost all the resources in the game are free to play friendly, the resonators are very intricate each one of them (hoping for more shogun and samurai resonators) the only thing I was hoping for was the optimization of the game especially for the low end devices. Hoping for this game to be one of the best for days to come.🟢🐉

OVERALL AMAZING GAME, HIGHLY RECOMMEND. I'm writing this review a day after launch so the game understandably has its fair share of bugs . However, the devs are already on it and I'm seeing improvements every time I log on. Additionally, what sets WuWa apart from other Gacha's is that it's combat system is actually complex, challenging, and incredibly entertaining!! The game is also very generous with its rewards and player compensations which are very strong signs that this game will thrive

it's a good game, really. the mechanic, the story, the quests, the graphic.. are all mesmerising and fun. Very fun game, nice exploration, fun puzzles, good quest, a skip button, multiplayer possible and a whole lot of good lore. Can only recommend the game. The only little downside is the lag, it's not much most of the time but on some days it's quite a bit. Maybe because of no high performance phone here but still a but sad. Game still has beautiful graphics.

The games and the contents are good, although I have only one concern. The performance, I have a good and working gaming laptop, it runs good with 3A games but when it comes to WUWA it starts lagging in areas with a lot of things in it and when boss fights starts using a whole lot of skills. The game itself is good alreay don't get me wrong, what they just need to do now is optimize it to devices.

Great game. Great Graphics. Fast to respond with fixing what needed to be fixed. Keeps getting better. Please continue doing this. Gameplay with dodging and parry feels really good and satisfying. I'm roughly 20 hrs in and there is still so much more to do. Apparently the launch was a bit rough for some, but I have had no issues so far. The bigger issues about log in seem to be getting better and are minimizing quickly as well. I haven't had anything other than fun. Combat is great, traversal is fast and smooth, and it's huge. 9/10

Game has been out for 2 days now and so far the game had a rocky start to be expected for an open world gacha game but the devs have been constantly patching the game up and a lot of the issues has been fixed or is being fixed right now and they're giving away multiple 10 pulls for it and even a 5 star selector. Aside from that the game is exactly what I wanted a fast paced combat with hard difficulty boss fights if you like that you're gonna like this game.

Been playing the game for at least 2 months now and I've got to say the games a 10/10 compared to other gacha games I've played. I like how generous the developers are especially with all the free in-game currencies/items they give out. Playing this game on the phone, I have had just one time when the game crashed during a boss battle. But never again. The world is really pretty and the music is relaxing. The character models are great for both male and female characters. The combat can be a bit of effort on the phone, but it's still really fun. The game has puzzle mechanics that I've not seen in other similar games. The story starts off slow, but after playing all the current main story, I really enjoyed it.

I like the gameplay and content more than the rewards. many players have been greedy nowadays. after the anniversary, I never complained about it and just enjoy the game. nothing else. my phone is Infinix Zero 30 5G, and it plays very well with a slight lag(but not really due to almost full storage). it's a really nice game, it's enjoyable, the characters are fun to play and look stunning, and it's just fun overall. This game is very well processed and produces an excellent gaming experience. Characters design, art and model; skills style and effect; world map and scenery; gameplay and optimization; voices, bgm and sfx; visual detail and color tune; weapons art and model; boss monsters design and skill style; simple but entertaining puzzles, minigames, events and quests. 5 stars for the hardwork and bring this experience to us.

PC User since the start of the game... I can't play on my PC coz I've always been away, so I try this on my potato phone... Android Gameplay is smooth and the biggest reason I play personally. Encore ftw. Pretty amazing game. I love the open world and the character's design.It's vast and so much to do I can't wait to see more of the story that has me so intrigued about this world. The menus are a bit of a mess but not a reason to not play. Overall a well done game for the ride.

This is the best gacha game I have ever played. The combat is a lot of fun, the story is interesting, the open world is fun to explore, and the characters are great. Even if you don't care about the story you can skip it with a button and you can do this for almost any dialogue in the game. Even when you get really far into the game there is still a lot of fun and challenging content to engage in. The only problem I have with it are performance issues on the mobile version.

Overall, it's a great game! Not only did you guys improved on the visual quality but the new character designs as well. The reason I'm giving only 4 stars for now is due to the fact that sometimes the camera would shake unnecessarily whenever I'm gliding or running too fast. Finally, it's also due to the rendering. Despite having high graphics and resolution, faces of npcs would seem smudged or blurry. Hope you can fixed these issues. Again, a phenomenal game :-)👌.

It's really a good game, nice graphics, cool characters, interesting mechanic and the world is huge!! My only problem is that, it easily makes my phone hot and it glitches. One time my phone actually shut itself down and I was worried the motherboard is damaged. Thankfully, my phone is fine but I'll just stop using the app until everything is fine and stable. When that day comes, I'll be sure to download it again!

Have played this game for a couple of days on my tablet and so far I have been enjoying it. Cons: the game is slightly laggy, the voicelines get cut in some summoning animations and scenes even when it's not in auto play, the story tends to drag and is too info dumpy from the start, the EN voice direction needs to be improved for a lot of characters. Pros: the combat is actually engaging, enemies feel interactive and diverse, the monster collecting system is fun, the character models are great.

I've been play wuthering waves since day one. The story just draws you in and the combat is just so satisfying. I used to main Jinshi, but now I am an Iuno main. As a dolphin spending wise the game has been amazing. Due to the game giving out so many rewards I don't feel like I have to over spend. Some patches I might not even need to spend. Honestly I only spend more than a bit of money because I get all weapons as well as characters. If you just go for your favorites money becomes obsolete!

While it is a very fun game, the constant crashing and black screen makes it hard to play. Before, it would crash about every 10-15 mins. Now, it crashes a minute or two in. The black screen issue is also something that's been happening for a few days now, which is unfortunate. If the game becomes more optimised and didn't lag/crash so much, I'd definitely give it a higher rating. Definitely needs to fix it's issues on mobile, it's ridiculous.

Very fun and interesting game. The visuals are top-tier, and the characters are gorgeous. The gameplay can be a bit laggy, but fortunately, it's still bearable, and only minor issues are experienced. The storyline is okay. The combat is fun and easy to understand, it's all I could ask for. This game gives generous rewards and the developers are quick to act once a bug/issue is met. Overall, I love this game so far and would recommend it to people who love to play open-world games.

Despite not being able to play wuwa on my phone. I saved up for a computer just for the sake of playing wuwa 😭. I'm so happy I can finally play wuwa again after all this time. The story line , the art style , and everything did not disappoint me. Everything goes very smoothly. Not a single lag in sight. I recommend playing wuwa on a computer instead of on your phone. Cause your phone cannot handle it.

Played for 2 or so hours, it's fun. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because the camera controls for battle are too random and the glide button isn't convenient. Otherwise graphics are great. Few frame drops. Lots to explore. The initial game load time is very long, way more than Dark Souls games. But similarly, the trade off is having no load times during actual gameplay. If the game doesn't load at all, it is your old device, not the game. Try it out yourself.

The game is so good and has a lot of potential to grow. The developers are listening to it's community to make the game more promising. The only thing is that why we can't use other unleveled echoes to upgrade our desired echo which is waste if we can't used all the collected echoes we have. One more thing is it's hard to play the game on mobile most especially the screen in combat and the auto locking which made it hard for us deal with the enemies.

It's a nice game. Played for a few hours, but I'm married to Genshin and only have so much time and energy. Ability descriptions are really wordy and oftentimes vague/confusing. While the world is post-apocalyptic, the color palettes of characters and the open world tend to blur together into desaturated smears. The bugs I encountered weren't game-breaking, just silly. Combat is fun and easy once you get the hang of it. Music is lovely. Story has potential so far. Return Scar's onigiri 2024

The exploration, puzzles, characters, story, details are all very well done! Even 4-stars have good quality outfits too! And listening to community input to improve the game on top! My experience with Wuthering Waves has been amazing! Sure sometimes there is a bug but its nothing to cry about! Keep this up! Because this is my favorite game now! Especially enjoying the fact I can help new players beat high level bosses for early 5-star material!

Wow! What can I say about this game? Amazing! Generous! I liked almost everything about this game!! Combat mechanic are so cool! Puzzle were interesting. The game itself have unique storyline!. Don't let me start on character! They are well done! Perfect! What can I say? I don't mind spending some here if this keep going.. although sometimes bug kinda piss me off. But it's a new game so I don't really put my eye on it too much. Limitless potential!! Keep the hard work Devs!.

I've been enduring the stutter and lag ever since the release day hoping that it will be fixed or at least be minimized by the time the new version arrive. scar. kidding aside, i haven't faced that much issue within the game, and everything has been pretty smooth with me. there are a few bugs here and there, but i know they've been working on it, and some of it had been fixed. the story so far has been pretty interesting. the graphics are decent. my favorite part of this game is the combat, i was looking forward to it, and it didn't disappoint. the characters are pretty and cute. the developers are generous with gifting their players. recommended!

One of the very best open world exploration games, anime games, and third-person combat games I've ever played. Imagine if Breath of the Wild, Nier Automata, and Elden Ring had a baby--it would be this. Splash in an element of Pokémon, an enticing and engaging story, and you have one your hands one of the very best mobile games ever. You can also play on PC with much better GFX, textures, and controls making it superbly flexible. The devs are also amazing, and have listened to the player-base.

From what I was able to get to, the story line was interesting, the character design was amazing, and the gameplay was fun.

I loved this game so far. I have played similar games before (like Genshin Impact for example), and it's pretty similar to it. I was (and am) very excited about the game, it's really fun, especially fighting. But unfortunately I have to give it a lower rating because of the graphics quality. The game has come a long way and is definitely improving. It's alright. Just another genshin Impact/ zelada game, the only difference is the gameplay and the fights. The story so far is... Not that great. I feel like I missed a whole chapter or something. Really great game actually 😮‍💨 , I'm loving the battle style and the exploration of it , but it'd be nice if the lag in mobile + computer was fixed. This game takes the open-world formula that was made by Hoyoverse and mixes it with Kuro Games' fast paced combat that feels like a mix between Genshin Impact and Devil May Cry, creating a unique gameplay experience that is fun and addictive. While the game does have some technical issues, Kuro Games has proven to be very receptive to their players and are willing to address their issues and concerns. I am so invested into WuWa and I cannot wait to see what the future has in store for this game.

This is one of the best games I've ever played and it just came out. From the action to the story, personally I think it tops all action games out there. The dodge mechanic makes fighting enemies fun and the skills and talents are very detailed. I love the time they took to make the characters look alive. (plus it is very easy to get tides so f2p is very reasonable because of all the fun events to get astrite)

Other than the game lagging super ultra mega hard on pc (SOMETIMES) it runs great on my phone, at a lesser quality though. It has everything Genshin Impact doesn't AND more. It is however lacking in the music department but the trailer of the new character Zhezhei shows promise that they can deliver amazing soundtracks. If you are going to spend money on a gacha game, I would recommend you do so on Wuthering Waves! The rates for 5 star characters and weapons is more consumer friendly.

Wuthering Waves is honestly one of the best action-adventure games I've played. The combat feels super smooth, and the movement mechanics make exploration really fun. The world is stunning, and the soundtrack adds so much to the atmosphere. I also love the variety of Resonators—it keeps things interesting. There are some performance issues on lower-end devices, but overall, it's an amazing experience. Definitely worth checking out if you love open-world RPGs!"

I personally love this game. I haven't had too many issues once I bumped down the graphics to the lowest setting. I play on mobile and PC. PC works great. Graphics are gorgeous. The story telling is... Well, it could be better. It has a good premise. The English voice acting isn't great. The gameplay itself is so much fun. The exploration is awesome and I absolutely love that every area has lore. I can see myself playing this for as long as I play Genshin. I love them both very much.

Despite minor issues on launch, the game is fantastic, story needs a bit of work and voice acting in english isn't great but I really enjoy the open world, the traversal and the combat. The devs we're extremely generous at launch and I get the feeling that they are trying their best to listen to player feedback and to fix any issues asap. 5/5 G Play stars but overall I'd give the game 8/10 for now

Despite the occasional lags and frame drops, this is one of the best game I've played in a long time. I hope Kuro will continue to be this responsive to the players' opinion and suggestion, as well as their generosity to their target audience. I also hope that they would be able to find a way to remove—or at least decrease the frequency of frame drops and lags in mobile, because most players either don't have a high-end device or pc to fully experience the game, or both.

To start off, the game is amazing, i love the parrying mechanic, dodging mechanic, and probably the, if not the best gacha games out there if only that one problem is fixed, and it's the intense amount of lag, im looking forward to it being more available on wider variety of devices, other than that the whole core game is amazing and brings alot of content

This game is amazing on both PC and mobile. Best Mobile Game I've played. Users must navigate this hostile and desolate world, The game features a dynamic real-time combat system, skills, and effects that really bring out the different styles for each character. The post-apocalyptic theme provides a thrilling experience for me to enjoy. The game also offers a range of social features and multiplayer co-op combat. The game's gacha makes me come for more, but there are some minor bugs and issues, lag as well,so I recommend playing on a high-end device. 🙏

To be honest, the game is great although need just a little more polishing. I encounter some bugs and lags but it's understandable since the game just released and the developers are quickly fixing and resolving it. Additionaly, the developers also listen to their community, working hard, and is very generous so far. I hope this game went well and succeeded and I'm looking forward to it's future patch.

As a mobile game, it's probably the best action combat + stat system I've experienced. But that's it. There's literally nothing compelling except fighting, which is fun, but it's a formula that eventually people move on from. Story, voice acting, music (though sound design is ok) are unbelievably disappointing, ranging from average to, well, terrible. Some of these need an upgrade, or it's going to be another case of a failed attempt at being an over-hyped "Genshin killer."

This game is very fun to play, but the stupid auto targeting is so annoying. It stays locked on to one target and ignores the ones closer to me. It's too hard to untarget using my phone. This needs to be fixed. Add a setting or something. I thought I removed it, but sometimes it pops up at the worst times and annoys me to my core. Other than that the game is fun to play.

Best game so far, I've enjoyed the story and gameplay. Although it lags a bit since my phone can't handle the game but everything is working properly so far. I'd rate the story a 5/5 it have a very interesting Story line, can't wait to discover more. And I love how generous they are with the rewards and free SSR. Best game that came out this year.

Wuthering Waves is easily one of the best mobile games out there. The world-building is top-notch, the boss fights are intense and skill-based, and the storyline actually pulls you in. It's a misconception that 16GB RAM prevents lag. Performance is driven by the SoC (CPU/GPU) and optimization. If the update changed the shader cache or increased the thermal load, even a high-end device will throttle. RAM just gives the game room to breathe, it doesn't make a weak processor faster😮‍💨😮‍💨
